title: Außenspiegelanordnung für ein Fahrzeug sowie Fahrzeug mit einer solchen Außenspiegelanordnung
abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft eine Außenspiegelanordnung (1) für ein Fahrzeug, mit einem Minimalspiegel (2), welcher einen Spiegelkopf (3) mit einem ortsfest im Spiegelkopf (3) montierten Spiegelglas (5) und einen Spiegelfuß (7) umfasst, welcher über eine einstellbare Verstellmechanik (9) mit dem Spiegelkopf (3) verbunden ist, wobei die Verstellmechanik (9) des Minimalspiegels (2) ausgeführt ist, bei Bedarf eine Position des Spiegelkopfs (3) mit dem Spiegelglas (5) relativ zum Spiegelfuß (7) zu verstellen, wobei eine Kameraanordnung (10) im Spiegelkopf (3) hinter dem Spiegelglas (5) angeordnet ist und eine Kamera (12), welche eine Öffnung (3) im Spiegelkopf (3) zumindest teilweise durchgreift, und eine Verstellvorrichtung (14) umfasst, welche ausgeführt ist, die Kamera (12) am Spiegelkopf (3) zu befestigen und eine Position der Kamera (12) bezogen auf den Spiegelkopf (3) einzustellen, sowie ein Fahrzeug mit mindestens einer solchen Außenspiegelanordnung (1).

title: Vorrichtung zur Ionisierung eines Luftstroms und Verfahren zur Herstellung einer solchen Vorrichtung zur Ionisierung eines Luftstroms
abstract: Eine Vorrichtung (1) zur Ionisierung eines Luftstroms hat einen Behälter (2) aus elektrisch isolierendem Material, eine im Innenraum des Behälters (2) angeordnete Innenelektrode (3) und eine an der Außenseite des Behälters (2) angeordneten Außenelektrode (10), sowie eine Ansteuerelektronik (12), die mit der Innenelektrode (3) und der Außenelektrode (10) zur Beaufschlagung mit einer Versorgungsspannung verbunden ist. Die innere und/oder äußere Oberfläche des Behälters (2) ist säurebehandelt. Ein elektrisch leitfähiges Material (7) ist mit der in das elektrisch leitfähige Material (7) eingesteckten Innenelektrode (3) in dem Innenraum des Behälters (2) eingebracht und die Innenelektrode (3) ist von dem elektrisch leitfähigen Material (7) umgeben. Die innere und/oder äußere Oberfläche des Behälters (2) ist durch Silanisierung hydrophobiert.

title: Schutzhelm
abstract: Schutzhelm, insbesondere Motorradschutzhelm, mit einer Außenschale (1) zur Verteilung von Aufprallkräften und mit einem mit der Außenschale (1) fest verbundenen Steckplatz (2) zur Aufnahme einer elektrischen Zusatzvorrichtung (3), wobei der Steckplatz (2) an einem Rand (6) der Außenschale (1) angeordnet ist und der Steckplatz (2) dazu eingerichtet ist, bei Aufnahme der Zusatzvorrichtung (3) diese im Wesentlichen entlang einer Innenseite (7) der Außenschale (1) zu führen, sodass die aufgenommene Zusatzvorrichtung (3) sich im Wesentlichen entlang der Innenseite (7) der Außenschale (1) erstreckt, dadurch gekennzeichnet, dass der Steckplatz (2) eine Schnappvorrichtung (17) für einen formschlüssigen Eingriff zum Festhalten der Zusatzvorrichtung (3) aufweist, dass der Steckplatz (2) eine Wandung (18) aufweist, an welcher die aufgenommene Zusatzvorrichtung (3) flächig anliegt und dass die Schnappvorrichtung (17) mindestens einen Haken (16) aufweist, welcher mindestens eine Haken (16) für den formschlüssigen Eingriff zum Festhalten der Zusatzvorrichtung (3) verstellbar aus der Wandung (18) ragt.

title: VERFAHREN ZUR AUTOMATISCHEN PASSERKORREKTUR IN EINER DRUCKMASCHINE
abstract: Die vorliegende Erfindung betrifft ein Verfahren zur automatischen Passerkorrektur in einer Druckmaschine mit wenigstens einem Bilderfassungssystem zur Passerkontrolle, das insbesondere bei Verwendung von kreisförmigen Messmarken und großen Passerabweichungen vorteilhaft angewendet werden kann. Dazu werden zwei digitale Korrekturverfahren parallel in einem Rechner durchgeführt und je nach Ausmaß der Passerabweichung ein grobes oder ein feines Korrekturverfahren an die Druckmaschine gesendet.

abstract: Haltevorrichtung (1) für Personen zur Verwendung in einem öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel, aufweisendeinen Haltegriff (6),ein Gehäuse (4), undein Verfahrteil (5), an welchem der Haltegriff (6) befestigt ist und über welches der Haltegriff (6) an das Gehäuse (4) angekoppelt ist,wobei das Verfahrteil (5) mittels eines Antriebs in das Gehäuse (4) einfahrbar und aus dem Gehäuse (4) ausfahrbar ist.

title: System zum Aufbewahren mindestens eines Endgeräts in einem Fahrzeug
abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft ein System zum Aufbewahren mindestens eines Endgeräts (12) in einem Fahrzeug, wobei das System ein um eine Achse (10) drehbares Modul (6) aufweist, wobei das Modul (6) eine Vorderseite mit einem Anzeigefeld (5) und eine Rückseite mit mindestens einer Schnittstelle (7) zum vorübergehenden und lösbaren Befestigen des mindestens einen Endgeräts (12) an der Rückseite des Moduls (6) aufweist.

inventors: AMBROSETTI SEBASTIEN [DE]; Ambrosetti, Sebastien

title: Verfahren zum Bestimmen eines Drucks in einer Vakuumschaltröhre und Druckmessvorrichtung
abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft ein Verfahren zum Bestimmen eines Drucks in einer Vakuumschaltröhre (1), mit den Schritten: Bereitstellen der Vakuumschaltröhre, die eine erste Elektrode (3) und eine zweite Elektrode (4), die einen Kontaktzustand, in dem die erste Elektrode und die zweite Elektrode einander kontaktieren, und einen Beabstandungszustand haben, in dem die Elektroden voneinander beabstandet sind, sowie ein Gehäuse (2) aufweist, das einen Innenraum (26) begrenzt, in dem die Elektroden angeordnet sind, und das in dem Innenraum ein Vakuum hält, so dass in dem Beabstandungszustand die Elektroden von dem Vakuum elektrisch voneinander isoliert sind; Anlegen eines elektrischen Feldes (23) und eines Magnetfeldes (24) an den Innenraum, so dass eine Gasentladung erzeugt wird, wobei in dem Innenraum die Orientierung des elektrischen Feldes verschieden von der Orientierung des Magnetfeldes ist; Messen einer Stromstärke (I) der Gasentladung zu einer Mehrzahl von verschiedenen Zeiten (t); Bilden eines Messdatensatzes (I(t)) aus den Stromstärken und den Zeiten, wobei der Messdatensatz die zeitliche Entwicklung der Stromstärke während der Gasentladung darstellt; Anpassen zumindest eines Teils des Messdatensatzes mit zumindest einer Anpassungsfunktion (43), die einen oder mehrere Anpassungsparameter hat; Rückschließen von zumindest einen der Anpassungsparameter auf den Druck.
assignee: SIEMENS ENERGY GLOBAL GMBH & CO KG [DE]; Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
inventors: KOLETZKO MARTIN [DE]; RETTENMAIER THOMAS [DE]; Koletzko, Martin et al.

title: Druckmessvorrichtung und Verfahren zum Messen eines Drucks in einer Vakuumschaltröhre
abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft eine Druckmessvorrichtung (40) zum Messen eines Drucks in einer Vakuumschaltröhre (1), mit der Vakuumschaltröhre (1), die eine erste Elektrode (3) und eine zweite Elektrode (4), die einen Kontaktzustand, in dem die erste Elektrode (3) und die zweite Elektrode (4) einander kontaktieren, und einen Beabstandungszustand haben, in dem die erste Elektrode (3) und die zweite Elektrode (4) voneinander beabstandet sind, sowie ein Gehäuse (2) aufweist, das einen Innenraum (26) begrenzt, in dem die erste Elektrode (3) und die zweite Elektrode (4) angeordnet sind, und das in dem Innenraum (26) ein Vakuum hält, so dass in dem Beabstandungszustand die erste Elektrode (3) und die zweite Elektrode (4) von dem Vakuum elektrisch voneinander isoliert sind, einer Spannungsquelle (41), die eingerichtet ist, ein elektrisches Feld (23) an den Innenraum (26) anzulegen, einem Magneten (42), der eingerichtet ist, ein Magnetfeld (24) an den Innenraum (26) anzulegen, das in dem Innenraum (26) eine von dem elektrischen Feld (23) verschiedene Orientierung hat, und einer Strahlungsquelle (27), die eingerichtet ist, den Innenraum (26) mit einer elektromagnetischen Strahlung (28) zu beaufschlagen, die Gammastrahlung aufweist, wobei die Strahlungsquelle (27) ein Isotop aufweist, das die Gammastrahlung erzeugt und das innerhalb und/oder außerhalb des Gehäuses (2) angeordnet ist. Zudem betrifft die Erfindung ein Verfahren zum Messen des Drucks mit der Druckmessvorrichtung.
assignee: SIEMENS ENERGY GLOBAL GMBH & CO KG [DE]; Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG

title: Verfahren und System zur aktiven Geräuschminderung in Fahrzeugen
abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft ein Verfahren zur Geräuschunterdrückung für einen Insassen eines Kraftfahrzeugs, wobei ein In-Ohr-Ohrhörer (1) verwendet wird (S1), wobei durch mindestens ein Mikrofon (2) Umgebungsgeräusche erfasst werden und mithilfe einer Recheneinheit (3) eine Geräuschkompensation (S2) zum teilweisen Eliminieren der Umgebungsgeräusche erfolgt, indem Gegenschall erzeugt wird, wobei durch die Recheneinheit (3) ein vortrainiertes Modell des Maschinenlernens ausgeführt wird und dadurch eine Auswahl getroffen wird (S3), welche Umgebungsgeräusche zum Insassen durchgelassen werden und welche eliminiert werden, wobei die Recheneinheit (3) mit einer Steuereinheit (4) des Fahrzeugs verbunden ist und durch das Modell des Maschinenlernens die Auswahl gestützt auf aktuelle Informationen der Steuereinheit (4) des Fahrzeugs vorgenommen wird, wobei von der Recheneinheit (3) entschieden wird, die Sprache eines Mitfahrers durchzulassen, wenn eine akustische Signatur des Mitfahrers dem Modell des Maschinenlernens bekannt ist, und wobei der Mitfahrer zum Abgeben einer Sprachprobe durch die Steuereinheit (4) des Fahrzeugs oder durch die Recheneinheit (3) aufgefordert wird, wenn der Mitfahrer dem Modell des Maschinenlernens unbekannt ist, um eine akustische Signatur des Mitfahrers abzuleiten und ihn unter Zuordnung seiner akustischen Signatur als bekannt abzuspeichern.

title: Universal device for performing filtration, regeneration of mineral fuels or lubricants and filtration method
abstract: A universal device for performing filtration, regeneration of mineral fuels or lubricants and a method of filtration are described, wherein the device consists of a dirty container (ZN1) as a tank for unfiltered fuels or lubricants, a clean container (ČN2) as a tank for unfiltered fuels or lubricants, a device for filtering fuel or lubricants and monitoring devices (AN1; AN2). The main component of the technical solution is a specially modified filter (ŠUF11), which first captures water, thereby eliminating the possibility of contact, for example, with sulfur substances at the inlet to the facilities of devices that use fuel or lubricant. A specially modified filter (ŠUF11) and its regeneration component are composed of cellulose (1) providing the first stage of filtration and removal of large water (C1), molecular sieves (E3; E5) for removal of dissolved water (MS), Fuller's earth for removal of lighter oxidation products and improvement of color (FZ), activated alumina (4) for removal of complex oxidation products (AA) and cellulose (1), which as a protective filter prevents the penetration of particles from the upper layers (C2). Between all layers there is a layer of viscose (5), which ensures uniform distribution (C1) of oil or diesel over the entire surface of the individual layers. The monitoring device (AN1; AN2) has developed software that allows monitoring of the current status, history of measured values ​​and their archiving. The monitoring device (AN1; AN2) allows the collection of online data on the progress of filtration and regeneration and the achieved results in the form of data, graphs, excel tables, cvs and allows sending warnings when critical values ​​are reached via SMS, e-mail or mobile application.

title: A BLAST RESISTANT CAGE
abstract: A blast resistant cage is disclosed for securing a safe within an ATM or similar environment. The cage comprises spaced horizontal, vertical, and top members forming an enclosure with a door that allows access to the internal space. The door includes a locking mechanism to secure it in a closed position. The cage further includes a top blocking plate and a front blocking plate, the latter featuring an opening for cash transactions. These plates are strategically positioned to be displaced by a blast within the cage, thereby obstructing the ATM’s cash dispensing opening and preventing unauthorized access to the safe’s contents.

title: Verfahren und Vorrichtung zur Herstellung von Arzneiformen
abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft ein Verfahren zur Herstellung einer Arzneiform, umfassend folgende Schritte:a) Bereitstellung von wenigstens einem ersten Wirk- und/oder Hilfsstoff, wobei dieser als Faden (2) ausgebildet ist,b) Zuführung des Fadens (2) aus Schritt a) zu einer Mitnehmerwelle (5, 8) über wenigstens eine Zuführdüse (4),c) Aufbringen des Fadens (2) aus Schritt b) auf die Mitnehmerwelle (5, 8) oder Einführen des Fadens (2) in eine Aussparung an der Mitnehmerwelle (5, 8),d) Rotation der Mitnehmerwelle (5, 8) und translatorische und/oder pendelnde Bewegungen der wenigstens einen Zuführdüse (4) relativ zur Mitnehmerwelle (5, 8), so dass der Faden (2) aus Schritt c) Windungen bildet, wobei die einzelnen Windungen nicht parallel zueinander liegen und aus dem Faden (2) ein Rotationskörper (1, 16, 22) erzeugt wird, wobei dessen Größe von der Rotationsfrequenz der Mitnehmerwelle (5,8), des Durchmessers der Mitnehmerwelle (5, 8) und der Gesamtrotations-zeit der Mitnehmerwelle (5, 8) bestimmt wird,e) Abziehen des in Schritt d) erzeugten Rotationskörpers (1, 16, 22) von der Mitnehmerwelle (5, 8), sodass eine Arzneiform vorliegt.

title: RECYCLABLE MULTILAYERED POLYMERIC STRUCTURE WITH THERMAL RESISTANCE AND BARRIER PROPERTIES AND USES THEREOF
abstract: The present disclosure pertains to recyclable multilayered polymeric structures comprising a number N of layers. Said recyclable multilayered polymeric structures comprise an outer surface layer N1, an inner surface layer N2, and optionally one or more layers between N1 and N2. Said recyclable multilayered polymeric structures comprise at least two different layers. The outer surface layer N1 is a barrier layer comprising a first polymer P1, P1 is polyethylene-based polymer with an ethylene content of at least about 50 mol% functionalized with polar groups and having an oxygen transmission rate (OTR) below 30 cc•20µm/m2•atm•day; a melting temperature above 160°C; a moisture resistance characterized by a water vapor transmission rate (WVTR) of less than 2 g•mm/m2•atm•day; and a density below 1.10 g/cm3. Said recyclable multilayered polymeric structures are for use in packaging applications, such as food packaging, building liners, geomembranes, pipes or containers for liquids.

abstract: A magnetic fastener system has a magnetic encapsulation structure which has a first cap, a second cap, and at least one magnet. The first cap mates with the second cap and a magnet is positioned in a cavity formed therebetween. The first cap and second cap are sealed to create a watertight cavity. A laser welded junction may be formed between the first cap and the second cap to seal the first cap and the second cap to create the watertight cavity. The magnetic encapsulation structure may be positioned at least partially within a cavity of at least one mount having a shelf positioned along a perimeter of the cavity, where the magnetic encapsulation structure is movable between a retracted position and an extended position.

title: DISPLAY APPARATUS HAVING A LIGHT-EMITTING DEVICE AND AN ENCAPSULATION STRUCTURE
abstract: A light-emitting device can be disposed at an emission area defined by a bank insulating layer. A spacer can be disposed on the bank insulating layer. The light-emitting device, the bank insulating layer and the spacer can be covered by the encapsulation structure. The encapsulation structure can include a first encapsulating layer, a second encapsulating layer and a third encapsulating layer, which are sequentially stacked. The second encapsulating layer can have a higher fluidity than the first encapsulating layer and the third encapsulating layer. The spacer can have a stacked structure of a conductive pattern, a porous layer and a cap pattern. The second encapsulating layer can be in contact with a side surface of the porous layer. Thus, in the display apparatus, stains due to a difference in level of the upper surface of the encapsulation structure can be prevented.

abstract: Described herein are DMSO formulations and methods for cell therapy. Methods of treating a cell with these formulations are also provided. title: ULTRAVIOLET DISINFECTION SYSTEM AND METHOD
abstract: A far-ultraviolet (far-UVC) disinfection device including a light source positioned within a housing and configured to emit a far-UVC light. There are one or more subject detection sensors positioned configured to detect the presence of one or more subjects and a controller in communication with the light source and the one or more subject detection sensors. The controller is configured to receive detection data from the one or more subject detection sensors and determine whether one or more subjects are within a range of the far-UVC light emitted by the light source. The controller is further configured to cause the light source to emit or cease emitting far-UVC light based on the amount of time one or more subjects are within the range of the emitted. far-UVC light.

title: Dual-Action Mailbox — A Gravity-Activated Mechanical Device for Incoming Mail Notification
abstract: A dual-action mailbox for indicating incoming mail comprises a box body, an inlet gate pivotally mounted thereto, an outlet gate pivotally mounted thereto, and a track container affixed to the outlet gate. The track container houses at least one coloured ball movable along an internal track under gravity between a starting position and an observation position. A cam associated with the inlet gate retains the coloured ball in the starting position when the inlet gate is closed. Upon insertion of mail, the inlet gate pivots, lifting the cam and releasing the coloured ball to roll to the observation position where it is visible through an observation aperture in the outlet gate, providing a visual notification of delivery. Lifting the outlet gate for mail retrieval tilts the track container, causing the coloured ball to return under gravity to the starting position where it is again retained by the cam, and resetting the mechanism as the outlet gate is closed again. The cam further abuts the outlet gate when the inlet gate is forcibly pushed, limiting inward travel and preventing unauthorised access. ar a r a r

title: DEVICE FOR CALCULATING A SCALAR PRODUCT
abstract: Invention relates to computing technology and can be used in specialized computer systems, digital signal processing systems and neural networks to increase a range of variation of input data values when calculating a scalar product with pre-known multipliers (constants). Device for calculating a scalar product comprises an input for a maximum order of macro-partial products, three write inputs, four control inputs, two clock inputs, an input for an input data order, an input for an input data mantissa, an address input, a data input, a memory operating mode selection input, a memory select input, a reset input, a maximum order register for macro-partial products, an input data loading unit comprising k order registers, where k is a number of product pairs, and k mantissa registers, a maximum order determination unit comprising an order register, an order switch, an AND logic element, a subtractor, a higher order register, a maximum order register, an address register, a data register, a NOT-OR logic element, k nodes for order alignment and address bit formation, wherein each s-th node, where s=1,…, k, comprises an order register, a mantissa register, a subtractor, a first switch, a comparison circuit and a second switch, an OR logic element, an order adder, an address switch, a memory, a macro-partial product register, a macro-partial product adder-subtractor, a scalar product order register, a scalar product mantissa register, a scalar product order output, and a scalar product mantissa output. Technical result: increasing the range of variation of input data values when calculating the scalar product with pre-known multipliers by using a floating-point format.

title: METHOD FOR CONSERVATION OF RADIOACTIVE WASTE IN A WELDED TUFF MASSIF

title: LOCAL DRAINAGE SYSTEM OF SAUCER-SHAPED DEPRESSIONS
abstract: Local drainage system of saucer-shaped depressions includes drainage wells, regulating sluices, outlet structures, a network of open drainage channels, drains and closed drainage collectors. In the area of each saucer-shaped depression, a receiving trench is arranged, filled in the lower part with natural filtering material, on top of which a layer of water-permeable artificial filtering material is placed, and the upper part of the trench is covered with a fertile layer of soil. Wherein a closed drain is connected to the bottom of the trench, which is structurally connected to the nearest open drainage channel through the outlet structure.

title: METHOD FOR PRODUCING A DISINFECTANT BASED ON SILVER NANOPARTICLES
abstract: Method for producing a disinfectant based on silver nanoparticles involves preparing colloidal silver solution, reduction of silver from an aqueous solution of silver salt in the presence of a reducing agent and a stabilizer for the silver nanoparticles. Wherein, trisodium citrate is used both as a reducing agent and a stabilizer. The reduction is carried out in an aqueous medium at a temperature of 100 °C until a colloidal solution of silver nanoparticles with a size of 10–12 nm is formed.

title: THREE-LEVEL VOLTAGE INVERTER
abstract: Invention relates to electrical engineering and can be used in power conversion equipment and electronics as a three-level voltage inverter. The invention consists of positive and negative terminals for connecting a DC voltage source, a bridge on first, second, and third legs each having two series-connected upper and lower transistor-diode switches. The upper switches of the legs are connected via collectors and diode cathodes to a positive terminal of a buffer capacitor, the negative terminal of which is connected to emitters and diode anodes of the lower switches. A midpoint of the first leg is connected through an output filter inductor to a first terminal of a filter capacitor and a load, the second terminal of which is connected to a midpoint of the second leg and a negative power supply terminal. A fourth leg with two series-connected transistor-diode switches and a center-tapped autotransformer are introduced into the circuit. Outer terminals of the autotransformer are connected between midpoints of the third and fourth legs, and a midpoint of the autotransformer is connected to the positive power supply terminal. A technical result of the invention is a significant expansion of the field of formation and regulation of the output sinusoidal voltage while maintaining the quality of output energy without complicating the control system for the switches of the four legs.

title: AEROSOL DELIVERY SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR FORMING AEROSOL DELIVERY SYSTEM
abstract: Invention relates to aerosol delivery system and method for forming this system. Aerosol delivery system comprises: a control housing portion containing a first elongated tubular element having opposite ends and an energy source housed therein, and a cartridge housing portion comprising a second tubular element having first and second opposite ends, wherein the first end is engaged with one of the opposite ends of the control housing portion. The cartridge housing portion further comprises a first aerosol-generating device located inside the second tubular element and designed to engage functionally with an energy source following engagement between one of the opposite ends of the control housing portion and the first end of the cartridge housing portion. Wherein, the second end of the cartridge housing portion is oriented toward the mouth-engaging end of the aerosol delivery system. The second aerosol-generating device is positioned between the first aerosol-generating device and the mouth-engaging end of the aerosol delivery system. The second aerosol-generating device is designed to be detachably engaged within the second tubular element of the cartridge housing portion, and the second aerosol-generating device includes a cartridge having an elongated tubular housing with opposite ends containing porous partition elements. Method for forming aerosol delivery system is also proposed. Inventions ensure the delivery of aerosol under pleasant or comfortable conditions when it is inhaled into the user’s mouth.

title: RAILWAY TRACK CONDITION MONITORING SYSTEM FOR DETECTING OF OBSTACLES AHEAD OF A TRAIN USING DISTRIBUTED FIBER-OPTIC ACOUSTIC SENSING
abstract: Railway track condition monitoring system for detecting of obstacles ahead of a train using distributed fiber-optic acoustic sensing consists of a fiber-optic sensor cable deployed along the railway track on which the train is traveling. Additionally, a distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) system integrator and a data processing unit are connected to a fiber-optic sensor cable; the data processing unit receives acoustic signals along the railway track and is designed to determine the location and speed of the train. The distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) system integrator is designed to transmit optic impulses to a fiber-optic sensor cable. The system is designed to generate and transmit an alarm signal to the train operator via the train control system.

title: HYDRODYNAMIC SHAFT SEAL
abstract: Hydrodynamic shaft seal contains a rotating chamber filled with sealing fluid, designed to be driven by a motor, a shaft, and dividing discs immersed in the fluid - a stationary one, which is hermetically connected to the machine body, and a rotating one, which is hermetically connected to the shaft. The design incorporates n rotating chambers for the sealing fluid arranged in a chain, the same number of rotating separator discs hermetically connected to additional chambers, and the same number of autonomous drives for additional chambers. Rotating dividing disc is hermetically connected to the shaft and immersed in the sealing fluid in the last additional chamber of the chain. Each additional dividing disc is immersed in the sealing fluid in the preceding chamber, and each chamber is designed to rotate via its own autonomous drive at a speed greater than that of the preceding chamber.

title: DEVICE FOR THERMAL IMAGING DIAGNOSTICS OF A HYDROGENERATOR ROTOR
abstract: Device for thermal imaging diagnostics of a hydrogenerator rotor comprising a lens, a frequency divider, n separate infrared sensors of an infrared receiver, a buffer register, a video control unit, two controlled amplifiers, a voltage generator, a memory unit, a first counter, a data preparation unit, a switch, a position setting unit, a first indicator, a speed setting unit, a digital adder, three digital comparators, two registers, a position sensor, five AND elements, a clock distributor, five triggers, and two pulse generators. An output of the frequency divider is connected to an input of the buffer register and to a first input of the video control unit, the second and third inputs of which are connected to outputs of the first and second controlled amplifiers, the first inputs of which are connected to an output of the voltage generator. Second inputs are connected, respectively, to the first and second outputs of the memory unit, an input digital bus of which is connected to an output digital bus of the first counter. A fourth input of the video control unit together with a first input of the data preparation unit are connected to an output of the switch, an input digital bus of which is connected to an output digital bus of the buffer register, an input digital bus of which is connected to outputs of n separate infrared sensors of the infrared receiver. An output of the data preparation unit is connected to computer circuits. An output digital bus of the position setting unit is connected to a first input digital bus of the first digital comparator, the second input digital bus of which together with input digital buses of the first and second registers are connected to the output digital bus of the position sensor. An output of the first digital comparator is connected to a first input of the first AND element, the second input of which is connected to a first output of the second trigger, and an output is connected to a first input of the first trigger, the second input of which together with an input of the first indicator are connected to a second output of the second trigger, the first input of which is connected to an output of the second digital comparator, the second input digital bus of which is connected to the output digital bus of the speed setting unit. A first input digital bus is connected to an output digital bus of the digital adder, the first and second input digital buses of which are connected, respectively, to the output digital buses of the first and second registers, the inputs of which are connected, respectively, to the first and second outputs of the clock distributor, the third output of which is connected to a second input of the second trigger. An output of the second AND element is connected to a second input of the data preparation unit, an output of the first trigger is connected to a first input of the second AND element, the second input of which is connected to an output of the first pulse generator. An output is connected to inputs of the frequency divider, the voltage generator, and the switch. Output digital buses of the first and second registers are connected, respectively, to the first and second input digital buses of the third digital comparator, the first and second outputs of which are connected, respectively, to first inputs of the fourth and fifth triggers, the second inputs of which are connected to the third output of the clock distributor. Outputs are connected, respectively, to first inputs of the fourth and fifth AND elements, the second inputs of which are connected to the output of the frequency divider. The output of the first digital comparator is connected to a first input of the third trigger, the second input of which is connected to a fourth output of the clock distributor. An output is connected to a first input of the third AND element, the second input of which is connected to an output of the second pulse generator, and an output is connected to an input of the clock distributor. A comparator, a sixth AND element, two counters, a fourth digital comparator, a vibration setting unit, and a second indicator are introduced. The output of the switch is connected to an input of the comparator, an output of which is connected to a third input of the sixth AND element, the second input of which is connected to the output of the frequency divider, and a first input is connected to a third output of the second counter. First and second outputs of the second counter are connected, respectively, to first and second inputs of the first counter, and first and second inputs are connected, respectively, to outputs of the fourth and fifth AND elements. The output of the first counter is connected to a second input of the third counter, a first input of which is connected to the output of the sixth AND element, and an output digital bus is connected to a first input digital bus of the fourth digital comparator, the second input digital bus of which is connected to an output digital bus of the vibration setting unit, and an output is connected to an input of the second indicator.

title: BRAKING PULLEY
abstract: Braking pulley consists of a hub, a disk, a rim, a circular groove, a heat-accumulating material, a fan wheel made of aluminum alloy, which comprises of a hub and a flange connected by blades. The fan wheel rim is secured to the end face of the brake pulley rim via a flange and an O-ring by screws. The braking pulley rim consists of two sections- an outer and an internal section- separated by a circular groove and connected on one side by a disk, and in the circular groove between the outer and the inner sections of the brake pulley, a heat-accumulating material is placed, which is used as nanofluid containing fusible metals-sodium (Na) and lithium (Li)-in the form of powders mixed in proportion to water. The circular groove houses the heat-conducting rods of the fan wheel, which are perforated.

title: METHOD FOR SEPARATING A POLYMER BLEND
abstract: A first aspect of the invention relates to a method for separating a polymer blend, wherein the polymer blend comprises (I) a polyester and (II) one or more component(s) selected from the group consisting of a second polymer, a third polymer, a colorant, and an additive, wherein second polymer and third polymer are different from each other and different from the polyester of (I); the method comprising: (a) providing the polymer blend and providing a solvent comprising 1 -methylpyrrolidin-2-one; (b) optionally contacting the polymer blend with the solvent comprising 1- methylpyrrolidin-2-one at a temperature T1 of < 140 °C, preferably of < 135°C, thereby obtaining a solvent comprising 1 -methylpyrrolidin-2-one, which is enriched in dissolved optional second polymer, in optional colorant and in optional additive or a part thereof; and a residue of the polymer blend, which is depleted of optional second polymer, of optional colorant and of optional additive or part thereof; and comprises the polyester, optionally the third polymer; and the optional additive or a part thereof; and (c) contacting the polymer blend provided in step (a) or the residue of the polymer blend obtained in step (b) with a solvent comprising 1 -methylpyrrolidin-2-one at a temperature T2 in the range of from > 150 to < 160°C, thereby obtaining a solvent, which comprises 1 -methylpyrrolidin-2-one and which is enriched in dissolved polyester compared to the solvent provided in step (a) and comprises optionally at least a part of the additive, and optionally a residue of the polymer blend, which is depleted of polyester and comprises optionally the third polymer and optionally the additive or a part thereof. A second aspect of the invention is directed to a polyester obtained or obtainable from the method according to the first aspect of the invention. In a third aspect, the invention is related to the use of the polyester of the second aspect, and a fourth aspect of the invention is directed to a method for preparing a product comprising (I) providing a polyester of the second aspect of the invention; and (II) preparing a textile, a fiber, a packaging, a plastic, an automotive part, an electronic part from the polyester provided in step (I).

title: FIBER-BASED MATERIALS CONTAINING GRAPHENE OXIDE
abstract: [0000]    Materials (e.g., packaging materials) comprising a fiber substrate (e.g., paper) in a form of a porous network of fibers, and graphene oxide on surfaces of the fibers are provided, wherein the graphene oxide is present in the material at an amount of less than 1 weight % are provided. The materials are characterized by improved properties (e.g., increased oil/water resistance, increased mechanical properties) as compared to the fiber substrate absent the graphene oxide. Methods of improving mechanical properties of a fiber substrate are also provided. Food-packaging materials, methods of making the food-packaging materials and methods of using the food-packing materials are also provided.

title: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR COMPACT IMAGE ENCAPSULATION WITH COMPRESSED ACCOMPANYING NON-PIXEL DATA
abstract: The present invention concerns a method of encapsulating an image into an ISOBMFF based media file, the method comprising, by a processing device, the steps of: obtaining data of an image and accompanying non-pixel data associated with the image that are compressed; and generating a single box, e.g. a minimized image box such as MinimizedImageBox, that includes the obtained image data and the compressed non-pixel data. A flag is inserted in the box to signal, either individually or in a common way, the compression of the data. The accompanying non-pixel data of multiple accompanying data elements are separately compressed or combined to be compressed as a single payload. Compression parameters fields are included in the box to indicate compression parameters for compressing the accompanying non-pixel data.

title: PHOTOVOLTAIC MODULE
abstract: The present application discloses a photovoltaic module and a photovoltaic system. The photovoltaic module comprises a plurality of cells electrically connected and encapsulation layers located on front surfaces and back surfaces of the cells; each cell is provided with holes, and a filling material is provided in each hole; and an encapsulation layer and a filling material form at least one refractive interface. The photovoltaic module provided in embodiments of the present application has a good light-trapping effect on both normally incident light and large-angle incident light, and can take into account the light-trapping effect on both normally incident light and large-angle incident light, thereby improving the light absorption rate of the photovoltaic module.

title: PANEL AND PHOTOVOLTAIC ASSEMBLY
abstract: Disclosed in the present application are a panel and a photovoltaic assembly. The photovoltaic assembly comprises a panel, a backsheet, a cell sheet layer and a first encapsulation adhesive film layer, wherein the backsheet and the panel are arranged in a stacked manner, the cell sheet layer is located between the panel and the backsheet, the first encapsulation adhesive film layer is located between the cell sheet layer and the panel, a fluorine-containing film layer is arranged on the side of the panel that faces away from the first encapsulation adhesive film layer, an anti-reflection layer is arranged on at least one side of the fluorine-containing film layer in the direction of the thickness of the fluorine-containing film layer, and the fluorine-containing film layer is a light-transmitting layer. The fluorine-containing film layer has good hydrophobicity and can resist contamination and prevent dust accumulation. By providing the fluorine-containing film layer on the panel, it can increase the difficulty for impurities such as dirty water and dust to accumulate on the panel, thereby making the panel easier to clean. In addition, the anti-reflection layer can reduce the reflection of sunlight on the panel, thereby increasing the amount of incident sunlight, increasing the solar power generation capacity, and reducing the phenomenon of building light pollution.

title: LIPID COMPOUND FOR DELIVERING THERAPEUTIC AGENT AND COMPOSITION CONTAINING SAME
abstract: Disclosed in the present invention are a lipid compound for delivering a therapeutic agent and a composition containing same. The present invention provides a lipid compound represented by formula I or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof. The lipid compound provided by the present invention, as a drug carrier, exhibits high encapsulation efficiency, high expression level, and good targeting property.

title: DISPLAY PANEL AND DISPLAY APPARATUS
abstract: The present application discloses a display panel and a display apparatus. The display panel comprises: a driving backplane, light-emitting devices, an encapsulation layer, and an auxiliary color resist layer. The auxiliary color resist layer comprises at least two layers of auxiliary color resist portions that are stacked, and colors of the at least two layers of auxiliary color resist portions are different. In this way, the auxiliary color resist layer can block light of at least three colors. For a part of the auxiliary color resist layer distributed in a photosensitive display area, by means of providing a light through hole penetrating through at least one layer of the auxiliary color resist portions, it can be ensured that the auxiliary color resist layer can allow light of a specific waveband to pass through. In addition, the specific waveband can also be controlled by adjusting the penetration of the light through hole, so that the matching between the waveband of light that can pass through the photosensitive display area and the photosensitive waveband of a photosensitive element can be improved, so that the photosensitive element can work normally.
assignee: BOE TECH GROUP CO LTD [CN]; CHENGDU BOE OPTOELECTRONICS TECH CO LTD [CN]; 京东方科技集团股份有限公司 et al.

title: DISPLAY PANEL AND DISPLAY DEVICE
abstract: The present invention provides a display panel and a display device. The display panel comprises: a substrate; a pixel defining layer located on one side of the substrate, wherein the pixel defining layer comprises a plurality of pixel opening areas and non-pixel opening areas located between adjacent pixel opening areas, and the plurality of pixel opening areas comprise a plurality of shared pixel opening areas and a plurality of privacy pixel opening areas; a plurality of light-emitting layers which are respectively located in the corresponding shared pixel opening areas and the corresponding privacy pixel opening areas; an encapsulation layer located on the side of the pixel defining layer and the light-emitting layer facing away from the substrate; a light modulation layer located on the side of the encapsulation layer facing away from the substrate, wherein the light modulation layer comprises light-transmitting areas arranged corresponding to the shared pixel opening areas and the privacy pixel opening areas, and light-shielding areas arranged corresponding to the non-pixel opening areas; and at least one light-shielding layer located on the side of the light modulation layer facing away from the substrate, wherein each light-shielding layer comprises shared openings having one-to-one correspondence to the plurality of shared pixel opening areas and privacy openings having one-to-one correspondence to the plurality of privacy pixel opening areas.
assignee: BOE TECH GROUP CO LTD [CN]; 京东方科技集团股份有限公司

title: METHOD FOR PRODUCING MEAT ALTERNATIVE
abstract: The present invention provides a production method suitable for producing a high-moisture meat alternative material using a vegetable protein as a main raw material, wherein a protein amount equivalent to that of real beef or real pork can be ingested with the meat alternative material, and the meat alternative material can be considered as beef-like or pork-like in terms of a fiber state or the like. The method for producing a meat alternative according to the present invention involves a process in which a raw material kneaded product that has been subjected to a pressure heating treatment and that contains a vegetable protein and water is passed through a breaker plate and then subjected to extrusion molding with a tapered cooling die.

title: MODIFIED STARCH AND METHODS AND USES RELATED THERETO
abstract: The invention relates to methods of manufacturing modified starch compositions using thermomechanical degradation. The invention also relates, inter alia, to compositions obtainable by the methods of the invention; products such as food items, feed items, thickening agents, adhesives, cosmetic products, paper, or construction materials, comprising said compositions; and uses and various applications of said compositions.

title: THERMOMECHANICAL DEGRADATION OF STARCH
abstract: The invention relates to methods of thermomechanical degradation of starch, which allow the use of starch that has not been subjected to any pretreatment. By controlling the conditions of the thermomechanical degradation, different starch extrudates can be obtained. For example, low-viscosity extruded starch (LVES) and thermoreversible gelling extruded starch (TRES) may be obtained by subjecting native granular starch and water to thermomechanical degradation. The optional addition of a starch-modifying agent leads to modified extruded starch (MOES). The invention also relates, inter alia, to compositions obtainable by the methods of the invention; products comprising said compositions; and various applications of said compositions.

title: LOW STARCH RICE COOKER
abstract: [0000]    Rice cooked in traditional rice cookers generally produce a significant amount of starch, and the rice cooker disclosed herein reduces the amount of starch in cooked rice by raising cooked rice out of starch rich water after being cooked an appropriate amount by having the cooked rice contained within a strainer structure which is lifted by a lifting mechanism.

abstract: The invention relates to cold-water soluble starch compositions having at least two mass fractions. The starch compositions of the invention are capable of thermoreversible gelation. The invention also relates, inter alia, to methods of manufacturing the starch composition of the invention, uses of said compositions, and compositions obtainable by the methods of the invention.

title: PROMOTING LIPID-SOLUBLE RETINOL AND ALPHA-TOCOPHEROL ABSORPTION USING RESISTANT STARCH SUPPLEMENTATION
abstract: We demonstrate that supplementation with resistant potato starch (RPS) inﬂuences the circulating levels of retinol, alpha-tocopherol, choline, and the choline-derived phospholipid sphingomyelin in serum. Levels of the toxic microbially transformed choline metabolites trimethylamine and trimethylamine oxide did not increase, suggesting that RPS may be an e ective way to enhance choline uptake without promoting increased toxic metabolite production. Increased hydroxysphingomyelin levels in RPS consuming individuals are particularly intriguing given the role these metabolites play in myelin.

title: Zellkontaktiersystem und elektrischer Energiespeicher
abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft ein Zellkontaktiersystem (15) und einen elektrischen Energiespeicher (10), wobei das Zellkontaktiersystem (15) eine flexible Leiterplatte (45), wenigstens eine Zellverbinderanordnung (35) mit wenigstens einem Zellverbinder (50), einen Niederhalter (160) und wenigstens einen Sensor (100) aufweist, wobei die flexible Leiterplatte (45) einen Armabschnitt (110) aufweist, wobei der Sensor (100) an dem Armabschnitt (110) angeordnet ist, wobei der Niederhalter (160) einen Anbindungsabschnitt (165), einen Federabschnitt (170) und einen Abstützabschnitt (175) aufweist, wobei der Anbindungsabschnitt (165) mit dem Zellverbinder (50) mechanisch verbunden ist, wobei der Federabschnitt (170) an dem Anbindungsabschnitt (165) angeordnet ist, wobei sich der Federabschnitt (170) von dem Anbindungsabschnitt (165) wegerstreckt und eine beabstandet zu dem Anbindungsabschnitt (165) angeordnete erste Anlagefläche (200) aufweist, die an dem Armabschnitt (110) und/oder dem Sensor (100) anliegt, wobei der Federabschnitt (170) eine Anpresskraft (FS) bereitstellt, die von dem Federabschnitt (170) in Richtung des Armabschnitts (110) wirkt, wobei der Abstützabschnitt (175) sich von dem Anbindungsabschnitt (165) wegerstreckt und eine beabstandet zu dem Anbindungsabschnitt (165) angeordnete zweite Anlagefläche (205) aufweist, wobei der Abstützabschnitt (175) ausgebildet ist, eine zweite Gegenkraft (FG2) zur zumindest teilweisen Abstützung der Anpresskraft (FS) bereitzustellen.

title: Fingereinheit mit zweidimensionaler Messvorrichtung und einem als Wippe ausgestalteten Sensor, Roboterhand und Verfahren zur Ermittlung der Greifkraft
abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft eine Fingereinheit (1), insbesondere Fingerspitze, für eine Roboterhand aufweisend eine elastische Haut (2) und eine unterhalb der elastischen Haut (2) angeordnete im Wesentlichen starre Fläche (3), wobei eine zweidimensionale Messvorrichtung auf der starren Fläche (3) angeordnet ist und ein Übertragungselement (4) zwischen der elastischen Haut (2) und der starren Fläche (3) angeordnet ist, wobei das Übertragungselement (4) derart mit der elastischen Haut (2) und der zweidimensionalen Messvorrichtung verbunden ist, dass eine Verformung der elastischen Haut (2) zu einer Bewegung des Übertragungselements (4) führt und die zweidimensionale Messvorrichtung die Bewegung des Übertragungselements (4) messen kann.

title: CHEMO-ENZYMATIC APPROACH FOR THE SYNTHESIS OF RARE C3- SUGARS EPIMERS USING A GLYCOSIDE 3-OXIDASE (ENGINEERED) ENZYMES
abstract: The present disclosure relates to engineered bacterial glycoside-3-oxidases with improved catalytic and stability properties (and homologues) and their use in producing rare C3-sugar epimers. The present disclosure further relates to a method for the enzymatic oxidation of the C3-position of chemically protected saccharides at the C1-position, followed by a chemical reduction and deprotection steps.

title: Kraftfahrzeug
abstract: Kraftfahrzeug, umfassend eine Brennkraftmaschine (4) mit einer nachgeschalteten Abgasanlage (6) umfassend eine Abgasrohrlei-tung (7), und eine Karosserie (2) mit zwei hohlen Seitenschwellern (3), wobei die Abgasrohrleitung (7) zumindest abschnittsweise im Inneren eines Seitenschwellers (3) angeordnet ist, wobei der Seitenschweller (3) eine Lufteinlassöffnung (11), über die die Abgasrohrleitung (7) kühlende Luft in den Seitenschweller (3) eintritt, sowie eine Luftauslassöffnung (14), über die die Luft aus dem Seitenschweller (3) austritt, aufweist.

title: Optisches System; Verfahren zum Justieren und Betreiben einer Optikgruppe; Anlage zur Fertigung und/oder Bearbeitung von optischen Elementen
abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft ein optisches System (1) mit einer ersten Systemeinheit (2a), einer zweiten Systemeinheit (2b) und einer dazwischen angeordneten Optikgruppe (3), die gemeinsam einen Strahlengang für einen Lichtstrahl (4) ausbilden. Die erste Systemeinheit (2a) und die zweite Systemeinheit (2b) weisen jeweils eine im Wesentlichen zylinderförmige Teleskopeinheit (5) mit einem verschieblichen, vorderen Hülsenelement (5a) und einem hinteren Hülsenelement (5b) auf, welche mittels des vorderen Hülsenelements (5a) in Richtung auf die Optikgruppe (3) einfahrbar und ausfahrbar sind. Die Teleskopeinheiten (5) geben in einem eingefahrenen Zustand in einer Axialrichtung entlang des Lichtstrahls (4) einen Freiraum (A) zwischen der Optikgruppe (3) und der ersten Systemeinheit (2a) und einen Freiraum (B) zwischen der Optikgruppe (3) und der zweiten Systemeinheit (2b) frei und die Teleskopeinheiten (5) verschließen in einem ausgefahrenen Zustand die Freiräume (A, B) in Axialrichtung. Die Optikgruppe (3) ist zumindest in einem eingefahrenen Zustand der Teleskopeinheiten (5) relativ zu den Teleskopeinheiten (5) bewegbar, um die Optikgruppe (3) mittels einer Justiereinrichtung (6) der Optikgruppe (3) zu justieren. Die Optikgruppe (3) weist an einem der ersten Systemeinheit (2a) zugewandten, ersten Ende (3a) und einem der zweiten Systemeinheit (2b) zugewandten, zweiten Ende (3b) der Optikgruppe (3) jeweils ein im Wesentlichen kreisförmiges oder zylinderförmiges Adapterelement (7) auf.

title: System zur Bereitstellung einer Betriebsflüssigkeit in einem Kraftfahrzeug
abstract: System (1) zur Bereitstellung einer Betriebsflüssigkeit in einem Kraftfahrzeug (2) aufweisend einen Tank (3), in welchem die Betriebsflüssigkeit lagerbar ist, und eine Abgabestelle (4), an welcher die Betriebsflüssigkeit bereitstellbar ist, weiter aufweisend eine funktional betrachtet zwischen dem Tank (3) und der Abgabestelle (4) angeordnete und bidirektional betreibbare Förderpumpe (9) zum Fördern der Betriebsflüssigkeit, und weiter aufweisend eine Ansaugleitung (15) und eine Rücklaufleitung (16), welche funktional betrachtet parallel zueinander zwischen der Förderpumpe (9) und dem Tank (3) angeordnet sind, wobei an oder in der Ansaugleitung (15) ein erstes Filtermodul (17) angeordnet ist, wobei die Betriebsflüssigkeit mittels der Rücklaufleitung (16) an dem ersten Filtermodul (17) vorbei zu dem Tank (3) rückförderbar ist, wobei an oder in der Ansaugleitung (15) ein, vorzugsweise als Kugelrückschlagventil (7) ausgebildetes, Sperrventil (6) angeordnet ist, welches ein Rückfördern der Betriebsflüssigkeit durch die Ansaugleitung (15) verhindert, wobei funktional betrachtet zwischen der Förderpumpe (9) und der Abgabestelle (4) ein zweites Filtermodul (26) angeordnet ist.
assignee: TESONA GMBH & CO KG [DE]; TESONA GmbH & Co. KG

title: Verfahren zur Steuerung einer Temperierungsvorrichtung in einem Fahrzeug
abstract: Um ein Verfahren zur Steuerung mindestens einer Temperierungsvorrichtung (11), wobei die Temperierungsvorrichtung (11) mindestens eine Heizvorrichtung (12) und/oder mindestens eine Kühlvorrichtung (12a) und mindestens eine Gebläsevorrichtung (13) umfasst, in einem Fahrzeug (10), durchzuführen, durch welches einem kühlenden Klimagefühl entgegengewirkt wird und der Fahrer, z.B. während eines Powernaps und/oder einer Ausruhphase, ein angenehmes Klimatisierungsgefühl erfährt, wird vorgeschlagen, dass das Verfahren die Schritte:a) Feststellung eines vorbestimmten Neigungswinkels (A) einer Sitzlehne (15) und/oder Feststellung der Aktivierung einer Ausruhfunktion, und bei Überschreiten des vorbestimmten Neigungswinkels (A) und/oder bei Aktivierung der Ausruhfunktion:b) Erfassung einer bevorzugterweise voreingestellten ersten Soll-Temperatur, wobei die erste Soll-Temperatur eine erste Ausströmtemperatur der Temperierungsvorrichtung (11) ist,c) Festlegen einer zweiten Soll-Temperatur, wobei die zweite Solltemperatur eine zweite Ausströmtemperatur der Temperierungsvorrichtuing (11) ist, wobei die zweite Soll-Temperatur eine Wohlfühltemperatur in einer vordefinierten Fahrzeugsitzumgebung (18) erzeugt, undd) Einstellung der Gebläsevorrichtung (13) unter Erhalten eines vordefinierten Abdeckluftstroms (20) und Einstellung der Heizvorrichtung (12) und/oder der Kühlvorrichtung (12a), um die zweite Soll-Temperatur und die Wohlfühltemperatur in der Fahrzeugsitzumgebung (18) zu erhalten, umfasst.

title: Verfahren zur Verbesserung der Rekuperation in einem Elektrofahrzeug
abstract: Verfahren zur Verbesserung der Rekuperation in einem Elektrofahrzeug mit mindestens zwei elektrisch angetriebenen Achsen, umfassend die folgenden Schritte:Erkennung einer Abfahrt mittels einer Analyse eines Fahrzeugneigungswinkels und/oder von Navigationsdaten mittels einer Analyseeinheit,Steuerung einer Motorsteuerungseinheit zur Ankoppelung einer Sekundärachse, die zuvor abgekoppelt war,Nutzung beider elektrischer Achsen, nämlich der Sekundärachse und einer Primärachse, für eine Rekuperation einer Bremsenergie des Fahrzeugs während der Abfahrt.

title: Vibration damper for aeration installations, especially in biological sewage treatment plants
abstract: Przedmiotem zgłoszenia jest tłumik drgań, mający zastosowanie w instalacjach napowietrzających, w szczególności w biologicznych oczyszczalniach ścieków. title: Computer-implementiertes Verfahren zum Ermitteln von mindestens einem betrachteten Element sowie technisches System und Computerprogrammprodukt
abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft ein computer-implementiertes Verfahren zum Ermitteln von mindestens einem betrachteten Element, aufweisend die Schritte a. Bereitstellen von mindestens einem Datenelement (S1); wobei das mindestens eine Datenelement mindestens ein Element (A, B, C, D) aufweist, wobei sich das mindestens eine Element (A, B, C, D) auf einer Strecke oder einem Streckenabschnitt von mindestens einem Transportmittel befindet oder bewegt; b. Bereitstellen von Informationen (S2), wobei sich die Informationen auf das mindestens eine Element (A, B, C, D) beziehen; wobei die Informationen eine Ortsinformation aufweisen; c. Ermitteln von einer Mehrzahl von Blickvektoren (1, 2, 3, 4) in einer zeitlichen Abfolge für Blickrichtungen einer Person in Bezug auf das mindestens eine Element (A, B, C, D) auf Basis des mindestens einen Datenelementes und der Informationen mittels einer graphischen Datenverarbeitung (S3); d. Analysieren der Mehrzahl der Blickvektoren (1, 2, 3, 4) im Hinblick auf mindestens eine zeitliche Überlagerung der Blickvektoren (S4); e. Identifizieren des mindestens einen betrachteten Elementes (B) aus dem mindestens einen Element (A, B, C, D) unter Berücksichtigung der mindestens einen zeitlichen Überlagerung (S5); wobei das mindestens eine betrachtete Element (B) über einen bestimmten Zeitraum von der Person betrachtet wird; und f. Bereitstellen des mindestens einen betrachteten Elementes (B) (S6).Ferner betrifft die Erfindung ein technisches System und ein entsprechendes Computerprogrammprodukt.

title: Verfahren zum sicheren Betreiben einer HPEM-Waffe
abstract: Ein neues Verfahren zum Betreiben einer HPEM-Waffe (19, 19a, 19b) eines HPEM-Trägerfahrzeugs (10, 10a, 10b) und zum gleichzeitigen Schützen eines strahlungssensitiven Frontends (18, 18a, 18b) eines Begleitfahrzeuges (20, 20a, 20b) umfasst folgende Merkmale:• das HPEM-Trägerfahrzeug (TF) (10, 10a, 10b) umfasst einen TF-Transceiver (11) und eine TF-Recheneinheit (12),• das Begleitfahrzeug (BF) (20, 20a, 20b) umfasst einen BF-Transceiver (21) und eine BF-Recheneinheit (22),• das Verfahren zum Betreiben einer TF-HPEM-Waffe (19) umfasst folgende Schritte:a) die TF-HPEM-Waffe (19) übermittelt HPEM-Angriffsparameter eines beabsichtigten Angriffs an die TF-Recheneinheit (12),b) die TF-Recheneinheit (12) berechnet eine auszusendende TF-Nachricht,c) der TF-Transceiver (11) sendet diese TF-Nachricht an den BF-Transceiver (21),d) die TF-Recheneinheit (12) erteilt bei Vorliegen einer BF-Empfangsbenachrichtigung der HPEM-Waffe (19, 19a, 19b) eine Angriffserlaubnis,• das Verfahren zum Schützen eines Frontends (28, 28a, 28b) eines Begleitfahrzeuges (BF) umfasst folgende Schrittea) der BF-Transceiver (21) empfängt die TF-Nachricht,b) der BF-Transceiver (21) sendet bei vollständigem Empfang eineEmpfangsbenachrichtigung an den TF-Transceiver (11),c) die BF-Recheneinheit (12) berechnet mit den HPEM-Parameterwerten der TF-Nachricht einen Schädigungswert für das strahlungssensitive Frontend (28, 28a, 28b) und schaltet in Abhängigkeit von der Höhe des Schädigungswertes ein HPEM-Schutzmittel für das strahlungssensitive Frontend (28, 28a, 28b) ein.

title: Verfahren und Computer-Vision-System zur Kritikalitätsbewertung bei Objektklassifizierung
abstract: Die vorliegende Erfindung betrifft ein Verfahren zur Kritikalitätsbewertung in einem Computer-Vision-System, bei dem während eines Fahrbetriebes in fortgeführter Ausführung durch einen Sensor ein Bild (111) eines Fahrzeugvorfeldes aufgenommen wird, bei dem zur Ermittlung einer Kritikalitätsgrenze das Bild in N Bildbereiche aufgeteilt (120) wird, zu jedem der N Bildbereiche ein Shapley-Wert berechnet wird, entsprechend der Shapley-Wert die N Bildbereiche nach Wichtigkeit sortiert werden, beginnend mit einem in der Rangfolge wichtigsten Bildbereich schrittweise ein jeweilig nachrangiger Bildbereich entfernt wird (130) und zu einem jeweilig verbleibenden Restbild eine Klassifikation von Objekten durchgeführt wird. Dies wird solange wiederholt, bis zu einem i-ten Restbild die Klassifikation von Objekten kein Ergebnis liefert (140) und mit einem Teiler i/N und Mittelwertbildung über mehrere Bilder die Kritikalitätsgrenze gebildet wird. Während durch einen Test-Fahrbetrieb damit eine Standard-Kritikalitätsgrenze gebildet wird, wird während eines Standard-Fahrbetriebes in ständiger Ausführung eine aktuelle Kritikalitätsgrenze berechnet, und bei Unterschreiten der Standard-Kritikalitätsgrenze durch die aktuelle Kritikalitätsgrenze eine Sichteinschränkung des auf das Fahrzeugvorfeld gerichteten Sensors festgestellt, woraufhin eine Warnung auf einem Fahrer-Display angezeigt wird. Ferner wird ein Computer-Vision-System vorgestellt, welches das Verfahren umsetzt.

title: PROCESS TECHNOLOGY AND METHOD FOR PREPARING BIO-INGREDIENTS, FOODS AND BEVERAGES IN ABSENCE OF OXYGEN
abstract: [0000]    A method and processing technology for preparing baked products from raw materials is disclosed. The method includes at least one baking or roasting step in which the raw materials are processed in the absence of atmospheric air, achieved through a vacuum, vacuum-compensated, or pressure—the latter two employing an inert atmosphere. A sealed rotary roasting drum (or processing compartment) is supplied with pre-heated inert gas while heating and rotating the raw materials, and the inert gas is optionally recycled for reuse. Additional unit operations such as milling, cooling, spraying, extraction, and storage are also performed in the absence of atmospheric air, to preserve product quality and prevent oxidation. Optional steps include cryogenic pre-milling, sweetener addition to generating a “torrefacto” effect, and supercritical fluid extraction of oils for later incorporation into the baked products. The disclosed technology enables continuous production of baked products with improved aroma, stability, and self-life, by maintaining an oxygen-free environment throughout processing.

The handle of the device can be printed with branding and identification. To use this product, take the desired beverage delivery device, such as a white coffee with one sugar, tear off the handle end tag and tip the milk and sugar into a cup and add hot water. Then immerse the micro perforated section into the water and stir to infuse the coffee and mix the drink. Stir longer for a stronger beverage. The device functions as separate single serve ingredient packaging, infuser and stirrer all in the one device, making a quick and convenient plunger/press quality beverage from the one standalone package. title: Kinetic method for rapidly sensing sweetness of sweetener by detection cells
abstract: The invention provides a kinetic method for rapidly sensing the sweetness of a sweetening agent by detection cells. The method comprises the following steps: S1, determining a fluorescence signal of interaction of the sweetening agent and sweet recipient cells by adopting a staying fluorescence spectrophotometer; a Ca < 2 + > fluorescent probe is added into the sweet recipient cells; s2, performing data processing on the fluorescence signal to obtain an apparent rate constant kobs; s3, based on the apparent rate constant kobs, calculating a receptor isomerization rate constant k3, a receptor deisomerization rate constant k4 and the retention time tau of the sweetening agent in sweet recipient cells; and S4, judging the sensory result of the sweetening agent according to the calculation result of S3. According to the method for analyzing the sweetener activation cell signal by detecting the sweetness based on the stay spectrum, some sensory information of the sweetness can be rapidly obtained, and compared with traditional sensory evaluation, the method is more efficient and more economical.

title: Fruit and grain mixed peptide solid beverage and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of food processing, and discloses a fruit and grain mixed peptide solid beverage and a preparation method thereof, the solid beverage comprises the following components by weight: 35-55 parts of composite peptide, 3-8 parts of functional polysaccharide, 8-15 parts of a wall material, and 5-15 parts of a sweetener. Wherein the composite peptide is prepared by compounding cereal peptide and fruit and vegetable peptide according to a specific weight ratio; the micromorphology of the solid beverage is composite microcapsule particles coated with peptide and polysaccharide, the average particle size is 10-50 [mu] m, and the water activity of the product is not higher than 0.28. The preparation method and the application are applied to the solid beverage. Through component design and process control, the product has excellent instant solubility, high-activity embedding rate and long-term storage stability, and effectively solves the common technical problems of easy activity loss, dissolution layering and short shelf life of peptide solid beverages.

title: Construction method and application of skin aging cell model
abstract: The invention discloses a construction method and application of a skin aging cell model, and belongs to the technical field of cell models. According to the method, the skin aging cell model can be constructed by culturing cells with a complete culture medium containing an artificial sweetening agent. According to the invention, saccharin is used as a chemical inducer for skin aging for the first time, the common sweetening agent widely used for low-sugar and sugar-free food has a biological effect of inducing skin aging for the first time, and the blank of the component in aging model research is filled. Experimental results show that only 24-hour saccharin treatment is needed for one time, and the induction effect can reach the level of 48-hour treatment of a classic H2O2 induction model. The invention not only provides a brand-new special research tool for revealing the unknown mechanism of the artificial sweetener in skin aging, but also provides a standardized and high-throughput in-vitro screening platform for evaluating the skin health risk under the background of sugar-free diet and developing related anti-aging components.

title: Room-temperature storable room-shaped box yoghourt beverage and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the field of dairy product processing, in particular to a room-shaped box yoghourt beverage capable of being stored at normal temperature and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) mixing reconstituted milk and raw milk, sterilizing, cooling, inoculating a leavening agent for fermentation, demulsifying and cooling to obtain a yoghourt base material; (2) performing dry mixing on white granulated sugar, a high-power sweetener and a stabilizer, adding the mixture into hot water, performing high-shear dispersion, and cooling to obtain a mixed solution; (3) mixing the yoghurt base material with the mixed solution, homogenizing and sterilizing; and (4) carrying out hot filling on the sterilized feed liquid into a house-shaped box, immediately inverting the package, sterilizing, and cooling. Through cooperation of hot filling and sterilization after inversion, on the premise of not depending on sterile packaging and production line transformation, the problem of microorganism control in a non-sterile house type box filling environment is effectively solved, the product reaches a commercial sterile state, normal-temperature stable storage as long as 6 months is achieved, and meanwhile good flavor and texture are kept.

title: Electronic atomized liquid formula and optimization method thereof
abstract: The invention provides an electronic atomized liquid formula and an optimization method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: preparing a plurality of electronic atomized liquid samples with different sweetener concentrations; determining a sensory score of each electronic atomized liquid sample; detecting the atomization rate of each electronic atomized liquid sample; and determining the sweetener concentration formula of the electronic atomized liquid according to the sensory score and the atomization rate of the electronic atomized liquid sample. According to the electronic atomized liquid formula optimization method provided by the invention, sensory scores and atomization rates under different sweetening agent concentrations are respectively determined, so that a scientific and quantitative evaluation system is established, and an optimal sweetening agent concentration interval for balancing sensory sweetness and physical properties at the same time is explored on the basis. Therefore, the formula of the electronic atomized liquid can ensure the sweetness, the atomization rate is maximized, and the economical efficiency and the stability of the electronic atomized liquid product are further improved.

title: METHOD FOR PRODUCING DRY SOLUBLE MIXTURE BASED ON WHEY PROTEIN ISOLATE FOR ENTERAL NUTRITION OF INDIVIDUALS WITH CARBOHYDRATE METABOLISM DISORDERS
abstract: Method for producing dry soluble mixture based on whey protein isolate for enteral nutrition of individuals with carbohydrate metabolism disorders consists of four main stages and the addition of components per 100 kg of product, according to which: at the first stage, the raw materials are sieved through a sieve; at the second stage, trituration is performed, involving the addition of riboflavin, pyridoxine, beta-carotene and 100 g of whey protein isolate, followed by mixing for 10–15 minutes, at the third stage, preliminary mixing is performed, during which 48.0 kg of whey protein isolate, coenzyme Q10, zinc gluconate and the mixture obtained from the previous trituration are added and mixed for 15–20 minutes, at the fourth stage, the remaining specified amount of whey protein isolate, isomaltulose, medium-chain triglycerides of plant origin from palm kernel oil, fructose, L-glutamine, sunflower lecithin, inulin, L-glycine, chamomile extract, chicory root extract, ascorbic acid, rutin, calcium lactate, magnesium citrate, glucosamine hydrochloride are added to the mixer with the mixture obtained after preliminary mixing and mixed for 15–20 minutes.

title: METHOD FOR PREPARING A TRADITIONAL CHINESE MEDICINE EXTRACT FOR REGULATING GLUCOSE AND LIPID METABOLISM
abstract: The present invention belongs to the technical field of extracting and isolating active ingredients from compound traditional Chinese medicines (TCM), and specifically relates to a method for preparing a TCM extract for regulating glucose and lipid metabolism. The method includes the steps of: mixing mulberry leaf powder and pueraria root powder, adding an ethanol solution, adjusting a pH value to below 2, heating for extraction, filtering the mixture, recovering the filtrate, subjecting the filtrate to column chromatography, eluting to remove impurities, collecting the eluate, concentrating and drying to obtain the TCM extract for regulating glucose and lipid metabolism. The obtained TCM extract for regulating glucose and lipid metabolism includes 2-4 mg/g of 1-deoxynojirimycin, 40-80 mg/g of quercetin, and 150-200 mg/g of puerarin. The present invention has effects including lowering blood glucose, regulating blood lipids, and protecting pancreatic islets.

title: Process for the sequential monotopic synthesis of β-ethylene acetals of 1-(phenacyl-, acetonyl) isatins
abstract: The invention relates to organic chemistry, in particular to a process for synthesizing heterocyclic compounds based on isatin, which can be used in the field of pharmaceutical industry.The process for the sequential monotopic synthesis ofβ-ethylene acetals of 1-(phenacyl-, acetonyl) isatins with the formula:according to the invention, includes the interaction of isatin with chloroethanol in dimethylformamide medium in the presence of potassium carbonate at room temperature for 25...35 hours. After which an equimolar amount relative to isatin of phenacyl halide or chloroacetone dissolved in dimethylformamide is added dropwise to the reactant mixture, the mixture being heated at a temperature of 55...70°C for 1.5...2.5 hours, then the resulting mixture is diluted with water, extracted with ethyl acetate, from which the target product is isolated and purified by standard procedures in organic chemistry.

title: MULTI-DIMENSIONAL OPTIMIZATION METHOD FOR DIRECTED ENHANCEMENT OF CHARACTERISTIC AROMA AND QUALITY OF RAPESEED OIL
abstract: The present invention belongs to the technical field of grain and oil processing, and discloses a multi-dimensional optimization method for directed enhancement of characteristic aroma and quality of rapeseed oil. The method aims to solve the problems in the existing rapeseed oil processing, such as limited flavor dimensions, severe protein denaturation in rapeseed dregs, and residual impurities affecting oil quality. According to the multi-dimensional optimization method for directed enhancement of characteristic aroma and quality of rapeseed oil in the present invention, through a collaborative process of microwave pretreatment, composite food additives, gradient seed roasting, and low-temperature degumming, the collaborative optimization of the directed enhancement of characteristic aroma of rapeseed oil (roasted, nutty + floral, fruity), the improvement in oil quality, and the preservation of nutrition of rapeseed dregs is achieved.

title: Family of heme binding proteins that increase chelated iron content and improve flavor of nutritional supplements and food products
abstract: This disclosure provides materials and methods for improving the nutritional value of food products by increasing the content of chelated iron. Heme binding proteins (designated as PX90 proteins) that have not previously been used as food additives are manufactured by recombinant expression, and then included in food products during manufacture or preparation. PX90 proteins may also impart a meat-like flavor or aroma, either coincidentally or by design. Subcategories of PX90 proteins are structurally related to THAP4-like heme-binding beta-barrel domain containing proteins, indoleamine 2,3-dioxygenase (IDO), DyP-type peroxidase, ferritins, and hemopexins. The bioavailable iron in nutritional supplements and food products of this disclosure is especially beneficial for consumers who have manifestations of iron deficiency, low blood hematocrit, anemia, and other hematological abnormalities.

title: NUTRITIONAL MEAL REPLACEMENT FOOD CONTAINING PEUCEDANUM PRAERUPTORUM AND PREPARATION METHOD THEREOF
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of preparation of nutritional meal replacement foods, and specifically relates to a nutritional meal replacement food containing Peucedanum praeruptorum and a preparation method thereof. The nutritional meal replacement food of the invention is made from an emulsified gel carrier, a Peucedanum praeruptorum composite extract, and ingredients such as coix seed, red dates, and goji berries. The Peucedanum praeruptorum composite extract has high nutritional value and retains many of the inherent nutritional properties of Peucedanum praeruptorum. The emulsified gel carrier is a complex obtained by subjecting proteins and polysaccharides to a Maillard reaction, which enhances the gastrointestinal absorption of the Peucedanum praeruptorum composite extract and provides a certain degree of controlled release of nutrients. Coix seed, red dates, and goji berries are crushed into ultrafine powders and added to improve the flavor of the nutritional meal replacement food. The nutritional meal replacement food of the invention is low in fat, high in protein, and provides a strong sense of fullness, meeting daily nutritional intake requirements. It can replace one to two meals for adults and is also safe for consumption.

title: A PREPARATION METHOD FOR PURE NATURAL POLYPHENOL-RICH FLOUR FROM BLACK WHEAT.
abstract: The present invention relates to a preparation, processing method for a pure natural polyphenol-rich flour from black wheat. A method for preparing pure natural polyphenol-rich flour from black wheat includes the following steps: collecting unripe black wheat grains with colored outer skins after flowering; steaming the grains for 20 to 30 minutes; cooling the steamed grains to room temperature, absorbing surface moisture; freeze-drying the steamed grains; pulverizing, milling the dried grains to obtain the pure natural polyphenol-rich flour. She fully utilizes the advantages of black wheat resources to produce truly pure natural polyphenol-rich flour. While maximizing the retention of nutritional components in the grains, it avoids the influence of the bran of conventionally harvested mature wheat on the edible quality, improves the edible quality of the grains. The total phenol content, antioxidant activity TEAC, and DPPH in the prepared polyphenol-rich flour are significantly higher than those prepared by regular method.

title: Application of apple polyphenols in delaying postharvest deterioration quality of pummelo (Citrus maxima Merr.) fruit
abstract: This invention provides an application of apple polyphenols in delaying the decline of postharvest quality deterioration of pummelo (Citrus maxima Merr.) fruit, belonging to the technical field of postharvest storage and preservation of fruits. Experiments prove that pre-storage apple polyphenol treatment can effectively reduce postharvest decay and quality deterioration of ‘Jinshayou’ pummelo (Citrus maxima Merr.) fruit. Pre-storage immersion of 1.0% apple polyphenol can maintain significant levels of high antioxidant activity and free radical scavenging ability of harvested ‘Jinshayou’ pummelo fruit, as a result of reducing senescence-induced oxidative stress, and play a remarkable role in balancing ROS homeostasis in pummelo juice sacs. Therefore, ‘Jinshayou’ pummelo (Citrus maxima Merr.) fruit treated with 1.0% apple polyphenols can be stored at room temperature for a maximum of 90 days, moreover, it can inhibit the peel coloration and the albedo soften, and also reduce fruit decay index, weight loss and nutritional quality deterioration. <Figure 1>

title: ANTIBIOTIC DETECTION KIT FOR ANIMAL-DERIVED FOOD
abstract: The present invention discloses a kit for detecting antibiotics in animal-derived food, which belongs to the field of food safety detection. The kit comprises microencapsulated indicator bacterium particles, a detection solution, an antibiotic synergist, an animal- derived food sample extraction solution, and a control group; the indicator bacterium is Escherichia coli (CICC23657). The present invention establishes a PVA-sodium alginate- boric acid-sodium tetraborate microencapsulation technology suitable for microbial colorimetry, which provides a stable environment for target microorganisms in the immobilized carrier, allowing their quantity and activity to be maintained and enhancing stability. Adding an antibiotic synergist to the detection system amplifies the effect of antibiotics on sensitive bacteria, making the detection results more obvious and more accurate. Compared with existing methods for detecting antibiotic residues, the present invention is more convenient to operate, low in cost, accurate in results, and allows judgment of antibiotic residues based on color development with the naked eye.

title: Serum-Protein Coated Fusogenic Lipid Particles For Targeted Drug Delivery
abstract: The invention is based on the finding that fusogenic lipid particles, when coated with serum proteins such as apolipoproteins, retain their fusogenic properties. By coating fusogenic particles with serum proteins such as apolipoproteins, the inventors provide protein-coated fusogenic lipid particles that can be used for targeted drug delivery. The invention pertains to said protein-coated fusogenic lipid particles, their method of manufacturing and therapeutic use, und to methods for targeted delivery of drugs and of the fusogenic lipid particles that rely on the coating of the fusogenic lipid particles with serum proteins. In particular embodiments, the protein-coated fusogenic particles of the invention comprise a polyphenol.
