title: MICROCAPSULES WITH OECOPETALUM MEXICANUM SEED OIL AS A FUNCTIONAL ADDITIVE
abstract: The present invention belongs to the technical field of phytochemistry for health nutrition. The proposal of this invention relates to the formulation and process for the development of Oecopetallurgm mexicanum seed oil microcapsules, characterized by containing polyunsaturated fatty acids, phenolic and nutritional compounds (elements), known for their health benefits. The microencapsulation process implemented ensures the protection and stability of the bioactive components, resulting in microcapsules with a significant profile of unsaturated fatty acids. This profile includes a high concentration of essential fatty acids such as oleic acid, linoleic acid and alpha-linolenic acid, which are fundamental for the maintenance of cardiovascular health and cognitive function. One of the advantageous aspects of this invention is the ability of the microcapsules to inhibit oxidative reactants, which translates into greater oxidative stability of the encapsulated oil. In addition, the microcapsules present a nutritional composition relevant to the human organism, benefiting the consumer as a source rich in important minerals such as nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium, calcium, magnesium, sulfur, iron, copper, nickel, manganese, molybdenum and zinc. On the other hand, they have a low humidity and water activity, crucial features for extending the useful life of the product during storage. The cohesiveness of the microcapsules is another significant attribute, as it provides a robust and stable structure that facilitates its handling and transportation without compromising the integrity of the content. Also, these properties render the microcapsules ideal for incorporation into a variety of food products, providing not only nutritional but also functional benefits, by improving the stability and quality of the final product.

title: Conversion device for sake jars of different beer varieties
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of beer production, in particular to a different-beer-variety clear wine tank conversion device which comprises a supporting table, no less than two clear wine tank bodies for storing different beer varieties are installed on one side of the top end of the supporting table, a liquid outlet pipe with a valve is installed at a liquid outlet of each clear wine tank body, and a liquid outlet pipe with a valve is installed at the liquid outlet of each clear wine tank body. And a sliding adjusting mechanism is mounted on one side, positioned on the sake tank body, of the supporting table. Through the cooperative design of the sliding adjusting mechanism, the switching mechanism and the cleaning mechanism, the bright beer tank bodies for storing different varieties of beer can be switched and butted on a semi-automatic beer filling production line; rapid butt joint of the sake tanks for storing different varieties of beer and the filling production line is achieved in an automatic disassembly and assembly and cleaning mode, tedious operation of manual disassembly and assembly and butt joint is avoided, and therefore the conversion and butt joint efficiency of the sake tanks for storing different varieties of beer is improved, and efficient filling production of different varieties of beer is facilitated.

title: A PREPARATION METHOD AND APPLICATION OF ACIDIC POLYSACCHARIDES FROM PYRUS SINKIANGENSIS YU
abstract: The present invention discloses a preparation method and application of acidic polysaccharides from Pyrus sinkiangensis Yu., belonging to the technical field of Pyrus sinkiangensis Yu. acidic polysaccharides. The method comprises the following steps: (1) Removing the cores of Pyrus sinkiangensis Yu. fruits, slicing them, air-drying naturally, pulverizing, defatting, and drying; (2) Adding distilled water to the Pyrus sinkiangensis Yu. powder, performing reflux extraction twice, filtering, collecting the filtrate, and concentrating it; (3) Mixing the concentrated filtrate with ethanol for alcohol precipitation, filtering, and collecting the precipitate as the crude polysaccharide of Pyrus sinkiangensis Yu.; (4) Performing preliminary separation to obtain neutral polysaccharides and acidic polysaccharides from Pyrus sinkiangensis Yu.; then, subjecting the acidic polysaccharides to three elution separations to obtain PSAP-1 and PSAP-2, two types of acidic polysaccharides from Pyrus sinkiangensis Yu. The invention found that the acidic polysaccharides PSAP-1 and PSAP-2 from Pyrus sinkiangensis Yu. can alleviate inflammatory responses.

title: A Method for Preparing Zirconia-Loaded Friedel's Salt Using Dealumination Waste Liquid and its Application in Fluoride Removal
abstract: The present invention discloses a method for preparing zirconia-loaded Friedel's salt using dealumination waste liquid as a raw material and its application in fluoride removal, belonging to the technical fields of wastewater treatment, resource utilization, and environmental functional material preparation. The invention addresses the issues of improving the selectivity and adsorption capacity of existing Friedel's salt for fluoride ions. The invention utilizes aluminum in the dealumination waste liquid from retired crystalline silicon solar cells for synthesizing Friedel's salt. By adding calcium hydroxide to adjust the calcium-to-aluminum molar ratio, the waste liquid is resourcefully utilized. Subsequently, zirconium salt hydrolysis is employed to load zirconium precursors, followed by high-temperature calcination to produce zirconia-loaded Friedel's salt composite material. This composite material possesses abundant anion exchange sites, effectively adsorbing fluoride ions. When used as a fluoride removal agent for fluoride-containing wastewater, it demonstrates excellent defluorination efficiency, achieving both waste resource utilization and contributing to environmental protection and resource recovery.

title: EDIBLE FRUIT PRESERVATIVE AND ITS METHOD OF USE AND APPLICATION
abstract: The present invention discloses an edible fruit preservative, prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 10–30 parts of film-forming polysaccharide; 5–15 parts of natural antioxidant; 3–8 parts of plant essential oil; 2–6 parts of thickener; 1–5 parts of composite functional auxiliary agent; and water to make up the balance. The composite functional auxiliary agent is a compound of fructo-oligosaccharide and nano-silicon dioxide, with a mass ratio of 3:1–5:1. The natural antioxidant is a compound of tea polyphenols, vitamin C, and anthocyanins from black wolfberry, with a mass ratio of 1:1:0.5–1:1:1, so as to achieve synergistic enhancement among tea polyphenols, vitamin C, and black wolfberry anthocyanins. The thickener is at least one of gum arabic and xanthan gum. Through the synergistic effect of the composite preservation system, vitamin C in the natural antioxidant can effectively regenerate the oxidized tea polyphenols and, together with black wolfberry anthocyanins, construct a multi-level, renewable antioxidant network, which greatly prolongs the duration of antioxidant protection and effectively inhibits enzymatic browning and nutrient loss of fruits.

title: METHOD FOR SELECTING HIGH-YIELDING GENOTYPES FOR OZONE TOLERANCE FOR SWEET PEPPER BREEDING
abstract: Method for selecting high-yielding genotypes for ozone tolerance for sweet pepper breeding involves determining tolerant lines at the seedling stage. Seedlings of breeding lines at the 3–4 true-leaf stage are exposed to ozonation at a concentration of 250 mg/m³ for ten days, with an exposure time of seven hours per day. Next, the content of total chlorophyll in the leaves of the breeding lines is determined before and after ozonation. The coefficient of relative sensitivity to elevated ozone doses is calculated and genotypes with the highest resistance are selected with the ability to determine the genotypes most adapted to growing conditions for breeding new stress-resistant varieties of sweet pepper.

title: Autonomous drone swarm system with AI-driven coordination and multi-modal sensor integration
abstract: [0000]    An autonomous drone swarm system and method utilizing artificial intelligence for coordinated operations comprises command drones equipped with large language model processors and subordinate drones coordinated through a hierarchical Queen-Worker architecture. The system processes natural language commands, generates autonomous mission plans, and coordinates multi-drone operations through an encrypted self-healing mesh communication network utilizing laser, radio frequency, and visual communication channels. Multi-modal sensor integration including electro-optical, infrared, LiDAR and photogrammetry, radio frequency, and chemical detection provides comprehensive environmental awareness while federated learning algorithms enable distributed coordination in signal-denied environments. The system implements configurable operational modes spanning tactical (15 minutes-2 hours over 2 to 5 square kilometers), operational (6-24 hours over 20 to 50 square kilometers), and strategic (7-30+days over 200 to 500 square kilometers) mission profiles for military and commercial applications. Fault-tolerant protocols ensure continued operation despite individual failures through automatic task redistribution and leader election procedures.

title: BALLOON DEVICE FOR RIGID BRONCHOSCOPY
abstract: A balloon device for a rigid bronchoscope includes a balloon shaft member; a balloon member connected to the balloon shaft member; and an inflation device operably connected to the balloon shaft member and the balloon member. The inflation device configured to adjust an inflation level of the balloon member. The inflatable and adjustable balloon device is configured to fit snugly on the outside of the rigid bronchoscope. This enables better ventilation of patient's undergoing rigid bronchoscopy and prevents back bleeding into the lung. Once the balloon is inflated, improved jet ventilation can occur with better resulting aeration.

title: System for preparing dimethyl 1, 4-cyclohexanedicarboxylate
abstract: The utility model provides a system for preparing 1, 4-cyclohexanedicarboxylic acid dimethyl ester. The system comprises a first feeding pipeline, a second feeding pipeline and a hydrogenation reactor, the first feeding pipeline is communicated with the hydrogenation reactor through the bottom of the hydrogenation reactor; a reinforced mass transfer device is arranged in the hydrogenation reactor, microbubble outlets are formed in the upper end and the lower end of the reinforced mass transfer device, and the number of the microbubble outlets in the upper end is smaller than that of the microbubble outlets in the lower end; the second feeding pipeline is connected with the enhanced mass transfer device; the hydrogenation reactor is a slurry bed reactor, a material outlet of the hydrogenation reactor is higher than the reinforced mass transfer device in the vertical direction, and the material outlet is lower than the liquid level in the hydrogenation reactor in the vertical direction; a baffle is arranged in the hydrogenation reactor close to the material outlet, and the top of the baffle is located between the material outlet and the liquid level of the hydrogenation reactor in the vertical direction; the bottoms of the baffles are obliquely arranged close to the side wall of the hydrogenation reactor. The system can effectively increase the phase boundary mass transfer area of the gas phase and the liquid phase.

title: A Food-grade Coffee Ground Adsorption Pack and Its Preparation Method and Application
abstract: The present invention discloses a food-grade coffee grounds adsorption pack, which belongs to the field of environmental engineering technology. The coffee grounds adsorption pack comprises the following parts by weight: 10-20 parts of porous starch, 0.5-1.0 part of coffee powder flavoring, and 80-90 parts of coffee grounds. The coffee grounds are dried and mixed with porous starch and coffee flavoring, then packed. The coffee grounds refer to the residue obtained after grinding, extracting, or brewing coffee beans. The present invention is low-cost, and all raw materials are food-grade, making it safe and effective, providing a new approach for the removal and adsorption of odors.

title: METHOD FOR ARTISANAL CREAM CHEESE PRODUCTION
abstract: Method for artisanal cream cheese production involves milk reception, filtration, and pasteurization; cooling to a specified temperature; inoculation with mesophilic Lactococcus and Leucococcus cultures; addition of rennet preparation and milk coagulation; separation of whey and pressing of curd; cooling curd, adding salt, shaping finished product, packaging it in airtight containers, and storing it at low temperatures. Combination of four strains of mesophilic bacteria is used for souring: Lactococcus lactis subsp. cremoris, Lactococcus lactis subsp. lactis, Leuconostoc mesenteroides subsp. cremoris, and Lactococcus lactis subsp. diacetylactis. Coagulation is carried out at a temperature of 30±2 °C for 22-24 hours. Rennet is added directly to soured milk. Cheese balls with a diameter of 2 cm are formed, rolled in pre-pasteurized spices, placed in glass containers with a volume of 250330 ml, and topped with sunflower oil.

title: INTELLIGENT ADAPTIVE CONTROL SYSTEM FOR STERILIZATION AND PASTEURIZATION PROCESSES IN AUTOCLAVES FOR THE PRODUCTION OF VEGETABLE PRESERVES
abstract: The present utility model relates to an intelligent adaptive control system for sterilization and pasteurization processes in autoclaves and pasteurizers used in a vegetable canning production facility, including the production of chutney and other vegetable mixtures packaged in glass jars or metal containers. The intelligent adaptive control system for sterilization and pasteurization processes in autoclaves for the production of vegetable preserves according to the utility model comprises a technological data acquisition module (1), an automated control and software analysis module (2), an adaptive sterilization process control module (3), in communication with an autoclave and pasteurizer module (4), as well as a steam and power supply control module (5). By continuously measuring and analyzing temperature, pressure, processing time, product type, product volume, and packaging type, the intelligent adaptive control system for sterilization and pasteurization processes in autoclaves for the production of vegetable preserves used in the vegetable canning production facility, according to the utility model, calculates in real time an optimal sterilization or pasteurization regime and automatically adjusts the duration and process parameters, thereby ensuring microbiological safety with minimal energy consumption and without compromising product quality.

title: METAL-ORGANIC FRAMEWORK-CONFINED NANOSCALE CONJUGATED POLYMER COMPOSITE, PREPARATION METHOD THEREFOR, AND APPLICATIONS THEREOF
abstract: The present invention provides a metal-organic framework (MOF)-confined nanoscale conjugated polymer (CP) composite, a preparation method therefor, and applications thereof, falling within the technical field of photocatalysis. For the MOF-confined nanoscale CP composite, an ultrasonic cavitation effect is utilized to induce ordered alignment of monomer molecules adsorbed within channels along a channel direction, facilitating subsequent oriented polymerization. A polymerization reaction is strictly confined to MOF nanochannels through sonochemically confined polymerization, ensuring precise and controllable growth of CP chains and forming CP nanostructures with controlled size and morphology. Furthermore, the MOF-confined CP composite exhibits significantly enhanced mass transfer efficiency and overall photocatalytic performance, providing innovative insights and effective solutions for advancing photocatalytic technology.

title: Solvent-less System and Method for Emulsion Breaking and Viscosity Reduction in Crude Oil and Bitumen Using Disc Atomizer, Water Curtain, Horizontal FWKO, and Ultrasound
abstract: Abstract The invention relates to a solvent-less system and method for breaking stubborn water-in- oil emulsions and reducing viscosity in crude oil and bitumen froth, particularly from oil sands extraction. The system comprises a high-speed rotary disc atomizer that mechanically disintegrates the froth into fine particles and thin films, an annular water curtain that provides high-shear impact to strip fines and promote coalescence, and a horizontal free-water knock-out (FWKO) vessel configured to receive the quenched mixture submerged in a water pad for efficient gravity separation. In preferred embodiments, ultrasound transducers apply acoustic energy to further disrupt residual emulsions and reduce bitumen viscosity through cavitation. The process operates without chemical diluents or solvents, achieving clean bitumen overflow with low water and solids content. The invention offers an environmentally friendly, cost-effective alternative to conventional solvent-based froth treatment. title: Pet Food for Improving the Antioxidant and Anti-Aging Capacity of Dogs and Cats and Preparation Method Thereof
abstract: The invention provides a pet food for improving the antioxidant and anti-aging capacity of dogs and cats and a preparation method thereof, aiming to prolong their healthy lifespan and improve overall vitality. The pet food, by weight, comprises 3–5 parts of Lentinus edodes, 2–4 parts of Agaricus bisporus, and seven kinds of mushrooms in total, together with Aronia melanocarpa fruit, raspberry, beef heart powder, broccoli sprouts, turmeric, Codonopsis pilosula, and other ingredients. The mushrooms provide ergothioneine as an anti-aging component, Aronia melanocarpa fruit supplies high-activity anthocyanins, and broccoli sprouts contribute sulforaphane, all of which synergistically enhance antioxidant and anti-aging effects. The preparation method includes raw material pretreatment (cleaning, drying, and grinding), mixing, and forming/packaging, wherein a low-temperature process (45– 60 °C) is adopted to retain bioactive compounds. The resulting pet food is safe, easily absorbed, and effective in scavenging free radicals, protecting organ function, boosting immunity, and delaying cellular aging in dogs and cats.

title: Polyethylene glycol terephthalate hydrolase PmPETase and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses polyethylene glycol terephthalate hydrolase PmPETase and application thereof.The hydrolase PmPETase is protein with the amino acid sequence shown in SEQ ID NO.1. An expression system suitable for the PmPETase is constructed, recombinase protein with catalytic activity is obtained, and the polyethylene glycol terephthalate hydrolase PmPETase can be used for preparing the polyethylene glycol terephthalate hydrolase PmPETase. The substrate specificity, the catalytic property and the potential plastic degradation capacity of the PET degrading enzyme are comprehensively analyzed, and a new theoretical basis and application reference are provided for development and utilization of the PET degrading enzyme and a high polymer material green treatment technology.

title: Marine metagenome-sourced low-temperature salt-tolerant hydrolase for efficiently degrading PET (polyethylene terephthalate) plastic and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses low-temperature salt-tolerant hydrolase sourced from marine metagenome and capable of efficiently degrading PET (Polyethylene Terephthalate) plastic and application thereof. The hydrolase NH937 can degrade polyethylene glycol terephthalate (PET) at the temperature of 40 DEG C, the catalytic efficiency of the hydrolase NH937 is dozens of times higher than that of reported IsPETase, and the hydrolase NH937 has remarkable PET degradation activity in a 0-5.3 M NaCl buffer solution with the wide PH range of 5.0-11.0 and natural seawater and is a PET hydrolase with high salt resistance in a low-temperature environment at present. The NH937 can change the surface morphology of PET, can enable the surface of a PET film to show obvious holes, and can be used as a candidate enzyme for marine in-situ degradation of PET plastics. The PET hydrolase disclosed by the invention is high in activity, low-temperature-resistant and high-temperature-resistant, is a seawater environment-like PET plastic, and can provide theoretical guidance and technical support for degradation of marine micro-plastics in the future.

title: HIGH-STRENGTH ASPHALT MIXTURE AND PREPARATION METHOD THEREOF
abstract: The invention discloses a high-strength asphalt mixture and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of construction materials. The raw materials of the high-strength asphalt mixture of the invention, calculated by mass parts, include: 100 parts of aggregate, 4-7 parts of base asphalt, 0.3-0.8 parts of high-modulus modifier, 0.5- 2 parts of activated diatomite, 0.2-0.5 parts of fiber, 0.1-0.3 parts of interface enhancer, 0.2-0.4 parts of paraffin and 3-8 parts of water. title: SLOW-RELEASE AND LONG-ACTING FERTILIZER SUITABLE FOR COASTAL SALINE-ALKALI SOILS AND PREPARATION METHOD THEREOF
abstract: A slow-release and long-acting fertilizer suitable for coastal saline-alkali soils, including the following components by weight percentage: “IS-20% of organic-inorganic composite particles, 40-48% of slow and controlled release nitrogen fertilizer, 8—17% of monoammonium phosphate, 5-12% of potassium sulphate, 4-8% of boric acid, and 10-18% of biological bacteria particles. Among them, the organic-inorganic composite particles are prepared by compounding weathered coal or lignite rich in humic acid (after activation treatment), phosphogypsum, citric acid, and zinc sulphate in a certain proportion. Compared with traditional crop-specific fertilizers, long-term application of this fertilizer may not only improve soil fertility, reduce saline-alkali damage, and alleviate soil saline-alkali obstacles, but also flexibly adjust the nutrient formula according to the differences in soil fertility among different farmers, effectively improve nutrient use efficiency, increase crop yield, and enhance crop quality. Thus, it helps to achieve the goal of green production for crops in saline-alkali soils, featuring fertilizer saving, quality improvement, and efficiencyenhancement.

abstract: The present invention relates to technology for improving the lifespan characteristics and charge/discharge efficiency of a lithium secondary battery by applying amorphous Si on the surface of a high-nickel ternary positive electrode active material. The present invention has the effects of maintaining stable lifespan characteristics even in high-temperature environments and suppressing side reactions with an electrolyte, by forming a coating layer by adding Si and other metal elements (Al, Ti, Zr, etc.) to a positive electrode active material containing a high concentration of nickel. In addition, the present invention includes a method for preparing the positive electrode active material, and proposes a process for preparing a high-performance positive electrode active material. Accordingly, the charge/discharge efficiency and long-term stability of a high-capacity lithium secondary battery can be achieved.

abstract: The present invention discloses a multifunctional wheat strip seeder, relating to the field of seeding equipment. title: Process for dissociating, chelating, and dissolving solids, suspended solids, and bacteria, harvesting and liberating oxygen bound to other substances, and preventing dissolved solids from precipitating and reprecipitating in oil separation systems
abstract: [0000]    A process for separating solids and oil from water without requiring waste haul-off comprising six phases. In the first phase, a stream of raw saltwater is treated with desired chemistry and a beneficial reuse chemical effluent. In the second phase and third phase, the water undergoes oil separation, and the water is stored to facilitate phase changes. In the fourth phase, the saltwater is treated with desired chemistries and a beneficial reuse chemical effluent. In the fifth phase, the water is stored and agitated. In the sixth phase, the water passes through a mechanical filter—or similar unit—the stream then directed to a chemical reactor. Desired chemistries and solids removed from the filter are added to the reactor. The reactor outputs a beneficial reuse chemical effluent which can be recycled to Phase 1 and Phase 4—and prefilter Phase 6—of the system.

abstract: The present invention relates to the technical field of sputum suction medical instruments, and specifically relates to a sputum suction care flushing device, comprising a sputum suction device body, wherein a sputum collection bottle is placed on the sputum suction device body; a bottle cap is detachably mounted on an open mouth of the sputum collection bottle; a cylindrical cavity and circular holes in communication with each other are formed inside the bottle cap; a suction flushing assembly is disposed above the bottle cap; the suction flushing assembly comprises two movable tubes slidably inserted into corresponding circular holes respectively; and a suction hose is connected and fixed to the top of each movable tube. title: Vegetal Concrete Masonry Unit and Method and System for Manufacture Thereof
abstract: [0000]    A vegetal concrete masonry unit and method and system for manufacturing thereof are disclosed. The masonry unit comprises treated crop residues (e.g., paddy straw, wheat straw, bagasse), a binder of hydrated lime, ground granulated blast furnace slag (GGBFS), and low-content alkali activator (2.5-20% by mass), and aggregates in a mass ratio of 1:0.1:1.5 to 1:5:5, achieving compressive strengths of 2-20 MPa and densities of 950-1900 kg/m<3>. The method involves alkali-treating residues at 0.1-10M NaOH for 15-1500 minutes, passing through a screw press, mixing with binder and aggregates to form C-A-S-H and N-A-S-H gels, and high-pressure molding (2-10 MPa). The system includes silos, a retention tank/screw press, pan mixer, and hydraulic press. This sustainable bio-composite utilizes agricultural/industrial wastes, reduces emissions by 80%, is energy efficient, enhances compatibility and mechanical performance, and provides thermal insulation for eco-friendly building blocks and panels.

title: MODULAR AUTONOMOUS RECHARGING POD SYSTEM FOR LIGHT ELECTRIC VEHICLES WITH INTEGRATED
abstract: A pod system is disclosed for docking and autonomously recharging light electric vehicles, such as electric scooters and bicycles. The system features a modular design for easy assembly and disassembly, consisting of a lightweight frame with a roof, base, and configurable walls. These walls support rows of detachable modules, each equipped for vehicle docking and recharging. The invention integrates a high-capacity battery pack as its power source, augmented by solar panels to ensure sustainable energy supply. A central controller oversees module operations and power distribution, resulting in a self-sufficient solution for urban and suburban settings.

title: PET DISCRIMINATION METHOD
abstract: Provided is a PET discrimination method capable of discriminating, by a method that has a relatively simple discrimination operation and that is objective, a chemical recycled PET resin (including fiber) which is a homologous and homogeneous polyester-based resin.　Infrared or near-infrared absorption spectra of respective comparative resins, of a group A of a plurality of comparative resins that are chemical recycled PET resins and a group B of a plurality of comparative resins that are virgin PET resins, are obtained. Spectral data in a predetermined wavenumber range are extracted from the absorption spectra, and an analysis data group obtained by multivariate analysis of the spectral data is accumulated as a database. Similarly, the spectrum data of an unknown resin to be inspected are subjected to multivariate analysis and compared with the analysis data group to discriminate between whether the resin being inspected is a chemical recycled PET resin or a virgin PET resin.

title: METHOD FOR RECYCLING PET
abstract: The present invention relates to a novel method for recycling polyethylene terephthalate (PET) using a glycolysis process. This method comprises depolymerising the PET via a transesterification reaction using ethylene glycol (EG) and specific catalysts. The method comprises subsequently synthesising an unsaturated polyester (UPE) from the glycolysis products and mixing the UPE with styrene, which produces an unsaturated polyester resin (UPER). Lastly, the UPER is chemically crosslinked, thereby obtaining a thermosetting material with mechanical properties comparable to commercial resins, which is suitable for use in the chemical polymer industry.

title: Triple-Lock Border Edge and Retain Barrier Apparatus
abstract: [0000]    The present invention is a border edge and retain barrier and curb apparatus for the creation and maintenance of beds, rings, patios and other spaces in landscapes. Border barrier members interconnect through engagement of overlapping base flanges (FIGS. 1-4), wall flanges (FIGS. 1-8), slots, tabs, lock pin holes (FIGS. 1-11) and lock pins (FIGS. 1-12) creating solid, seamless elongate horizontal base and vertical wall surfaces that span barrier member assemblies of solid construction with no cavities, voids or hollow channels. Barrier members are assembled in a plurality of geometric shapes all providing solid horizontal surface on both sides of the solid vertical surface and may be nested creating integrated curbs. The resulting assembly is freestanding, self-connected requiring no external anchors, connectors, or braces. This present invention quickly and easily retains soil, mulch, gravel, pavers, concrete and other materials to separate and edge lawns, beds, trees, patios, decks and other landscaping.

Ce parechoc virtuel, modulé en forme et étendu dans une zone périphérique, est contrôlé par un module de décision en fonction des phases de transfert de charge. Trois états principaux sont définis :   E1 (dépose au sol), activé en cas d’échec de reconnaissance de forme ou lorsque le moyen de préhension est en position intermédiaire ;E2 (prise au sol), activé en cas de reconnaissance positive de forme et lorsque le moyen de préhension est en position basse ; et E3 (prise ou dépose en hauteur), activé lorsque le moyen de préhension est en position haute ou intermédiaire avec reconnaissance de forme positive. Un état E4 couvre les situations non prévues par ces critères, garantissant la sécurité et l’adaptabilité.  Figure de l’abrégé. Figure 1

title: Procédé, système et standard de cuisson fondés sur la régulation d’une transformation par signature acoustique
abstract: L’invention concerne un procédé et un système de cuisson dans lesquels la fourniture d’énergie est pilotée principalement à partir d’un signal acoustique et/ou vibratoire émis par un aliment au cours de sa transformation. Une signature acoustique est extraite du signal, comparée à une trajectoire acoustique cible, et l’énergie est appliquée par actions ponctuelles ou événementielles afin de maintenir ladite trajectoire, sans consigne fixe de température, de puissance ou de temps. Une intelligence artificielle peut décider et/ou prédire les actions, mémoriser des trajectoires validées et interpréter des commandes vocales comme des intentions de transformation. Des capteurs complémentaires, notamment optiques, peuvent être utilisés en renfort, par exemple via une caméra (visible et/ou infrarouge) pour observer l’état de surface, la présence, la mousse ou les projections, sans que la commande principale ne cesse d’être fondée sur le signal acoustique. Le procédé peut fonctionner de manière sélective en milieu liquide (huile/eau) afin d’éviter fumée, projections, ébullition et débordement, la gravité pouvant être prise en compte comme contrainte passive. Un mode Scan‑Focus peut réaliser une cartographie acoustique par excitations de test pour homogénéiser la transformation

title: PASSIVE HIGH-HUMIDITY STORAGE CONTAINER WITH THERMAL ISOLATION FOR REFRIGERATED ENVIRONMENTS
abstract: A passive high-humidity storage container for preserving sensitive food products within a refrigerated environment subject to cyclic temperature fluctuations. The container includes an insulated enclosure defining an interior storage volume and forming a continuous thermal barrier surrounding at least 85% of the volume. An inner container is positioned within the enclosure, and an airtight seal located entirely inside the thermal barrier defines a high-humidity storage chamber thermally isolated from rapid external temperature changes. The thermal barrier dampens short-term temperature fluctuations while permitting long-term equilibration to the refrigerator's average temperature. Sliding drawers retain dense, cold, humid air during partial opening to preserve the internal microclimate. The container operates passively, utilizing produce transpiration to maintain high humidity and prevent condensation, thereby extending food freshness and shelf life without active cooling or electrical components.

title: TEMPERATURE SENSOR ASSEMBLY HAVING IMPROVED RESPONSE RATE
abstract: A temperature sensor assembly of the present invention uses a film-type thermistor temperature sensor instead of a bulk-type thermistor element of the prior art, so that it is possible to provide a temperature sensor assembly that is light in volume and easy to mount. In particular, the temperature sensor assembly of the present invention comprises: a thermistor element wrapped by an element protective unit; a lead terminal connected to the thermistor element; and a wire connected to a temperature measuring device. Since a protective member such as an epoxy part is not formed in the film-type thermistor temperature sensor formed in this manner, heat transfer delay does not occur and superior temperature sensing performance can be provided. In the temperature sensor assembly of the present invention, the film-type thermistor temperature sensor having no protective member is mounted on a support member and used, so that the above-described heat transfer delay phenomenon does not occur in a thermistor sensor element and the like, and mechanical stability is also improved. In addition, the temperature sensor assembly of the present invention may be used in a wide range of practical applications by further providing a connection member connected to a temperature measurement object.

One or more display modules (106-1, 106-2, 106-3) are arranged on one or both housing sections (112, 114). A plurality of antennas (306) are located along a first bezel (304) of the first housing section (112). A plurality of detune elements (134) are disposed along a second bezel (308) of the second housing section (114) and are configured to influence or detune the resonance of the antennas (306) when the device (102) is folded. The detune elements (134) are further incorporated into a near-field communication (NFC) antenna loop (136) positioned on the second bezel (308), enabling NFC transmission and reception. By electrically coupling the detune elements (134) with the antennas (306) through the housing geometry, the foldable device maintains stable antenna impedance, reduces electromagnetic coupling between the housing sections, and preserves reliable NFC communication efficiency in both the open and closed states.

title: SMART SURGICAL TABLE WITH AI AND BLOCKCHAIN-BASED DETECTION OF SURGICAL INSTRUMENTS
abstract: The present invention relates to an intelligent surgical instrument tracking system that integrates computer vision, precision weight sensing, and secure blockchain-based data recording. The system utilizes a central processing unit [fig. 1], equipped with an industrial 1TB SD-card storage module (1-2) for onboard data retention. An industrial imaging module (1-3) in combination with a uniform illumination module (1-4) enables high-accuracy, tag-less visual recognition of surgical instruments.A single-point load cell (1-5) connected through load-cell amplification circuitry (1-6) and a high-resolution analog-to-digital converter (1-7) provides real-time weight validation to ensure instrument completeness throughout the surgical procedure. The system is powered by a rechargeable power source (1-8), managed and boosted through a power-management and boost-conversion module (1-9), ensuring uninterrupted operation.Alerts are delivered through an audible alert generator (1-12) and a visual alert indicator (1-11). For secure data integrity, the device incorporates a hardware security module (1-10) to protect cryptographic keys used in the blockchain ledger. A touch-enabled display interface (1-13) provides user interaction and system feedback.By combining visual detection, weight-based verification, and immutable blockchain recording, the invention significantly enhances surgical safety and prevents retained surgical items without requiring RFID tags or manual counting.

title: DIGITAL SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR MANAGING HYDROGEN AND HYDROGEN-DERIVED SUPPLY CHAINS
abstract: [0000]    Systems and methods are disclosed for recording, validating, and using digitally signed provenance data associated with the production, delivery, transformation, reconversion, and withdrawal of hydrogen, hydrogen-containing energy carriers, and hydrogen-enabled synthetic fuels. Supply-chain events occurring at certified inlets, certified outlets, transfer interfaces, production facilities, conversion facilities, reconversion facilities, and transport systems may generate data elements that include measurements, quantities, timestamps, source identifiers, energy source information, carbon-intensity information, and participant credentials. These data elements may be authenticated and stored in a digital ledger that supports monitoring, reporting, and verification functions. Validated ledger entries may be used to determine eligibility for settlement actions or entitlements, including tax credits, subsidies, or incentive payments. Settlement logic, smart contracts, or automated rules may allocate or transfer credits, payments, or digital instruments among credentialed participants. The disclosed technology supports traceability, compliance, and financial settlement across supply chains for hydrogen, hydrogen-containing energy carriers, and hydrogen-enabled synthetic fuels.

title: ORCHESTRATION OF SYNTHETIC DNA COMPUTING AS A SERVICE FOR DATA STORAGE LEVERAGING GENERATIVE AI AND SMART CONTRACTS
abstract: [0000]    Systems and methods orchestrate synthetic DNA computing as a service (DNAaaS) to enable secure and controlled data storage and retrieval by leveraging generative AI and blockchain-based smart contracts. The system analyzes digital information using generative AI to classify data based on sensitivity, generating dynamic smart contracts that define encryption protocols, storage locations, and access entitlements. Digital data is encoded into synthetic DNA sequences using an intelligent encoding engine and securely stored across distributed DNA computing infrastructures. Retrieval requests trigger corresponding smart contracts to validate user identity, aggregate DNA-encoded data from multiple locations, and decode it back into its original form. Biometric validation, device-specific authentication, and anomaly detection ensure data integrity, security, and access control. The blockchain-based ledger provides transparency, immutability, and verification of all operations. This invention facilitates scalable, efficient, and secure management of sensitive data in synthetic DNA storage environments while maintaining strict compliance with security and entitlement rules.

title: GRAVITATIONAL AND MAGNETIC FORCE TO ELECTRICAL ENERGY CONVERSION SYSTEM (GMECS)
abstract: The invention proposes a Gravitational and Magnetic Force to Electrical Energy Conversion System (GMECS), a solution based on the simple pendulum principle and developed from the successful foundation of the "Large-sized clock, low power consumption" invention (internationally published by WIPO in 2022). GMECS overcomes the inherent challenges of using a simple pendulum for large-scale electricity production by optimally and effectively combining the interaction of the Earth's gravitational field with the powerful magnetic field of Neodymium N52 rare-earth magnets and the controlled variable magnetic field of an electromagnet to generate significant and continuous torque. In this system, the pendulum's oscillation energy, maintained and amplified by a small amount of electrical energy from an external source (e.g., solar power), is converted into mechanical energy through a complex gearbox system comprising a one-way gearbox and a reversing gearbox. This mechanical energy is then transmitted to a speed-increasing gearbox to augment rotational speed, thereby rotating the rotor of a rare-earth magnet generator, producing useful electrical energy. Experiments have demonstrated the system's superior capability to generate 22W of output power with only 8.7W of input power, showing a positive and significant energy amplification factor (COP > 2.5). This additional energy is attributed to the efficient harnessing from the relative motion of the hundreds-of- kilogram pendulum within the Earth's gravitational field and the interaction between the magnetic field of rare-earth magnets and the controlled variable magnetic field of the electromagnet, via the pendulum's resonance mechanism. This successfully addresses technical challenges, including overcoming the inertia of the speed-increasing gearbox, the generator, and the Lenz's Law effect. The GMECS invention has the potential for scalable electricity production, offering significant benefits in energy savings, providing independent distributed power, being environmentally friendly, and having broad applicability in both industrial and agricultural sectors, especially in areas difficult to access traditional energy sources or requiring sustainable energy solutions.

The preparation method comprises: performing extraction on tobacco raw material twice at medium and low temperatures, and obtaining tobacco flavor compounds; performing extraction on the tobacco raw material at a high temperature, and obtaining smoke flavor compounds; and mixing the tobacco flavor compounds and the smoke flavor compounds in a certain ratio to obtain a tobacco extract composition.

abstract: The present application relates to the technical field of electronic atomization, and specifically relates to a tobacco extract composition, and a preparation method therefor and a use thereof. title: Remote Controlled Chassis for Any Lawn Mower
abstract: [0000]    This invention is a modular remote-controlled chassis that converts any standard push mower into a remote-controlled mower. It features a two-piece adjustable frame of square tubing and flat bars, allowing compatibility with various mower sizes. A four-piece mower mounting system ensures secure attachment while preserving deck adjustments. A fail-safe safety adapter triggers the mower's safety switch, lever, or button and is universally adaptable via a detachable connector. The system supports upgradable four-wheel drive by connecting motors in parallel with a Y-splitter. The electronic box houses key components, including a motor driver, microcontroller, power switch, and an airflow system with intake and exhaust fans for cooling. A unique connector system prevents installation errors and allows future upgrades. Designed for durability and adaptability, this chassis provides a safe, efficient solution for converting push mowers into remote-controlled units.

abstract: An aspect of the present invention relates to an electrically controlled device for supplying air and water and, more specifically, to a device for supplying air and water, which is electrically controlled and thus can appropriately supply air and water to an endoscope. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a flow path control valve such as a solenoid valve, which is electrically controlled, is applied in order to control an air passage or a water passage installed in a device for supplying air and water, thereby enabling quick and precise adjustment of a fluid flow. Therefore, the operation burden of a user can be reduced, errors which may occur during endoscopy can be minimized, and the safety and comfort of a patient can be improved.

title: TOBACCO PROCESSING METHOD FOR SEPARATING TOP NOTE, BODY NOTE, AND BASE NOTE, AND AEROSOL GENERATION SUBSTRATE
abstract: The present application relates to the technical field of tobacco processing, and in particular to a tobacco processing method for separating a top note, a body note, and a base note, and an aerosol generation substrate. The method comprises the following steps: S1: adding an extraction solvent to tobacco raw materials, and performing extraction at -18°C to -5°C to obtain a crude tobacco extract; S2: performing molecular distillation on the crude tobacco extract at 90-120°C to obtain a top note and a primary molecular distillation residue; S3: performing molecular distillation on the primary molecular distillation residue at 130-170°C to obtain a body note and a base note; and S4: respectively performing adsorption decolorization treatment on the top note, the body note, and the base note, wherein the extraction solvent in S1 comprises ethanol, petroleum ether, and ethyl acetate in a volume ratio of (1-7):(1-7):(1-2). The method can achieve efficient separation of the top note, body note and base note of tobacco, and the obtained respective notes have high aroma intensity and are naturally coordinated, facilitating supplementation of specific aromas according to blending requirements.

title: AUTOMATICALLY-CONTROLLED INVERTED BACKWASH PRE-FILTER

The automatically-controlled inverted backwash pre-filter has a more optimized structure, can easily adapt to installation scenarios, and has a plurality of drain channels so as to adapt to different application modes.

abstract: The present invention relates to a modular commercial food storage, sterilization, and drinking water supply system for developing countries, based microplasma advanced oxidation processing (AOP) and an electromagnetic signal (EMS). title: INTEGRATED DEVICES FOR DRYING ORGANIC SOLID WASTES AND EXTRACTING METALS AND METHODS THEREOF
abstract: [0000]    An integrated device and a method thereof are provided. The integrated device includes: a pyrolysis chamber, a high-temperature cracking chamber, a material drying chamber, a steam boiler, a cyclonic dust removal chamber, a spray chamber, an electrostatic dust removal chamber, a water bath purification chamber, a biomass gas treatment chamber, and a metal carbonization chamber. The pyrolysis chamber is connected to the high-temperature cracking chamber. The pyrolysis chamber is provided with the first biomass air inlet. The high-temperature cracking chamber is provided with a second biomass air inlet and is connected to the material drying chamber through a lower hot air pipe and an upper hot air pipe. An air-drying cylinder is arranged in the material drying chamber. The upper hot air pipe is in communication with an interior of the air-drying cylinder. The lower hot air pipe is in communication with a space outside the air-drying cylinder.

abstract: [0000]    A bear spray device that is provided in a first embodiment and a second embodiment wherein both embodiments are constructed to provide emission of an audio signal ensuing removal of the trigger guard of a bear spray canister. A nozzle assembly embodiment is further provided wherein the nozzle assembly embodiment is operably coupled to a canister of bear spray and will provide discharge of spray disposed therein. abstract: Ce collimateur (8) comprend une source de lumière (10) et un corps (12) muni d’une surface d’entrée de lumière (14), d’une surface intermédiaire de collimation de lumière (16), et d’une surface de sortie de lumière (18). title: SIMPLIFIED TELESCOPIC OPTICAL LENS ARRANGEMENT HAVING THE SAME
abstract: The invention relates to a projection objective with a simplified structure for astronomical imaging and the same. The objective is adapted to project an image of an object to an imaging plane (30A-C), and comprises a first optical element group (G1) having a positive effective focal length, and a second optical element group (G2) having a positive effective focal length. The optical elements are arranged so that first element (11A-C) of the first group (G1) is identical with the second element (22A-C) of the second group (G2), and the second element (12A-C) of the first group (G1) is identical with the first element (21A-C) of the second group (G2), having air-spaces arranged so that aberrations from one group can be balanced by the aberrations in the other group. The objective suits well for correcting aberrations while employing a larger relative aperture (20A-C), while providing a simplified structure for manufacturing benefits.

abstract: Provided is a method for culturing a sample of cells, which includes circulating epithelial cells, peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC), or body fluid-derived cell samples (e.g. blood, ascites, pleural effusions, cerebrospinal fluids, perfusion fluids, sputum, and urine), or liquid biopsy-derived cell samples in presence of Bone Morphogentic Protein (BMP) inhibitor, a mitogenic growth factor, and a Wnt agonist, when culturing the circulating epithelial cells and relevant blood cells. Also provided is use of cell medium having a BMP inhibitor, a mitogenic growth factor, and a Wnt agonist in obtaining a cell culture of circulating epithelial cells, PBMC and body fluid-derived cells.

title: YEAST STRAINS THAT PRODUCE VOLATILE ORGANIC COMPOUNDS AND USE THEREOF FOR THE BIOCONTROL OF PHYTOPATHOGENIC FUNGI
abstract: The present invention relates to a group of microorganisms, specifically comprising Papiliotrema fonsecae RGM 3656, Aureobasidium pullulans RGM 3657 and Aureobasidium subglaciale RGM 3658, which are strains that produce volatile organic compounds (VOCs). The invention also comprises the use of these microorganisms to inhibit the growth of phytopathogenic fungi such as Botrytis cinerea, Fusarium oxysporum, Rhizopus sp, Penicillium sp, Alternaria sp, Aspergillus sp, Macrophomina phaseolina and Phytophthora cinnamomi in plant species belonging to the families Solanaceae, Asteraceae, Cucurbitaceae and Apiaceae. Lastly, the invention also relates to a method for producing this group of microorganisms using coffee grounds and diluted molasses as a culture medium.

title: Implantable Stimulator Device With Tissue Biasing for MRI Protection
abstract: Stimulator circuitry useable in a stimulator device is described. The stimulator circuitry features an MRI-safe mode configured to protect the device and the patient from malfunctions caused by voltages that may develop because of electromagnetic fields and gradients present in a patient’s tissue during an MRI procedure. The circuitry is configured to assert a common mode voltage to the patient’s tissue that is preferably between a ground and a compliance voltage of the stimulator device.

abstract: A mandrel assembly (100) for net-shape casting of an undercut finocyl grain (133) with aft-end counterbore (140) in a solid propellant rocket case (101) comprising a core (105) capable of forming central cylindrical cavities in the grain and a plurality of fins (106) capable of forming a plurality of forward-swept longitudinal cavities circular patterned around the core. title: APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR ADJUSTING MACHINE LINE DIRECTION ON THE SURFACES OF MANUFACTURED PRODUCTS
abstract: A system is provided for adjusting, correcting, re-orienting and/or re-designing the manufacturing marks (surface grain) that remain on the surface of a manufactured product, such as, for example, a screw after manufacturing of the same. A plurality of plates (222) having a predetermined size, shape, and edge design are attached to each other and configured to be rotated about a shaft. The edges of combined plates are brought into contact with a surface of a manufactured product or screw thread where a controlled rotation and/or sliding action is imparted to the thread surface. The edges of the plates and their design cause the surface grain in the thread surface to be re-directed, adjusted or re-oriented in a desired direction determined by the plates and their design.

title: Poulie intégrée
abstract: Le modèle d’utilité divulgue une poulie intégrée, comprenant un disque de protection, l'anneau intérieur dudit disque de protection étant équipé d'un disque denté ; cette poulie intégrée adopte une conception innovante qui combine plusieurs éléments en une structure unique et multifonctionnelle, formant une roue synchrone intégrée. Cette conception permet de simplifier les étapes complexes de production, de réduire significativement les coûts, et d’améliorer l’efficacité. La maintenance et le remplacement des produits deviennent également plus simples et rapides. De plus, la conception avec de larges ouvertures et des bords en V incliné sur le disque denté assure une évacuation efficace des particules fines telles que le sable pendant le fonctionnement, ce qui prolonge considérablement la durée de vie du système de transmission par courroie. Enfin, les bords-guides bidirectionnels permettent un alignement fluide de la courroie, évitant ainsi les risques de déraillement ou de saut de dents. Cette poulie respecte les normes ISO en matière de protection, et la partie interne dentée est hautement adaptable à différents arbres centraux des moteurs, offrant une compatibilité et une polyvalence accrues.

title: Mitochondrial-Endoplasmic Reticulum Cell Death Inducing Nanoparticles
abstract: The present technology provides a combination approach for treating multidrug resistant cancer. Multidrug resistant cancers have more mitochondrial networks than drug sensitive cancers. A first agent fragments mitochondrial networks, dissociates mitochondria from the endoplasmic reticulum, and lower the threshold for apoptosis. A second active agent induces the unfolded protein response, causing stress to the endoplasmic reticulum and limiting the ability of multidrug resistant cancer cells to grow and survive. A third active agent directly activates mitochondrial apoptosis, leading to death of the cancer cells. The active agents can be combined into a nanoparticle formulation for simultaneous delivery into multidrug resistant cancer cells. The formulation serves as a nanomedicine for treatment of multidrug resistant cancers such as multidrug resistant triple negative breast cancer.

title: CYLINDRICAL BATTERY AND ELECTRONIC DEVICE
abstract: The present application discloses a cylindrical battery and an electronic device. A housing comprises a first wall portion, an electrode assembly is disposed in the housing, and a current collector plate is disposed between the electrode assembly and the first wall portion. The current collector plate comprises a first portion, a second portion, and a connecting portion. The connecting portion is connected between the first portion and the second portion, the second portion and the first portion are folded relative to each other, the first portion is connected to the electrode assembly, and the second portion is connected to the first wall portion. The cylindrical battery further comprises a buffer member, the buffer member is disposed on the connecting portion, and the buffer member faces the first portion and the second portion. The buffer member can absorb part of impact force, reduce stress transmitted to the connecting portion, and facilitate reducing occurrence of breakage of the connecting portion. In addition, the buffer member can fill a part of a gap between the first portion and the second portion of the current collector plate, and can effectively reduce the repeated stress effect of the connecting portion, thereby improving the fatigue resistance of the connecting portion, facilitating prolonging the service life of the current collector plate, and reducing the risk of failure of the cylindrical battery.

title: YARNS AND TEXTILES FOR CUT RESISTANT DENIM
abstract: A denim textile may be manufactured using a warp yarn and a weft yarn that give the denim textile cut-resistant properties. The warp and weft yarns may both have a first covering layer which is made from Ultra-High Molecular Weight Polyethylene (UHMWPE). The UHMWPE may provide cut-resistant properties to each of the warp yarn and weft yarn. Each of the warp yarn and weft yarn may also have a second covering of nylon. The nylon may give the denim textile a softer, more comfortable texture and flexibility, and may serve to impart a specific color on the denim textile. The weft yarn may additionally have a cotton, polyester and rayon fibers blended core that may also include spandex and/or other stretch fibers, which may collectively give the denim additional softness and flexibility. The resulting denim textile is expected to meet various ANSI test requirements for cut resistance and durability.

title: STEPWISE PREPARATION METHOD FOR AEROBIC GRANULAR SLUDGE AND WATER TREATMENT METHOD USING SAME
abstract: The present invention relates to a stepwise preparation method for aerobic granular sludge and a water treatment method using same, and more specifically to the preparation of aerobic granular sludge which is stable even in an environment with high concentrations of organic matter and ammonia by, while treating water in a reactor filled with activated sludge on an operating cycle including an influent step, an aeration step, a settling step, an effluent step, and an idle step at specific COD and NH4 +-N concentrations, increasing the COD and NH4 +-N concentrations stepwise with the C/N ratio maintained at 2, increasing the aeration step time, and decreasing the settling step time. The aerobic granular sludge prepared by the preparation method according to the present invention can stably remove contaminants even in an environment with a high concentration thereof, and is thus expected to increase water treatment efficiency when provided as seed sludge to a sewage treatment plant.

abstract: The present disclosure provides a continuous microbubble generating device and system and a method for production of microbubbles. The device can include an inlet port configured to receive a fluid and a gas for the generation of microbubbles. The device can include a manifold comprising a vessel configured to increase the fluid-gas interface in a directed fluid pathway to deliver the fluid and the gas. The device can include an oscillator which is configured to oscillate the vessel for agitating the fluid in order to allow for interaction between the fluid and the gas. The device can further include an outlet port and cooler configured to output the generated microbubbles.

title: COMPACT, MODULAR AND EASILY TRANSPORTABLE PHOTOBIOREACTOR
abstract: This invention relates to a photobioreactor system that purifies and improves air quality by utilizing a microalgae bioreactor with integrated LED lighting and filter system to absorb pollutants, eliminate pathogens, and release oxygen-enriched air, while providing a sustainable and scalable solution to address environmental and public health challenges. The system includes; a compressor (1) that delivers atmospheric air to the system, an air distrubition and bubble generation system having pipes that generate carbon dioxide small bubble and large bubble from air, a photocatalytic filter (2) doped with neodymium or other nanomaterials, which oxidize and reduce impurities and contaminants from atmospheric air before entering the photobioreactor (1), a separator (4) which separates the biomass from the liquid phase, collecting the biomass for storage and subsequent treatment, a lightning system (7) including LED columns positioned at a maximum distance of 30 cm from each other and equipped with cyclic programs to reduce photoinhibition, a rain-fed system (8) that uniformly and regularly feeds microalgae through nozzles using nutrients from the fed tank (5), a heating system (9) keeping the water at optimal temperature and a control panel (6) allowing to monitor operating parameters and adjusting growth conditions in real-time through a network connected platform.

title: NANO-SCALE HIGHLY-DISPERSED STRUCTURED WHITE CARBON BLACK MATERIAL AND PREPARATION METHOD THEREFOR
abstract: The present invention relates to the technical field of white carbon black materials, and relates to a nano-scale highly-dispersed structured white carbon black material and a preparation method therefor. Disclosed in the present invention is a novel nano-scale highly-dispersed structured white carbon black, which comprises 98% by weight or more of SiO2 and 2-5% by weight of free water, has a specific surface area of 120 m2/g to 390 m2/g, and has a primary particle size of < 10 nm in a primary fixed structure. Also disclosed in the present invention is a preparation method for the novel nano-scale highly-dispersed structured white carbon black, wherein the nano-scale highly-dispersed structured white carbon black is directly prepared by means of dissolution, synthesis, filtration and spraying, and the method fundamentally solves the worldwide problems of poor dispersion of white carbon black and failure in being standard-compliant in one-step synthesis which have long troubled the white carbon black industry. In addition, the process of the present invention can reduce the production cost of white carbon black by means of avoiding ultrafine processing and grinding means, and creatively produces an alternative for fumed silica.

title: ELECTROMAGNETIC REACTOR
abstract: An apparatus and method for uniformly exposing a bulk volume of particles—including free-flowing, semi-flowable, or non-flowing materials such as grains, powders, biomass, or sewage—to an electromagnetic (EM) energy field. The system ensures consistent energy distribution to all particles, irrespective of orientation or surface exposure. An electromagnetic applicator, either metallic or plasma-based, transmits EM energy into a mechanical system that cycles particles through transportation and/or fluidization zones. The reactor enables precise control of EM energy across frequencies from 30 Hz to 30 EHz to regulate both the magnitude and rate of temperature or chemical reactions. Auxiliary systems, including fluid addition, air/gas circulation, and deagglomeration, enhance the reactor's versatility by supporting processes such as heating, drying, or material modification. These integrated features allow the reactor to efficiently process diverse materials, achieving uniform energy application and consistent reaction outcomes.

title: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR RAPIDLY SOLVING SKULL-ULTRASOUND COUPLING PROBLEM IN TRANSCRANIAL FOCUSED ULTRASOUND
abstract: The present application relates to the technical field of transcranial focused ultrasound. Disclosed are a method and apparatus for rapidly solving a skull-ultrasound coupling problem in transcranial focused ultrasound. The method comprises: constructing a skull model on the basis of Biot theory, wherein the elastic and porous sound-absorbing characteristics of the skull are considered; constructing an acoustic field governing equation, and using a perfectly matched layer technique to simulate an absorbing boundary of the acoustic field in the acoustic field governing equation, wherein the perfectly matched layer technique is frequency-independent, and during frequency sweep calculation, a mass matrix and a stiffness matrix thereof only need to be formed once, thereby improving the efficiency of solving acoustic radiation and acoustic scattering problems; then, solving a skull structure-acoustic field coupled equation on the basis of skull acoustic parameters and frequencies, so as to obtain solution results; and finally, generating a training data set on the basis of the skull acoustic parameters, the frequencies and the corresponding solution results, performing training on the basis of the training data set to obtain a regression model, and inputting target skull acoustic parameters and a target frequency into the regression model, so as to obtain a target solution by means of real-time calculation, thus improving calculation efficiency.

title: METHODS AND SYSTEMS FOR RECORDING ULTRASOUND VIDEOS FOR AUTOMATED ANALYSIS BY ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE/DEEP LEARNING (AI/DL) ALGORITHMS
abstract: [0000]    Disclosed herein are computer-implemented systems and methods for recording ultrasound videos, specifically designed to facilitate automated analysis by artificial intelligence (AI) and deep learning (DL) algorithms. The method involves capturing a cine-loop (a continuous video segment) in a standardized manner to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of AI/DL algorithms in medical imaging and diagnostics. The method includes selecting an appropriate preset on the ultrasound device for a target organ, positioning a probe to center the target organ on a screen, adjusting scanning depth, enabling harmonic or spectral imaging, and scanning the target organ while recording the cine-loop with a steady, uniform motion, maintaining a constant scanning plane. The recording is saved and reviewed for quality, allowing for parameter adjustments in future scans. The method of the present disclosure improves the automated interpretation of ultrasound videos, particularly in gynecological studies, including in vitro fertilization (IVF).

title: THE ECO-FRIENDLY THREE-LAYER CONCRETE SLAB
abstract: The eco-friendly three-layer concrete slab for advanced filtration of urban polluted water and flood resilience provides a transformative solution to pressing urban challenges, including rainwater runoff and soil pollution. Unlike traditional impermeable concrete, which exacerbates flooding, or permeable alternatives that struggle with clogging and pollutant removal, this innovative design optimally enhances filtration and drainage. The top layer captures larger pollutants, while the middle layer employs additives like activated carbon, graphite, carbon nanofibers, and specialized aggregates (garnet, silica, basalt, granite, and dolomite) to effectively eliminate heavy metals, nitrates, arsenic, pharmaceuticals, and microplastics. The robust bottom layer, reinforced with polypropylene fibers, ensures structural integrity and durability, executing final filtration even in harsh environments. Designed for use as precast slabs and concrete covers for water channels, this advanced porous concrete facilitates efficient rainwater management and supports safe irrigation practices, thereby promoting sustainable agriculture and contributing to healthier ecosystems and resilient urban infrastructure.

title: APTAMER SENSOR INTERFERENCE-CORRECTION ALGORITHMS
abstract: Examples are directed to analyte sensor systems and methods of use thereof. An analyte sensor system may include an electrochemical aptamer-based biosensor configured for use in sensing a target analyte. The biosensor may include a substrate, a reversible redox probe, and an aptamer. The system may include sensor electronics configured to perform operations. The operations may include interrogating the biosensor to determine a current response, determining an adjusted current value to correct for at least one of pH or temperature, and determining an estimated analyte value for the target analyte based on the adjusted current value.

title: SELF-ADHESIVE THERMAL INDICATOR
abstract: The utility model relates to devices for thermal indicator-based monitoring, and more particularly to a self-adhesive thermal indicator with thin tabs for installation on a wire of up to 6 mm in diameter. A self-adhesive thermal indicator for visually indicating that a threshold temperature has been exceeded comprises: a flexible polymer film having a layer of pressure-sensitive adhesive applied to the rear side thereof; and, attached to the front surface of the flexible polymer film, an irreversible thermal sensitive element which has an area that is not greater than 50% of the area of the flexible polymer film and which is covered on top by a protective layer. The thickness of the flexible polymer film without the adhesive layer is not more than 75 µm, the total thickness of the flexible polymer film, the thermal sensitive element and the protective layer is not more than 200 µm, and the thermal sensitive element is situated in the centre part of the flexible polymer film. The utility model provides for increased operational reliability and safety of electrical equipment as a result of the timely detection of heat-induced faults in wires by ensuring that the adhesive label is reliably affixed and that the thermal sensitive element lies snuggly against the wire throughout the entire service life thereof, which in turn allows accurate, fast and reliable temperature monitoring.

title: WIDEBAND DETECTION MODE RFID READER
abstract: [0000]    A wide band detection mode RFID reader capable of covering all operating frequencies of an LF RFID tag. The reader device first detects a marker ID tag, identifies operating frequency of the detected ID tag, tunes the reader devices to the tag natural frequency of the detected ID tag, then reads the data stored in the detected ID tag. Matching the resonance frequency of the reader device to the detected ID tag based on instantaneous measurement ensures well coupled communication. The wide band operation of the reader device offers the possibility of building multi-frequency RFID systems that carry multiple new opportunities in the field.

title: RFID READER WITH AUTONOMOUS MARGIN TESTING AND DEBOUNCE CONTROL
abstract: [0000]    An RFID reader system is disclosed that processes radio frequency signal data received from RFID tags using antenna-level debounce logic, onboard margin testing, and continuous tuning operations. The system obtains tag response data from one or more RFID antennas and applies configurable debounce parameters on a per-antenna basis to suppress redundant tag reads. The system executes margin testing across multiple reader operating parameter states to evaluate tag readability and records performance metrics associated with each configuration state. Tag read data may be filtered during margin testing based on tag selection criteria. The system applies continuous tuning using reference tag data positioned at known locations to detect deviations and generate tuning adjustment parameters. Reader configuration parameters are updated based on the tuning results, and validated tag read events are transmitted to external systems. The reader further includes one or more status indication interfaces configured to present operational state information.

title: VARIABLE FACIAL FEATURE-BASED CLEAN-LABEL BACKDOOR ATTACK METHOD
abstract: Disclosed in the present invention is a variable facial feature-based clean-label backdoor attack method, comprising: acquiring a facial recognition dataset D1, a sub-dataset D2, and a classification neural network; training the classification neural network by means of D1 to obtain a facial recognition model; for each clean sample in the sub-dataset D2, generating an adversarial sample; embedding a backdoor trigger into the adversarial sample to generate a poisoned sample, wherein a class label of the poisoned sample is a class label of the clean sample corresponding to the poisoned sample, and all poisoned samples constitute a poisoned dataset D3; and combining D1 and D3 to train the facial recognition model to obtain a backdoored model, using any facial image to generate a poisoned sample for attack, and attacking the backdoored model. The present invention combines adversarial perturbations and facial attribute editing technology, does not depend on changing labels of training samples, but achieves implanting of a backdoor by modifying hairstyle and hair color, thereby improving the stealthiness of backdoor attacks, and also enhancing learning of trigger features by the model, thus improving the effectiveness of attacks.

title: SMART HEARING AID
abstract: The present invention relates to a smart hearing aid, a main body of which is a pair of glasses that can project keywords and key images onto lenses. The pair of glasses comprises a frame and two lenses integrated therewith. A control apparatus is provided inside a side portion of the frame, and the control apparatus comprises a smart chip and a projector. The smart chip can receive external speech, and determine and select keywords therefrom, and the projector is then used to project the "keywords" and "key images" onto the lenses, so as to allow a hearing-impaired user to accelerate their comprehension of others' speech by using the hearing aid in conjunction with the visually observable "keywords" and "key images" when the user fails to understand the meaning of others' speech using the hearing aid alone. Moreover, the smart chip can convert the received external speech into synthesized sound and transmit the synthesized sound to the user's hearing aid, so as to provide clear and noise-free dialogue sound, thereby further helping the user understand others' true intent, and facilitating the real-time communication between the user and others.

abstract: The present invention relates to a method for preparing an ethosome encapsulating a Galla Rhois extract, an ethosome encapsulating a Galla Rhois extract prepared by the method, and a functional cosmetic composition using same. The present invention provides an ethosome encapsulating a Galla Rhois extract, which is a natural material having various biological activities such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antifungal effects, as well as skin tone-improving and astringent effects, and a method for preparing same. In addition, the present invention establishes optimal conditions for preparing ethosomes containing a Galla Rhois extract, thereby providing conditions that ensure effective loading and stability of the Galla Rhois extract under various conditions such as concentration, temperature, and pH. Furthermore, when cosmetics are prepared using ethosomes encapsulating a Galla Rhois extract, the present invention provides the effect of rapid absorption deep into the skin and sustained maintenance of oil and moisture.

title: COMPOSITION FOR MITIGATING SUN DAMAGE, SUNBURN, OR BOTH
abstract: [0000]    In some aspects, the disclosure relates to a composition including niacinamide and polypodium leucotomos extract, optionally with additional photoprotective ingredients including ascorbic acid, optionally biotin, astaxanthin, bovine collagen peptides, L-glutathione, hyaluronic acid, and inositol. The composition provides rapid and measurable photoprotection, reducing UV-induced erythema by approximately 60-68% when administered 1-2 hours prior to UV exposure. Clinical studies demonstrate significant increases in minimal erythema dose (MED) with effects persisting for at least 24 hours following a single oral administration. The composition exhibits excellent formulation characteristics including superior mixability, clarity, and palatability when formulated as a beverage powder.

title: COMPOSITIONS AND METHODS FOR TREATING INFECTIONS OF IMMUNE PRIVILEGED ORGANS COMPRISING IGA
abstract: The inventions relates to Immunoglobulin A (IgA) or a pharmaceutical composition comprising IgA for use in the treatment of an infectious disease of or in an immune privileged organ, such as the eye, fetus, placenta, central nervous system (CNS) and/or testicles caused by a bacterial, fungal, viral or parasitic infection, in particular caused by bacteria of the human microbiome. IgA-coated pathogens can be addressed by FCAR+ and/or CD11c+ innate immune cells, for example by phagocytosis, or by activation of the complement system. The use of IgA or a pharmaceutical composition comprising IgA in immune privileged sites is advantageous because in contrast to IgG, IgA-coated pathogens do not trigger activation of C1q, a protein used for the controlled pruning of synapses. This prevents neuronal damage in said immune privileged organ(s), while at the same time allowing an antibody-mediated immune response in said organs.

abstract: Certain aspects of the present disclosure provide systems and techniques for seamless and secure health data sharing. An example technique includes receiving a request from a user account of a third-party health system (TPHS) to access a first-party health system (FPHS). The request includes a token indicating that the user account is authenticated with the TPHS. A second token is obtained from the TPHS and indicates a user account type. abstract: Disclosed in the present disclosure is an evaluation method for a health status of an industrial complex system based on a physical information neural network model, including: acquiring status monitoring data of an industrial complex system; building an empirical degradation model of the industrial complex system, and constructing a physical information neural network model based on the empirical degradation model, the physical information neural network model including a solution network and a dynamic network; constructing statistical features from the status monitoring data as an input, and training the physical information neural network model; and after training of the physical information neural network model is completed, performing forward reasoning by using the solution network to predict the health status of the industrial complex system. title: ADVANCED EEG ELECTRODES FOR ENHANCED SIGNAL ACQUISITION AND COMFORT IN WEARABLE DEVICES
abstract: This invention introduces advanced wearable EEG technology designed for continuous monitoring and analysis of brain activity. It addresses key challenges in signal acquisition, noise reduction, motion artifacts, and long-term user comfort through the use of flexible, soft conductive materials and an innovative electrode architecture featuring an internal cavity that ensures stable skin contact when placed over the mastoid bone behind the ear. The system supports multiple lightweight and adaptable form factors, including ear-cuffs and EEG patches suitable for overnight and extended wear. Optimized shielding, flexible materials, and user-centered mechanical design enable reliable, high-quality brainwave data capture in real-world conditions, overcoming the limitations of traditional rigid EEG systems. This platform enables continuous brainwave monitoring for applications such as cognitive research, neurofeedback, emotional state detection, mental health monitoring, and preventive healthcare. By combining comfort, adaptability, and signal reliability, this invention represents a significant advancement in wearable brain health monitoring technology.
