title: SYSTEM AND METHODS FOR ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE INFERENCE OF CELL PHENOTYPE USING AN INTEGRATED BIOSENSOR
abstract: A biosensor comprises a complementary metal-oxide semiconductor (CMOS) image sensor (CIS), wherein the CIS comprises a plurality of light sensitive diodes disposed over a silicon substrate, and one or more metal layers for interconnect disposed therein above, and wherein the silicon substrate is back-lapped to a predetermined thickness. It further comprises a microwell layer disposed over the back-lapped silicon layer having etched therein an array of microwells, each microwell having a bottom which is the back-lapped silicon substrate and is further adapted to capture therein one or more biological cells. The biosensor can be used to train an artificial intelligence (AI) engine to generate an AI model for inference or prediction of a phenotype of a biological cell captured by the biosensor. The training is performed on images from both a fluorescence microscope and the biosensor.

title: DEOXYGENATION OF OXYGEN-CONTAINING FEEDSTOCK COMPOSITION DURING FLUID CATALYTIC CRACKING PROCESS
abstract: A process for fluid catalytic cracking of a feedstock composition is disclosed. The process comprises contacting the feedstock composition with a fluid catalytic cracking catalyst composition under fluid catalytic cracking conditions. The feedstock composition comprises one or more oxygen-containing organic compounds, wherein oxygen is present in the feedstock composition in an amount of greater than 0.2 wt.% to 50 wt.% or less based on a weight of the feedstock composition. The fluid catalytic cracking catalyst composition comprises a first particle comprising fluid catalytic cracking catalyst in an amount of from 50 wt.% or more to 99.5 wt.% or less based on a weight of the fluid catalytic cracking catalyst composition and a second particle comprising a deoxygenation additive comprising a Lewis Acid-containing component in an amount of from 0.5 wt.% or more to 50 wt.% or less based on the weight of the fluid catalytic cracking catalyst composition.

title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR REMOVING OIL FROM AN OIL AND WATER EMULSION
abstract: Systems and methods for removing oil from wastewater are described herein. The systems include, at a first stage, adding a demulsifier to a wastewater stream to produce a demulsifying wastewater stream that includes an emulsion of wastewater and oil. At a second stage, the demulsifying wastewater stream is passed into a physical separation unit to physically separate and remove demulsified oil from the wastewater and produce an effluent wastewater stream. At a third stage, the effluent wastewater stream is added to an enhanced oxidation process (EOP) reactor to produce a clean water discharge stream. The EOP reactor includes a first EOP chamber and a second EOP chamber fluidly coupled in series with the first EOP chamber. The first EOP chamber receives the effluent wastewater stream and receives an ozone stream to mix with the second wastewater stream within the first chamber.

title: METHOD FOR STARTING ANAEROBIC PROCESSING TANK
abstract: The problem addressed by the present invention is to provide a method for starting an anaerobic processing tank that efficiently advances microbial adhesion to carrier surfaces and makes it possible to shorten the amount of time required to start an anaerobic processing tank.　In order to solve this problem, the present invention provides a method for starting an anaerobic processing tank, the method comprising a carrier coating step that includes: a flocculant loading step in which a flocculant is loaded into an anaerobic processing tank after the anaerobic processing tank has been filled with a carrier; and a sludge loading step in which sludge is loaded into the anaerobic processing tank after the flocculant loading step. The carrier coating step is performed multiple times.　According to the present invention, a substance that contributes to microbial adhesion is loaded in a prescribed order and the foregoing is repeated a plurality of times, thereby making it possible to produce a state in which the sludge-coated carrier is accommodated in the entire interior of the anaerobic processing tank in a short amount of time. Namely, when starting the anaerobic processing tank, microbial adhesion to carrier surfaces is efficiently advanced such that the amount of time required to start the anaerobic processing tank can be shortened.

title: METHOD FOR PREPARING RECOMBINANT HUMAN COLLAGEN
abstract: Provided is a method for preparing a recombinant human collagen. The method comprises: constructing a genetically engineered bacterium which expresses a prolyl hydroxylase and a recombinant human collagen; culturing the genetically engineered bacterium and performing digestion treatment by means of pepsin to obtain a recombinant human collagen type I or type III. The prolyl hydroxylase comprises P4Ha2, P4Hb and vP4H, and by means of controlling the ratio of the copy numbers of the genes thereof, the recombinant human collagen and a natural human collagen are consistent in hydroxylation modification. Also provided is a large-scale production method for the recombinant human collagen. The prepared recombinant human collagen has completely the same sequence composition and length and substantially the same hydroxyproline content as the natural human collagen, and also has a stable full-length triple helix structure and biological activity without immunogenicity and potential risk of viruses.

abstract: [0000]    A process for producing monomers is disclosed. title: Procédé d’étalonnage automatique d’une caméra monoculaire
abstract: La présente invention concerne un procédé de calibration extrinsèque automatique d’une caméra monoculaire, destiné à estimer sa position et son orientation dans l’espace sans recours à des dispositifs physiques de calibration. Le procédé comprend l’acquisition d’au moins une image d’une scène comprenant une surface de sol, la génération d’une carte de profondeur dense à l’aide d’un réseau de neurones profonds, la reconstruction d’un maillage tridimensionnel de la scène, l’identification d’un plan dominant correspondant au sol, et l’estimation de la pose de la caméra par rapport à ce plan. Le procédé peut être appliqué à des caméras fixes ou mobiles, et s’étend à la calibration métrique d’un modèle 3D reconstruit, notamment par redimensionnement à l’aide de paramètres extrinsèques ou de références visuelles telles que la taille moyenne d’objets détectés. Il permet également la localisation précise d’objets dans la scène par projection géométrique sur le modèle du sol. L’invention s’applique notamment aux domaines de la vidéosurveillance, de la navigation autonome, de l’analyse urbaine et de la modélisation 3D

title: HONEYCOMB CRYSTALLIZER, SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR ACCELERATED EVAPORATION, AND METHOD FOR LITHIUM EXTRACTION
abstract: A method of accelerating water evaporation comprises immersing a portion of a crystallizer into a reservoir of water containing salts to be extracted. title: INTEGRATED HYDRO-ELECTRIC ACTUATION AND THERMAL MANAGEMENT SYSTEM WITH DISTRIBUTED ELECTROLYTIC ENERGY STORAGE
abstract: A robotic power and actuation system is disclosed in which a single circulating working fluid performs hydraulic actuation, electrochemical energy storage and delivery, and thermal management functions. The system replaces conventional inert hydraulic fluids and centralized battery packs with an electrochemically active liquid electrolyte having sufficient energy density and mechanical properties to support pressurized fluid actuation. The electrolyte is circulated through a distributed conduit network within the robotic structure to drive hybrid soft and rigid actuators, supply electrical energy to distributed electrical storage or conversion elements, and absorb and transport heat away from high-power electronic components. By integrating power delivery, mechanical actuation, and thermal regulation into a unified fluid loop, the system reduces mass, improves energy utilization efficiency, enhances fault tolerance through distributed energy storage, and enables rapid replenishment of energy via fluid exchange without disassembly or system shutdown.

title: POWER MANAGEMENT SYSTEM FOR ENERGY HARVESTING APPLICATIONS AND OPERATING METHOD
abstract: According to the invention, there is provided a power management system for energy harvesting applications, comprising: - a DC-DC converter configured to transfer energy from an energy source to a storage device, - a protection system configured to prevent voltage surges at an output of the DC-DC converter, - a monitoring circuit configured to monitor a voltage at the output of the DC-DC converter and to compare it to a predetermined reference voltage that is higher than the regulation voltage of the DC-DC converter. According to the invention, the monitoring circuit is enabled only during periods of active energy harvesting. Further, the protection system remains active until the voltage at the output of the DC-DC converter falls down below the predetermined reference voltage, or until the power management system deactivates it. Thereby, the system minimizes quiescent current consumption when energy harvesting is not occurring to reduce the impact on the storage device and ensure efficient energy management. In other words, the monitoring circuit is only turned on when necessary and is turned off when the risk of voltage surge at the output of the DC-DC converter is no longer present.

title: ULTRA-EFFICIENT INTEGRATION OF GENE LIBRARIES ONTO YEAST CYTOSOLIC PLASMIDS
abstract: High-efficiency integration of genes of interest (GOIs) onto the p1 plasmid used in the OrthoRep system is achieved utilizing recombinases for site-specific recombination. This method significantly increases the efficiency and consistency of GOI integration onto p1, enabling seamless recombination in the cytoplasm of Saccharomyces cerevisiae, bypassing the inefficiencies associated with the native nuclear recombination machinery. This accelerates the process of preparing yeast cells for directed evolution experiments, and enhances the uniformity of gene library representation, which is important for exploring diverse fitness landscapes. The use of recombinases enables rapid, site-specific integration, which reduces waiting times for colony formation and increases overall throughput. Moreover, this method is not limited to a specific recombinase, but can leverage any suitable recombinase to achieve high-efficiency integration, making it versatile and broadly applicable.

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR CONTINUOUS AUTHENTICATION OF PARTICIPANTS IN COMMUNICATION SESSIONS
abstract: A computer-implemented method provides continuous authentication for a participant in a communication session. The method involves accessing a reference biometric record comprising original voice recordings of the participant and capturing a live voice sample from the participant during the session. The live voice sample is subjected to a parallel analysis, which includes a biometric comparison process to generate an authentication score and a voice liveness detection process. A potential unauthorized access event is determined based on the authentication score in comparison to an authentication threshold and a result of the voice liveness detection. Responsive to determining the potential unauthorized access event, a challenge verification procedure is automatically executed. This procedure includes transmitting a prompt for a challenge-response task, receiving a challenge voice sample, and authenticating the challenge voice sample to generate a challenge result. An authentication status of the participant is then modified based on the challenge result.

The frozen hydrogel structure may be dried to form a polyacrylamide-based aerogel structure.

title: QUANTIZATION OFFSET OPTIMIZATION FOR LEARNED IMAGE COMPRESSION
abstract: Methods and systems for quantization offset optimization for learned image compression. A method includes receiving an image and mapping the image to a latent representation. The method also includes generating a quantized representation by quantizing the latent representation. The method then includes generating a bitstream by encoding the quantized representation using entropy encoding. The method further includes mapping the latent representation to a hyperprior representation to generate a hyper latent representation. The method additionally includes generating a quantized hyper latent representation by quantizing the hyper latent representation. The method also includes generating an offset latent representation by applying an offset to the quantized hyper latent representation. The method further includes decoding the bitstream using the offset latent representation to generate a reconstructed image.
assignee: SAMSUNG ELECTRONICS CO LTD [KR]; Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd.
inventors: NI SAIFENG [US]; BUDAGAVI MADHUKAR [US]; SINHAROY INDRANIL [US] et al.

title: DEVICE AND METHOD FOR INDEX CODING AND BEAMFORMING OPTIMIZATION BETWEEN WIRELESS APPARATUSES
abstract: The present invention relates to a device and method for index coding and beamforming optimization between wireless apparatuses. The device comprises a processor for executing an optimization program, wherein the program determines an index coding behavior and a beamforming design behavior, which minimize a transmission time between the wireless apparatuses, by inputting state information about the wireless apparatuses to a reinforcement learning model. The model includes a first level agent for determining whether each wireless apparatus performs index coding and determining, as the index coding behavior, the type of an index coding method to be used in the index coding, and a second level agent for determining, as the beamforming design behavior, an optimal beamformer design plan of each wireless apparatus in consideration of the index coding behavior determined by the first level agent.
assignee: SEOUL NATIONAL UNIV R&DB FOUNDATION [KR]; 서울대학교산학협력단
inventors: CHOI WAN [KR]; 최완

title: LOSS FUNCTION OPTIMIZATION SYSTEM FOR 3D MEDICAL IMAGE SEGMENTATION DEEP LEARNING MODEL
abstract: A loss function optimization system for a 3D medical image segmentation deep learning model, according to the present invention, comprises: an image input unit for receiving an input of a 3D medical image; a masking unit for masking a partial region of the input 3D medical image; a deep learning model unit for performing masked image modeling mechanism deep learning on the masked 3D medical image by using a deep learning model; a pixel area reconstruction unit that calculates a pixel-based loss function during learning of the deep learning model unit and performs backpropagation; a frequency domain reconstruction unit that calculates a frequency-based loss function during learning of the deep learning model unit and performs backpropagation; a loss function optimization unit that calculates a spectral distance scaling loss function in which the pixel-based loss function and the frequency-based loss function are combined, and performs backpropagation on the deep learning model of the deep learning model unit; and a pre-trained model generation unit for generating a pre-trained model that has been trained through the spectral distance scaling loss function.
assignee: INDUSTRY FOUNDATION OF CHONNAM NATIONAL UNIV [KR]; 전남대학교산학협력단
inventors: KIM JIN-YEONG [KR]; YU GWANG-HYUN [KR]; LE HOANG-ANH [KR] et al.

title: ACCELERATOR KERNEL AUTOTUNER FOR SPARSE HYPERPARAMETER SPACES
abstract: [0000]    Effective kernel hyperparameters can be determined by an autotuner configured explore the entire hyperparameter space. A main process of the autotuner divides the hyperparameter space into batches, while worker processes determine batch-leading hyperparameter combinations for the batches along with a performance metrics for each batch-leading hyperparameter combination. The batch-leading hyperparameter combination for a given batch can be determined using an optimization tool which receives performance metrics for an initial sample set of valid hyperparameter combinations of the given batch and applies an optimization technique to select additional hyperparameter combinations of the given batch for evaluation. The number of hyperparameter combinations in the initial sample set and the number of additional hyperparameters to select for evaluation can be input as tuning settings of the autotuner. The main process receives the batch-leading hyperparameter combinations for the batches and compares their performance metrics to determine an overall-leading hyperparameter combination for the kernel.
assignee: MICROSOFT TECH LICENSING LLC [US]; Microsoft Technology Licensing, LLC
inventors: DAS RITWIK [US]; DAS, Ritwik

title: DYNAMIC VECTOR GUIDED DEPTH LIMITED GRAPH TRAVERSAL SYSTEM AND METHOD WITH ADAPTIVE RESOURCE OPTIMIZATION
abstract: [0000]    A system and method for due diligence optimization facilitates risk assessment in transactions by receiving subscriber health assessment data, extracting features via machine learning, and generating risk scores for matching buyers and sellers. The method employs a centralized platform with natural language processing and distributed ledger for secure data exchange. Enhancements include dynamic vector-guided depth-limited graph traversal for hierarchical question structures: generating query embeddings, retrieving node embeddings via HNSW indexing (M=16 links, ef_construction=200), computing cosine similarities, determining adaptive depth D using logarithmic formula based on relevance, pre-warming CPU cache, executing bounded traversal with lazy loading, and returning single-response results.
assignee: ACCUDILIGENCE INC [US]; ACCUDILIGENCE INC
inventors: JANNAK TORPUM [US]; JANNAK NANTHAWAN [US]; Jannak, Torpum et al.

title: POLICY SET FEATURE GUIDED NODE LEVEL PARTITIONING FOR POLICY SEARCH TREE OPTIMIZATION
abstract: Approaches policy set feature guided node level partitioning for policy search tree optimization are disclosed. A set of policy bins is generated by creating equal-width bins on a given dimension. An original policy set is scanned to determine a number of policies falling into each policy bin in the set of policy bins. An original policy set characteristic is measured based on the number of policies falling into each policy bin. Parameters that represent relationships between the policy set and another policy set are determined based on a number of policies falling into each policy bin and the policy set characteristic. A new policy set is generated based on the parameters. A new policy search tree is generated based on a new policy set. The new policy search tree provides improved build cost or improved search cost as compared a search tree based on the original policy set.
assignee: FORTINET INC [US]; Fortinet, Inc.
inventors: WEN SHUSHAN [US]; WEI TIANRUI [US]; XU KEVIN JUNCHENG [US] et al.

title: METHOD FOR MANUFACTURING WOVEN TERRY FABRIC USING TWO-FOR-ONE TWISTING METHOD
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing a high-performance woven terry fabric. The manufacturing method can greatly improve the productivity of high-performance woven terry fabrics, which have been difficult to mass-produce, and at the same time, can minimize the occurrence of pilling caused by friction, thereby reducing the defect rate. In addition, a woven terry fabric manufactured by the manufacturing method can maintain a high quality even in a mass production environment. By maximizing productivity through a pile yarn manufacturing process using a two-for-one twisting method, high-quality products can be mass-produced while reducing manufacturing costs, and thus market competitiveness can be enhanced.
assignee: BIZLINK CO LTD [KR]; 주식회사 비즈링크
inventors: LEE KWANHEE [KR]; LEE JONGSEOK [KR]; 이관희 et al.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR FEDERATED AI-DRIVEN CONTROL AND OPTIMIZATION IN HYBRID CLOUD ENVIRONMENTS
abstract: [0000]    The present disclosure provides a system for federated artificial intelligence driven control and optimization in hybrid cloud environments comprising private cloud infrastructures and public cloud infrastructures. The system enables multiple distributed computing nodes to locally train artificial intelligence models using operational data retained within each node, thereby preventing transfer of raw data across cloud boundaries. Locally trained model parameters are securely transmitted to a coordination processor that authenticates and aggregates the parameters to generate a federated global model representation. The aggregated model representation is deployed back to participating computing nodes and is utilized to generate control outputs for adaptive workload scheduling, resource allocation, scaling, and migration across the hybrid cloud environments. Policy enforcement mechanisms ensure adherence to data locality rules, security constraints, and cloud-specific resource utilization policies during training, aggregation, and deployment.
assignee: KUMAR MANISH [US]; MEDIKONDA NARENDRA BALAJI [US]; KUMAR Manish et al.
inventors: KUMAR MANISH [US]; MEDIKONDA NARENDRA BALAJI [US]; KUMAR, Manish et al.

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR COMPLETE UTILIZATION OF COMBUSTIBLE WASTE WITH ELECTRICITY GENERATION AND ASH VITRIFICATION
abstract: This invention relates to a method and system for complete utilization of combustible waste with electricity generation and ash vitrification, which will find application in the field of thermal power generation, in particular for incineration of municipal solid waste, of end-of-life tyres, and of organic waste, for small-scale power generation, and for obtaining granular vitrified inert material.With the established method and system for the complete utilization of combustible municipal solid waste and tyres used as secondary fuel RDF or TDF, a closed waste-free production is ensured, with minimized risk of toxic emissions polluting the atmosphere. In addition, the volume of waste is reduced, electricity generation is increased, and an environmentally friendly vitrified granular product is produced instead of ash and slag. The resulting glass granular product can be used as a building material in road, civil and industrial construction, in the production of building materials and thermal insulation.
assignee: ABEX GREEN ENERGY LTD [BG]; SIMONSKI KRASIMIR YORDANOV [BG]; Abex Green Energy Ltd. et al.
inventors: SIMONSKI KRASIMIR YORDANOV [BG]; SHIRYAEVSKY VALERY LEONARDOVICH [RU]; Simonski, Krasimir Yordanov et al.

title: Zusammensetzung mit einem Zellkulturextrakt aus Bacillus subtilis zur Formung von Haaren
abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft eine kosmetische Zusammensetzung zur Formung von Haaren umfassend mindestens ein filmbildendes Polymer; und einen Zellkulturextrakt aus Bacillus subtilis. Die Erfindung betrifft außerdem die Verwendung dieser Zusammensetzung zur Formung von Haaren und zur Vermeidung von Schuppenbildung auf der Kopfhaut.

title: COMPOSITION FOR ORAL HYGIENE PRODUCTS COMPRISING N-CETYLPYRIDINIUM CHLORIDE, A FLAVONOID AND A POLYMER
abstract: [0001]    Eine Zusammensetzung, insbesondere zur Prophylaxe und/oder Behandlung von Karies, Gingivitis, Halitosis und/oder Arteriosklerose, umfasst N-Cetylpyridiniumchlorid, mindestens ein Flavonoid, mindestens ein Polymer, im Besonderen ein Homopolymer, umfassend mindestens ein Monomer mit einer polaren funktionellen Gruppe, insbesondere Polylysin, und optional Chlorhexidin, wobei das Gewichtsverhältnis zwischen Chlorhexidin und N-Cetylpyridiniumchlorid zwischen 0 bis 7, insbesondere zwischen 0.01 bis 6, speziell zwischen 0.1 bis 5 im Speziellen zwischen 0.2 bis 4, beispielsweise zwischen 0.4 bis 3.2, liegt.

title: METHOD FOR INTERCONNECTING PHOTOVOLTAIC CELLS BY CONTACT BETWEEN TWO ASSEMBLIES
abstract: [0001]    La présente invention concerne un procédé d'interconnexion de cellules photovoltaïques (4), chacune comportant des doigts de collecte, caractérisé en ce qu'il comporte les étapes successives suivantes : positionnement d'une pluralité de cellules photovoltaïques (4), selon des rangées transversales au contact de premiers fils métalliques (F1) d'un premier assemblage avant (A1), ou au contact de deuxièmes fils métalliques (F2) d'un deuxième assemblage arrière (A2), formant des rangées transversales de cellules photovoltaïques (4) interconnectées en série, les extrémités des premiers fils métalliques (F1) étant reliés à des premiers éléments de connectique (e1) et les extrémités des deuxièmes fils métalliques (F2) étant reliés à des deuxièmes éléments de connectique (e2) ; mise en contact du premier assemblage avant (A1) et du deuxième assemblage arrière (A2) pour la mise en connexion électrique des premiers éléments de connectique (e1) et des deuxièmes éléments de connectique (e2) formant des rangées longitudinales de cellules photovoltaïques (4) interconnectées en parallèle.

title: COMPOSITION FOR UNDERFILL AND METHOD FOR MANUFACTURING THE SAME
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a composition for underfill and a method for manufacturing the same, in which spherically and temporarily fixed high-thermal-conductivity shape-memory polymer composite particles are applied to the underfill, maintaining low viscosity during the filling process, and, at curing temperature, the particles are restored to a high aspect ratio shape to form a thermally conductive network between ceramics, thereby simultaneously achieving low filling viscosity and high heat dissipation performance.

inventors: KIM SEONG SU [KR]; LEE MINGEUN [KR]; CHO DONGHYEON [KR] et al.

title: SEMICONDUCTOR DEVICE
abstract: [0001]    A semiconductor device includes a capacitor structure (CAP), a buried contact (BC) on the capacitor structure (CAP), a hollow semicylindrical-shaped vertical channel layer (140) extending on the buried contact (BC) in a vertical direction (Z) and having an inner wall and an outer wall, a hollow semicylindrical-shaped gate dielectric layer (150) surrounding the outer wall of the vertical channel layer (140) and having an inner wall and an outer wall, word lines (WL) spaced apart from each other in a first horizontal direction (X) and extending in a second horizontal direction intersecting the first horizontal direction (X), a semicylindrical-shaped direct contact (DC) in contact with the inner wall of the vertical channel layer (140), and a bit line (BL) having a post (183) in contact with an upper surface of the direct contact (DC) and extending in the first horizontal direction (X). One of the word lines (WL) is in contact with the outer wall of the gate dielectric layer (150).

title: ANZEIGEVORRICHTUNG
abstract: Eine Anzeigevorrichtung umfasst ein unteres Substrat mit einem darauf angeordneten Dünnschichttransistor, ein oberes Substrat, das über dem unteren Substrat angeordnet ist, mehrere Kontaktstellenelektroden, die in einem nicht aktiven Bereich des unteren Substrats angeordnet sind, ein Loch, das sich durch das untere Substrat von einer unteren Oberfläche des unteren Substrats in Richtung einer Kontaktstellenelektrode unter den mehreren Kontaktstellenelektroden erstreckt, und einen flexiblen Film, der mit der Kontaktstellenelektrode durch eine leitfähige Schicht gekoppelt ist, die im Loch angeordnet ist. Folglich wird die Breite der vorderen Kante minimiert oder verringert, ohne das Substrat umzudrehen, so dass die Zunahme des Reflexionsvermögens des Anzeigefeldes und die Verschlechterung der Steifigkeit der Anzeigeeinheit aufgrund des Umdrehens des Substrats unterdrückt werden können.

title: Barriereschichtlaminat sowie Verfahren zu seiner Herstellung und Verwendung
abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft Barriereschichtlaminat (10) mit einem dreischichtigen Aufbau, wobei zwischen zwei, vorzugsweise materialidentische, Polyolefinschichten (20) eine Barrierematerialschicht (30) bestehend aus einer Mischung von Ethylenvinylalkoholcopolymer (EVOH) und Butandiolvinylalkoholcopolymer (BVOH) eingebettet ist sowie ferner ein Verfahren zur Herstellung des Barriereschichtlaminats (10) und dessen Verwendung zur Herstellung eines Verpackungslaminats mit Barriereschicht und/oder zur Herstellung einer Verpackung.

title: METHOD FOR MANUFACTURING SEMICONDUCTOR THIN FILM COMPRISING TELLURIUM OXIDE ALLOYED WITH SULFUR ATOM AND HETERO ATOM
abstract: [0001]    Disclosed is a method for manufacturing semiconductor thin film comprising tellurium oxide alloyed with sulfur atom and hetero atom. According to the present disclosure, by using a sulfur atom and controlling the annealing of the semiconductor thin film, a thin film transistor can be provided that comprises a semiconductor thin film exhibiting excellent output and transfer characteristics and superior electrical performance, with a high hole field-effect mobility and a high on/off current ratio of about 10<7>.

title: MULTI-MATERIAL EXTRUSION PRINTING
abstract: Printing head (1) for 3D semi-solid extrusion printing, comprising:- a printing head housing (5) comprising a nozzle (4);- a plurality of upstream channels (2) arranged to transport semi-solid material from a source (11) towards a corresponding progression actuator (7) during use;- a plurality of progression actuators (7) arranged to drive semi-solid material during use;- a multi-channel body (8) that is releasably provided in the printing head housing- wherein the multi-channel body is at least tapered towards the nozzle;- wherein the printing head further comprises a plurality of ducts (9) formed by the multi-channel body and the printing head housing;- wherein each upstream channel of the plurality of upstream channels is in fluid connection with the nozzle via a corresponding transport channel (3) arranged to transport a semi-solid material during use,- wherein each transport channel comprises a corresponding progression actuator and a corresponding duct such that, during use, semi-solid material present in each upstream channel is transported in a corresponding transport channel towards the nozzle.

title: METHOD OF MANUFACTURING A PHOTONIC INTEGRATED CIRCUIT AND PHOTONIC INTEGRATED CIRCUIT
abstract: The invention relates to a method of manufacturing a photonic integrated circuit, comprising: providing a wafer comprising a first layer (S1); coating the first layer with a soft resist (S2); patterning a pattern for one or more photonic components on the soft resist (S4); and dry etching the one or more photonic components in the first layer (S6).

title: MULTILAYER LAMINATED FILM
abstract: [0001]    Die Erfindung betrifft eine mehrschichtige Verbundfolie 1 mit wenigstens einer Deckschicht 2 und einer elektrisch leitfähigen Funktionsschicht 4. Die Funktionsschicht 4 ist zumindest stellenweise durch wenigstens eine Trennfolie 8 von wenigstens einer an die Funktionsschicht 4 unmittelbar angrenzenden Schicht der Verbundfolie 1 beabstandet und trennbar.

title: PROTECTION DEVICE FOR A CERAMIC TILE CONVEYOR LINE
abstract:
[0001]    The protection device (1) is associated with a coating head (100) from a calibrated slot (101) of which a laminar veil (V) of ceramic glaze continuously falls, which uniformly covers ceramic tiles (3), fed by a conveyor line (2) with belts (20), arranged in a row and spaced apart from each other by an empty space (K).
[0002]    The protection device (1) prevents the sections of belts (20) that remain uncovered in said empty spaces (K) from being soiled, by means of at least one battery (4) equipped with a number of nozzles (40) fed with compressed air equal to that of the belts (20). Said nozzles (40) are each equipped with a device (41) for instantaneous opening/closing of the jet, are facing the laminar veil (V) and are arranged above and aligned with the belts 20.
[0003]    By means of sensors (6), positioned upstream of the coating head (100), each empty space (K) between two consecutive ceramic tiles (3) is detected, as well as the front (3A) and rear (3P) transversal side of the same; the signals supplied by the aforementioned sensors (6) go to an electronic control unit (7), which opens, with suitable synchronism, the compressed air jet of all the nozzles (40), at the beginning of the transit of each empty space (K) under the aforementioned laminar veil (V), then, at the end, their instantaneous closure. In this phase, the air jets intercept pre-established portions (PV) of the laminar veil (V), so that they do not settle on the belts (20), but are deviated towards the sides of the latter.
assignee: AIR POWER GROUP S R L [IT]; Air Power Group S.r.l.
inventors: FRIGNANI CRISTIAN [IT]; LANDINI RICCARDO [IT]; FRIGNANI, Cristian et al.

title: RETROREFLECTIVE SHEET COMPRISING EMBEDDED MICROSPHERES
abstract: [0001]    This disclosure relates to a retroreflective sheet comprising, in order, a top film layer, a binder layer, a spacer layer, and a metal-based reflective layer. The retroreflective sheet comprises a plurality of microspheres which are partially embedded in the spacer layer, penetrate the binder layer, and reach into the top film layer. The binder layer is provided with a white colorant.

title: Sensor zur Analyse von chemischen Stoffen mittels Infrarot-Absorptionsanalyse
abstract: Sensor mit einem Gehäuse (10), einem im Gehäuse (10) angeordneten, für Infrarotstrahlung durchlässig eingerichteten Fenster (20, 20´), einer aus dem Gehäuse (10) durch das Fenster (20, 20´) in die Umgebung des Sensors Infrarotstrahlung (IR) abgebenden IR-Strahlungsquelle (30), einem Infrarotstrahlung detektierenden IR-Sensorelement (75) und einem zwischen dem Fenster (20, 20´) und dem Sensorelement (75) angeordneten, dem Sensorelement (75) durch das Fenster (20, 20´) eingetretene und/oder am Fenster (20, 20´) reflektierte Strahlung zuführenden Strahlungsleiter (60, 60´, 60´´), dadurch gekennzeichnet, dass der Strahlungsleiter (60, 60´, 60´´) als Hohlleiter ausgebildet ist, dessen Innenfläche eine Beschichtung mit einem hochreflektierenden Material aufweist.

inventors: GIESE ERHARD [DE]; Giese, Erhard

title: Mikromechanisches Bauteil für eine kapazitive Sensor- und/oder Aktorvorrichtung
abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft ein mikromechanisches Bauteil für eine kapazitive Sensor- und/oder Aktorvorrichtung mit mindestens zwei ersten Elektroden (10), wobei jede der ersten Elektroden (10) zumindest je einen elektrisch-leitfähigen ersten Elektrodenbereich (10a) umfasst, und mindestens zwei zweiten Elektroden(12), wobei jede der zweiten Elektroden (12) zumindest je einen elektrisch-leitfähigen zweiten Elektrodenbereich (12a) umfasst, und wobei jede der zweiten Elektroden (12) zusätzlich zu ihrem elektrisch-leitfähigen zweiten Elektrodenbereich (12a) noch zumindest je einen elektrisch-leitfähigen dritten Elektrodenbereich (12b) und je einen zwischen ihrem zweiten Elektrodenbereich (12a) und ihrem dritten Elektrodenbereich (12b) liegenden Isolierbereich (12c) umfasst, und die ersten Elektrodenbereiche (10a), die zweiten Elektrodenbereiche (12a) und die dritten Elektrodenbereiche (12b) über eine elektrische Kontaktiereinrichtung derart elektrisch kontaktierbar sind, dass ein erstes Differenzspannungssignal von einem zwischen den ersten Elektrodenbereichen (10a) und den zweiten Elektrodenbereichen (12a) anliegenden ersten Spannungssignal und einem zwischen den ersten Elektrodenbereichen (10a) und den dritten Elektrodenbereichen (12b) anliegenden zweiten Spannungssignal abgreifbar oder anlegbar ist.
assignee: BOSCH GMBH ROBERT [DE]; Robert Bosch Gesellschaft mit beschränkter Haftung
inventors: FRIEDRICH THOMAS [DE]; GOWDA HITESH GOWDA BETTASWAMY [DE]; Friedrich, Thomas et al.

title: Induktive Anregungs- und/oder Ausleseeinheit für einen Sensor für eine Batterie und/oder eine Batterieumgebung, Gehäuseanordnung, Messanordnung und Batterie für ein Kraftfahrzeug
abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft eine induktive Anregungs- und/oder Ausleseeinheit (20) für einen Sensor (24) für eine Batterie (16), wobei die Anregungs- und/oder Ausleseeinheit (20) eine Koppelspule (36) umfasst, und ein elektrisch an die Koppelspule (36) angeschlossenes Anschlusspaar (50) mit einem ersten und zweiten elektrischen Kontaktelement (50a, 50b). Dabei ist vorgesehen, dass die Anregungs- und/oder Ausleseeinheit (20) einen Kunststoffkörper (52) umfasst, der eine erste Seite (52a) und eine der ersten Seite (52a) bezüglich einer ersten Richtung (z) gegenüberliegende zweite Seite (52b) aufweist, wobei die Koppelspule (36) in den Kunststoffkörper (52) eingebettet ist und zumindest ein Teil des jeweiligen ersten und zweiten elektrischen Kontaktelements (50a, 50b) an der ersten Seite (52a) des Kunststoffkörpers (52) zur Bereitstellung eines elektrischen Steckanschlusses aus diesem heraussteht.
assignee: AUDI AG [DE]; AUDI Aktiengesellschaft
inventors: FRANK PAUL [DE]; STOLL OLIVER [DE]; Frank, Paul et al.

title: Vorrichtung zum Erfassen der Anschluss-Position
abstract: Eine Anschluss-Position-Erfassungsvorrichtung (200) zum Erfassen einer inkorrekten Positionierung eines Anschlusses (120) in einem Steckverbinder (100) umfasst einen Vorrichtungskörper (210) mit einer Steckverbinderkammer (214), die zur Aufnahme des Steckverbinders ausgelegt ist. Die Anschluss-Position-Erfassungsvorrichtung umfasst einen Anschluss-Sensor (300) an der Steckverbinderkammer. Der Anschluss-Sensor ist so konfiguriert, dass er betriebsmäßig mit dem Steckverbinder in der Steckverbinderkammer verbunden ist. Der Anschluss-Sensor kann durch induktives Erfassen durch ein Gehäuse (110) des Steckverbinders das Vorhandensein oder Fehlen des Anschlusses im Steckverbinder erfassen, um die korrekte oder inkorrekte Positionierung des Anschlusses im Steckverbinder zu bestimmen.
assignee: AMP AMERMEX S A DE C V [MX]; TE CONNECTIVITY SOLUTIONS GMBH [CH]; AMP Amermex, S.A. de C.V. et al.
inventors: ROSAS GARCIA JOSE MANUEL [MX]; ROMERO JUAN CARLOS [MX]; LIEW YIYANG [US] et al.

title: THERMOMANAGEMENTSYSTEM FÜR EIN ELEKTROFAHRZEUG
abstract: Ein Thermomanagementsystem (100) für ein Elektrofahrzeug wird offenbart. Das System (100) umfasst einen Wärmetauscher (110), mindestens einen Sensor (120), eine Vielzahl von Düsen (140) und ein Steuergerät (130). Der Wärmetauscher (110) ist schräg zur Längsrichtung (X-X) des Elektrofahrzeugs ausgerichtet. Der mindestens eine Sensor (120) ist geeignet, die Temperatur des Wärmetauschers (110) zu erfassen. Die Steuereinheit (130) ist kommunikativ mit dem mindestens einen Sensor (120) gekoppelt und operativ mit der Vielzahl von Düsen (140) verbunden, um ein Kühlmittel (C) in Richtung des Wärmetauschers (110) zu sprühen, wenn die von der mindestens einen Düse (120) erfasste Temperatur über einer vordefinierten Schwelle liegt. Das System (100) macht zusätzliche Wärmetauscher überflüssig, indem es eine Vielzahl von Düsen an einer strategischen Stelle im Fahrzeug einsetzt und außerdem die winklig ausgerichteten Wärmetauscher benetzt.

title: Flammendetektor zur strahlungsbasierten Detektion einer Flamme und Verfahren zu dessen Herstellung
abstract: Ein Flammendetektor zum Detektieren einer Flamme (20) umfasst einen Wellenleiter (110) mit einem ersten Ende (111) und einem zweiten Ende (112), wobei das erste Ende (111) ausgebildet ist, um thermisch an die Flamme (20) zu koppeln, und der Wellenleiter (110) ausgebildet ist, um eine elektromagnetische Strahlung (40) von dem ersten Ende (111) zu dem zweiten Ende (112) zu leiten, einen Sensor (130), der ausgebildet ist, um elektromagnetische Strahlung (40) zu detektieren; und eine Sensorbefestigung (135) zum Befestigen des Sensors (130) an dem zweiten Ende (111) des Wellenleiters (110), wobei eine Länge (L) des Wellenleiters (110) so gewählt ist, dass der Sensor (130) von der Flamme (20) thermische entkoppelt ist.
assignee: TECHNISCHE UNIV DARMSTADT KOERPERSCHAFT DES OEFFENTLICHEN RECHTS [DE]; Technische Universität Darmstadt Körperschaft des öffentlichen Rechts

title: FLAMMENDETEKTOR ZUR SCHWINGUNGSBASIERTEN DETEKTION EINER FLAMME UND VERFAHREN ZU DESSEN HERSTELLUNG
abstract: Ein Flammendetektor zum Detektieren einer Flamme (20) umfasst: ein Schwingungselement (110), einem Aktuator (120), eine Aktuatorbefestigung (130) und einen Sensor (140). Das Schwingungselement (110) weist einen ersten Abschnitt (111) und einen zweiten Abschnitt (112) auf und ist ausgebildet, um den ersten Abschnitt (111) thermisch an die Flamme (20) zu koppeln und den zweiten Abschnitt (112) thermisch von der Flamme (20) zu entkoppeln. Der Aktuator (120) dient zum Anregen von Schwingungen in dem Schwingungselement (110). Die Aktuatorbefestigung (130) dient zur Befestigung des Aktuators (120) an einer vorbestimmten Position entlang des Schwingungselementes (110). Der Sensor (140) dient zum Detektieren der Schwingungen in dem Schwingungselement (110) an dem zweiten Abschnitt (112) des Schwingungselements (110), wobei die detektierten Schwingungen einen Zustand der Flamme (20) anzeigen.

title: Vorrichtung und Verfahren zum Ermitteln eines Transmissions- und/oder Reflexionsverhaltens eines Optikelements
abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft eine Vorrichtung (15) zum Ermitteln eines Transmissions- und/oder Reflexionsverhaltens zumindest eines Optikelements, insbesondere Spiegel (M1-M10) eines mehrere Optikelemente, eine Bildebene (9) und eine Objektebene (5) aufweisenden Objektivs (7), insbesondere EUV-Objektivs, mit wenigstens einer Lichtquelle (2) und mit wenigstens einem Sensor (16,17), und mit einem Nutzstrahlengang (N). Es ist vorgesehen, dass zumindest ein optisches Testelement (18,19) der Vorrichtung (15) in der Objektebene (5) oder in der Bildebene (8) angeordnet oder anordenbar ist, und dass das Testelement (18,19) derart ausgebildet ist, dass es in der Objektebene (5) oder der Bildebene (9) einen Teststrahlengang (T1,T2) erzeugt, durch den durch das zumindest eine Optikelement beeinflusstes Licht der Lichtquelle (2) zu dem zumindest einen, außerhalb des Nutzstrahlengangs (N) liegenden Sensor (16,17) geleitet wird.

title: Kontrollsystem für ein Kraftfahrzeug und Verfahren zu dessen Betrieb
abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft ein Kontrollsystem (2) für ein Kraftfahrzeug, mit einem ersten Steuergerät (4) zur Kontrolle einer Funktion des Kraftfahrzeugs und einem zweiten Steuergerät (6) zur Kontrolle derselben Funktion, wobei das erste und das zweite Steuergerät (4, 6) jeweils mit mindestens einem Sensor (12, 14, 20, 22, 40, 42) und mindestens einem Aktor (8, 10, 16, 18) zur Ausführung dieser Funktion signalübertragend verbunden sind, wobei das Kontrollsystem (2) derart ausgebildet ist, dass die vorgenannte Funktion in einem fehlerfreien Normalbetrieb des Kontrollsystems (2) mittels des ersten und des zweiten Steuergeräts (4, 6) gemeinschaftlich ausführbar ist und in Abhängigkeit eines Eingangs eines Fehlersignals eines fehlerhaften Steuergeräts (4) bei dem fehlerfreien Steuergerät (6) dieses derart automatisch konfigurierbar ist, dass der zu dem fehlerhaften Steuergerät (4) korrespondierende Sensor (12, 14, 40, 42) und der zu dem fehlerhaften Steuergerät korrespondierende Aktor (8, 10) zwecks Ausführung der Funktion allein mittels dieses fehlerfreien Steuergeräts (6) kontrollierbar ist.
assignee: HELLA GMBH & CO KGAA [DE]; HELLA GmbH & Co. KGaA

title: Verfahren zum Justieren eines optoelektronischen Sensors
abstract: Die vorliegende Erfindung betrifft ein Verfahren zum Justieren eines optoelektronischen Sensors, welcher zum Erfassen von Objekten in einem Überwachungsbereich eingerichtet ist und eine Sendeanordnung zum Aussenden von Sendelichtsignalen entlang eines Sendelichtpfads in den Überwachungsbereich und eine Empfangsanordnung mit einem Lichtempfänger und mit zumindest einer Empfangsoptik umfasst. Der Lichtempfänger weist eine lichtempfindliche Fläche auf. Die Empfangsoptik ist dazu eingerichtet, Empfangslichtsignale, die von einem im Überwachungsbereich anwesenden Objekt durch Remission auftreffender Sendelichtsignale erzeugt werden und sich zwischen dem Objekt und dem Lichtempfänger entlang eines Empfangslichtpfads ausbreiten, in einen Empfangslichtfleck zu fokussieren. Die Sendeanordnung und die Empfangsanordnung sind biaxial zueinander angeordnet, sodass der Auftreffort des Empfangslichtflecks auf dem Lichtempfänger vom Abstand eines erfassten Objekts von dem Sensor abhängt. Die Sendeanordnung und/oder die Empfangsanordnung werden derart ausgerichtet, dass der Empfangslichtfleck nur zu einem Teil auf die lichtempfindliche Fläche trifft, wenn der Abstand eines erfassten Objekts von dem Sensor kleiner ist als ein vorgegebener Abstandsschwellenwert.
assignee: SICK AG [DE]; SICK AG
inventors: STEIN PATRICK [DE]; KRÄMER JOACHIM [DE]; BREINDL MICHAEL [DE] et al.

title: Magnetische Messanordnung
abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft eine magnetische Messanordnung (10) zur Bewegungserfassung eines linear entlang einer Längsrichtung (x) beweglichen Bauteils (12), mit einer Magnetvorrichtung (14), welche mindestens einen Permanentmagneten (14A, 14B) umfasst und mit dem linear beweglichen Bauteil (12) verbunden ist, mindestens zwei redundanten Sensoren (16), welche in Längsrichtung (x) einen vorgegebenen Abstand (AB) zueinander aufweisen und ausgeführt sind, innerhalb eines vorgegebenen Messbereichs (MB) mindestens eine magnetische Größe zu erfassen und korrespondierende Sensorsignale mit unterschiedlichen Signalqualitäten auszugeben, und einer Auswerte- und Steuereinheit (18), wobei ein erster Sensor (16A) der mindestens zwei redundanten Sensoren (16) ein sich über den Messbereich (MB) wiederholendes erstes Sensorsignal mit einer höheren Signalqualität ausgibt und ein zweiter Sensor (16B) der mindestens zwei redundanten Sensoren (16) ein sich über den Messbereich (MB) nicht wiederholendes zweites Sensorsignal mit einer niedrigeren Signalqualität ausgibt, wobei die Auswerte- und Steuereinheit (18) ausgeführt ist, durch Kombinieren der Sensorsignale der mindestens zwei redundanten Sensoren (16) eine aktuelle Position des linear beweglichen Bauteils (12) innerhalb des vorgegebenen Messbereichs (MB) eindeutig zu bestimmen.

title: Verfahren zur Vermessung der Geometrie einer Schrägverzahnung
abstract: Die vorliegende Erfindung zeigt ein Verfahren zur Vermessung der Geometrie einer Schrägverzahnung, bei welchem ein Sensor entlang mindestens eines Messpfades über eine Zahnflanke der Verzahnung geführt wird, um die Geometrie der Zahnflanke entlang des Messpfades an einer Mehrzahl von Punkten zu vermessen, wobei sich der Messpfad zumindest in einem Teilbereich schräg über die Zahnflanke erstreckt, so dass er einen Eingriffsbereich auf der Zahnflanke über mindestens 50 % seiner Erstreckung in Profilrichtung und in Flankenlinienrichtung überstreicht.

title: Verfahren zum Betreiben eines Tanksystems sowie Steuergerät
abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft ein Verfahren zum Betreiben eines mobilen Tanksystems (1) für ein Brenngas, insbesondere für Wasserstoff oder Erdgas, umfassend mindestens einen Druckgasbehälter (2), in dem das Brenngas unter Druck gespeichert wird, sowie ein Steuergerät (3), mit dessen Hilfe Sensordaten aus mindestens einem im Tanksystem (1) verbauten Sensor (4) ausgelesen und ausgewertet werden. Erfindungsgemäß wird in Phasen, in denen das Tanksystem (1) außer Betrieb ist, das Steuergerät (3) über eine implementierte Weckfunktion zeitweise aktiviert und zur Durchführung einer Leckageprüfung verwendet.

title: Fahrzeug mit einem Sensorreinigungssystem

title: VERFAHREN UND SYSTEM ZUR ECHTZEIT-PFADGENERIERUNG FÜR DAS ABBIEGEN EINES ROBOTERS
abstract: Ein Verfahren, das von einer Vorrichtung eines Roboters durchgeführt wird, umfasst das Erzeugen einer Kostenkarte für Umgebungsbereiche des Roboters anhand einer Rasterkarte und Informationen über ein Hindernis, das von einem Sensor des Roboters erkannt wurde, wobei die Umgebungsbereiche innerhalb einer Schwellenentfernung vom Roboter liegen, das Erzeugen eines kürzesten Ausweichpfades von einer aktuellen Position des Roboters zu einem Ziel, Erfassen eines gesperrten Bereichs außerhalb eines Sensorabtastbereichs, Erfassen eines Eintrittspunkts in den gesperrten Bereich, Erzeugen eines Eckenabbiegepfads, Bestimmen, ob ein Sichtfeld des Sensors in jedem voreingestellten Zeitintervall gesichert wurde, Erzeugen des kürzesten Ausweichpfads oder des Eckenabbiegepfads als endgültigen Pfad, Ausgeben eines Signals, das den endgültigen Pfad angibt, und Steuern der Bewegung des Roboters anhand des Signals.

abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft eine optische Messanordnung (100) zur Distanzerfassung einer Komponente relativ zu einer Referenz entlang mindestens einer Messachse umfassend einen Sensor (101) mit einem Sensorkopf (102) und einem mit der Komponente verbundenen oder verbindbaren Messtarget (103), wobei der Sensorkopf (102) einen Einkoppelspiegel (104) zur Einkopplung eines Messstrahls (106) und einen Endspiegel (105) aufweist, die eine Resonatorkavität (107) eines optischen Resonators umschließen, und wobei das Messtarget (103) eingerichtet ist, den Messtrahl (106) zwischen den Spiegeln (104, 105, 108, 109) des Sensorkopfes (102) hin- und herzulenken. title: MOBILES HANDGEHALTENES COMPUTERZUBEHÖR
abstract: Es wird ein mobiles Computerzubehör offenbart. Das mobile Computerzubehör umfasst ein Gehäuse mit einem ersten Abschnitt und einem zweiten Abschnitt. Der erste Abschnitt weist einen Montagemechanismus auf, der sich von einer ersten Oberfläche des ersten Abschnitts erstreckt und konfiguriert ist, um eine abnehmbare Computervorrichtung aufzunehmen, und eine Lasche, die sich von einer zweiten Oberfläche des ersten Abschnitts erstreckt, um ein Greifen des mobilen Computerzubehörs zu ermöglichen. Die zweite Oberfläche liegt der ersten Oberfläche gegenüber. Der zweite Abschnitt weist eine Radiofrequenzidentifikations (RFID)-Antenne auf, die in einem Inneren davon positioniert ist. Der zweite Abschnitt erstreckt sich in einem spitzen Winkel von einem proximalen Ende des ersten Abschnitts, sodass das Gehäuse U-förmig ist. Der spitze Winkel, um den sich der zweite Abschnitt von dem proximalen Ende des ersten Abschnitts erstreckt, ein Betrachten einer Szene über eine Anzeige der Computervorrichtung bereitstellt, die in dem Montagemechanismus montiert ist, während RFID-Etiketten gelesen werden, die in der Szene vorhanden sind.

title: DRAHTLOSER LEISTUNGSSENDER, DER EINE VORLADUNG MIT GERINGER LEISTUNG ZUR FREMDOBJEKTDETEKTION IN EINER HALBLEITERVORRICHTUNG IMPLEMENTIERT
abstract: In einer Ausführungsform wird eine Halbleitervorrichtung offenbart, die eine Pufferschaltung, die dazu konfiguriert ist, selektiv ein Ladesignal an einen Induktor-Kondensator-Knoten eines Leistungstreibers auszugeben, um den Induktor-Kondensator-Knoten auf einen vorbestimmten Spannungspegel zu laden, und eine Verstärkerschaltung, die dazu konfiguriert ist, eine Spannungsdifferenz über einem Kondensator des Induktor-Kondensator-Knotens des Leistungstreibers zu überwachen, umfasst. Die Verstärkerschaltung ist dazu konfiguriert, ein positivseitiges Signal und ein negativseitiges Signal auszugeben. Die Halbleitervorrichtung umfasst ferner einen Ausgang, der dazu konfiguriert ist, mindestens ein Signal basierend auf dem positivseitigen Signal und dem negativseitigen Signal an einen Analog-Digital-Wandler zur Messung durch eine Steuerung bereitzustellen.

title: Localization system for autonomous work vehicles
abstract: A system is provided for localizing an autonomous work vehicle within mapped agricultural environments when GPS may be unavailable. Range sensors capture LiDAR images that are segmented by a trained model into features such as trunks and canopy. Trunk points are clustered to compute centroids, which are used to estimate left and right tree lines and a lane centerline relative to the vehicle. This sensor-derived centerline is compared with georeferenced lane and row geometry stored in a digital map. A particle filter maintains multiple pose hypotheses, propagates them using vehicle odometry, and weights them according to alignment between the lane centerline relative to the vehicle and the mapped lane geometry for the particle. Resampling and averaging of high-weight hypotheses produces an adjusted pose that corrects for lateral and heading errors. The adjusted pose serves as input to a navigation controller that issues steering and speed commands, enabling accurate autonomous operation. title: ADHESIVE LABEL AND METHOD FOR MANUFACTURING ADHESIVE LABEL
abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft ein Haftetikett (100) zum Verspenden auf Produktverpackungen (10), insbesondere auf Kunststofflaschen (101), und ein Verfahren (200) zur Herstellung eines solchen Haftetiketts (100). Das Haftetikett (100) weist eine Basisfolie (11) aus Polyolefin mit einer Dicke von 80 µm bis 110 µm, eine partielle oder vollflächige Klebstoffbeschichtung (14) bestehend aus einem Acrylatklebstoff mit einer Anfangshaftung nach Finat FTM9 (N/25 mm) von ≥ 10, eine vollflächige Beschichtung bestehend aus einem Drucklack (15) und eine vollflächige erste Bedruckung mit mindestens einer ersten Druckfarbe (16) auf, wobei die Druckfarbe (16) im Flexodruckverfahren mittels einer ersten Rasterwalze (191) auf den Drucklack (15) der Basisfolie (11) aufgetragen ist, wobei die erste Rasterwalze (192) eine Slalom-Gravur (201) besitzt. title: ANALOG-TO-DIGITAL CONVERTER FOR CONVERTING AN ANALOG INPUT SIGNAL INTO A DIGITAL REPRESENTATION AND METHOD OF OPERATING AN ANALOG-TO-DIGITAL CONVERTER
abstract: [0001]    The invention concerns an analog-to-digital converter (1) for converting an analog input signal (V<i>) into a digital representation, the analog-to-digital converter (1) comprising comparison means for comparing an upper comparison value and a lower comparison value with the input signal (V<i>) and for outputting an indication signal indicating a crossing of the input signal (V<i>) with one of the comparison values, and comparison value generating means for generating the upper and lower comparison value depending on adjustment signals (A<u>, A<l>) of a control logic (2). title: Method and apparatus for public warning system indication and acquisition in wireless networks
abstract: This document describes systems and methods for indicating to a user equipment (UE) that a public warning system (PWS) is to be, and is being broadcasted, and for the UE to acquire the PWS broadcast. An Internet of Things (IoT) or an enhanced Machine Type Communication (eMTC) communication unit receives a message directly from a wireless serving communication unit. The received message indicates a PWS message and may be a Downlink Control Information (DCI). In response to a received message a transceiver in the communication unit is arranged to receive the broadcast PWS. The communication device may be a narrowband IoT (NB-IoT) device and may form part of a non-terrestrial network (NTN). [Fig. 2]

title: WATER HEATING SYSTEM AND RELATED MANUFACTURING METHOD
abstract: The water heating system (100) comprises: a compressor (101); an evaporator (102); a water tank (103); a condenser (104), to transfer heat to the water tank; a fan (105). The compressor (101), the evaporator (102), and the condenser (104) form a refrigeration cycle through which the working fluid circulates. The condenser includes a tube (T) wrapped around the water tank (103) to form a spiral about the longitudinal axis (L) and connected to the water tank (103), wherein at least one segment of the tube (T) in the spiral has, in a cross-section along a radial plane comprising the longitudinal axis (L), a flat wall (T2) in contact with an external surface (1031) of the water tank (103), and a curved wall (T1), joined to the flat wall and radially projecting toward the outside of the water tank (103), so as to form a "D" shape.

title: DEVICE, METHOD AND CLUSTER FOR DISPENSING LIQUID TO A WATER-SOLUBLE POUCH AND MACHINE FOR FORMING AND FILLING WATER SOLUBLE POUCHES
abstract:
[0001]    It is disclosed a device for dispensing liquid to a water-soluble pouch comprising: a fluid inlet; a fluid outlet; an elongated body defining a longitudinal axis of the device, the elongated body having a fluid passage therein extending from the fluid inlet to the fluid outlet; a fluidly actuated valve for opening and closing the fluid outlet, the valve having a fluid cylinder housed in the elongated body; wherein the fluid inlet, the fluid passage, the fluid cylinder and the fluid outlet are axially arranged with respect to the longitudinal axis; and wherein the fluid passage defines a fluid chamber, having an inlet and an outlet, enclosing the fluid cylinder.
[0002]    It is also disclosed a method for dispensing liquid to water soluble pouches, a cluster of two or more devices for dispensing liquid to water soluble pouches and a machine for forming and filing pouches made of water-soluble film.
assignee: MESPACK S L [ES]; Mespack, S.L.
inventors: SMITH GAVIN PATRICK [US]; HARTMAN DONN D [US]; LOIACONO TONY [US] et al.

title: DEVICES AND METHODS FOR DETECTING WATER INGRESS IN PERSONAL CARE DEVICES
abstract: [0001]    A personal care device includes a housing, a relative humidity sensor disposed within the housing, and a processor disposed within the housing and configured to monitor a rate of change of relative humidity within the housing using an output from the humidity sensor, and generate a water ingress alarm when the rate of change of relative humidity exceeds a predetermined first threshold. The personal care device may further include a temperature sensor disposed within the housing. In this case, the processor may be further configured to monitor a rate of change of temperature within the housing using an output from the temperature sensor, and generate the water ingress alert when both the rate of change of relative humidity exceeds the predetermined first threshold and the rate of change of temperature is below a predetermined second threshold.
assignee: KONINKLIJKE PHILIPS NV [NL]; Koninklijke Philips N.V.
inventors: KULAS ALEXANDRA [NL]; HIRSCH KELLY LAURENCE [NL]; KULAS, Alexandra et al.

title: INDOOR AIR COOLING
abstract: [0001]    The invention concerns a building air cooling system that comprises a thermoelectric heat pump (10) with a cold plate (11) and a hot plate (12), an indoor heat exchanger (3) for indoor air at the cold plate (11), a water duct (8) at the hot plate (12), an entry water conduit (50) at the water entry (30) of the water duct (8) and an exit water conduit (51) at the water exit (31) thereof. The entry water conduit (50) is configured flow-capably to connect to a plumbing system (40, 41) of a building. The exit water conduit (51) is configured to dispose of heat from the indoor heat exchanger (3) towards an outdoor environment. A flow-influence device (34, 35, 36, 37, 38) that is configured to influence the flow through the water duct (8) and to do so in the entry water conduit (50), the water duct (8) or the exit water conduit (51). The invention also concerns a method for installing suchlike building air cooling systems. The invention further concerns a room air cooling unit that comprises a thermoelectric heat pump (10) in between a heat-conductive foam (3) and a water duct (8), which are fixedly connected with respect to each other.
assignee: SIEMENS SCHWEIZ AG [CH]; Siemens Schweiz AG
inventors: HUBER BIRGIT [CH]; UTZ BERND [DE]; Huber, Birgit et al.

title: SNOW GENERATION SYSTEM FOR BATHROOM SYSTEMS
abstract: [0001]    This present disclosure is generally towards a snow generation system. The snow generation system can be integrated with a bathroom system, allowing the bathroom system to dispense water and snow. The snow generation system includes a storage configured to store water and a cooling system configured to generate snow using the water. The generated snow is dispensed from the bathroom system.

title: POWERTRAIN AND VEHICLE
abstract: [0001]    This application provides a powertrain and a vehicle, and relates to the field of electric vehicles. The powertrain includes a reducer and a motor controller, and a housing of the powertrain includes a reducer housing and an electric control groove. The reducer housing is configured to accommodate a cooling member and a gear shaft assembly of the reducer. The electric control groove is configured to accommodate functional components of the motor controller. An outer peripheral wall of the reducer housing includes a first base plate and a first side plate, and an axial bottom wall of the reducer housing includes an output bearing groove. The first side plate protrudes from the first base plate and away from the output bearing groove. The first side plate is a groove wall of the electric control groove, and the first base plate is a groove bottom of the electric control groove. The cooling member includes at least one hole, and the hole faces one of the first base plate or the first side plate. In this application, coolant is delivered to the first side plate and the first base plate, to cool the electric control groove and the functional components, thereby reducing a risk of an overheating failure of an internal component of the powertrain, and improving performance of the entire vehicle.
assignee: HUAWEI DIGITAL POWER TECH CO LTD [CN]; Huawei Digital Power Technologies Co., Ltd.

title: BEVERAGE CONTAINER WITH IMPROVED STRAW INSERTION OPENING
abstract: [0001]    Die Erfindung betrifft Getränkebehälter (1), insbesondere Getränkebeutel, mit einer vorderen Behälterwand (1a), einer hinteren Behälterwand (1b) und einem Boden (8) aus einer ein- oder mehrschichtigen Verpackungsfolie (2), umfassend: eine schlitzförmige Einstanzung (3), die im oberen Bereich der vorderen Behälterwand (1a) vorgesehen ist, wobei die Verpackungsfolie durch die Einstanzung (3) ganz oder teilweise durchgestanzt ist, ohne dass Partikel der Verpackungsfolie (2) ausgestanzt werden, eine Verschlussfolie (12), die an der Innenseite der Verpackungsfolie (2) der vorderen Behälterwand (1a) durch Verkleben, Verschweißen bzw. Versiegeln befestigt ist, um die schlitzförmige Einstanzung (3) innenseitig zu überdecken, wobei durch das Verkleben, Verschweißen bzw. Versiegeln zwischen der Innenfläche der Verpackungsfolie und der Verschlussfolie ein versiegeltes Gebiet (4) gebildet ist, das die Einstanzung (3) in der Verpackungsfolie (2) innenseitig umschließt, wobei das versiegelte Gebiet (4) zwischen der Verschlussfolie (12) und der Verpackungsfolie (2) einen inneren Schweißrand (5) und einen äußeren Schweißrand (6) umfasst, wobei der innere Schweißrand (5) ein Bereich (7) umschließt, in dem die Verpackungsfolie (2) nicht mit der Verschlussfolie (12) verklebt, verschweißt bzw. versiegelt ist und in dem sich die schlitzförmige Einstanzung (3) befindet.

title: TREATMENT AGENT COMPOSITION FOR CARBON FIBER, TREATMENT AGENT FOR CARBON FIBER, METHOD OF FORMING THE SAME AND CARBON FIBER PRECURSOR
abstract: [0001]    A treatment agent composition for carbon fiber, a treatment agent for carbon fiber, a method of forming the same and a carbon fiber precursor are provided. The treatment agent composition for carbon fiber includes modified polysiloxane having at least one modified functional group, a dispersing agent and water. Based on an amount of the modified polysiloxane as 100 wt%, an amount of the dispersing agent is 10 wt% to 50 wt%. The dispersing agent has a structure shown as formula (I). The modified polysiloxane is dispersed in water by the dispersing agent with the specific structure, thereby making the treatment agent for carbon fiber have better emulsification stability and thermal stability.

abstract: Provided is a bag capable of easily and stably holding a container with a simple operation and greatly reducing wetting of the bag with a liquid even when a beverage leaks from the container.[Problem][Solution] A bag includes a main body that has a bottom portion and a peripheral wall portion connected to the bottom portion at a peripheral edge of the bottom portion, and has a space portion that is surrounded by the bottom portion and the peripheral wall portion and is capable of storing contents, and an opening portion through which the contents are inserted into the space portion, the main body is provided with a position restricting member having a restriction wall portion that restricts movement of the contents inside the space portion, the position restricting member is bonded to at least an inner surface of the peripheral wall portion, and in a case where the contents are placed in the space portion so that the movement is restricted by the restriction wall portion, when a surface facing the content among surfaces of the restriction wall portion is defined as a facing surface, the restriction wall portion is configured to be capable of forming a first shape state where the facing surface forms a concave surface and a second shape state where the facing surface forms a convex surface.

title: RELIABLE CAPSULE BEVERAGE DISPENSING SYSTEM
abstract: A machine (1) is arranged to prepare a beverage from an ingredient contained in a capsule (100) by supplying an extraction liquid therein, The machine (1) has: a machine outlet ((55)) configured to dispense beverage externally towards aa user - recipient (9); and a seat (10,20) for holding the capsule (100) during beverage preparation. The seat ((1100,,2200)) includes: a seat liquid inlet (14,14') configured for delivering the extraction liquid to the capsule (100); and at least one seat outlet (15,15') at the capsule (100) configured to guide beverage from the capsule (100). The seat outlet (15,15') is associated with a capsule outlet opener (15a, 15a'). The machine (1) has a beverage passage (5') extending from the seat outlet(s) (15,15') up to the machine outlet (5). The seat outlet (s) (15,15'), the beverage passage (5') and the machine outlet (5) form an outflow path (5,15,15') having a direction of beverage flow extending therealong and a flow cross - section transverse to the direction of flow along the outflow path (5,15,15'). The flow cross - section along the direction of flow has a smallest cross - section with a surface area of at least 4.5 mm2. For example, the capsule (100) is made of a soft and/or tearable material, such as a material that is cellulosic,, cellulose-based or a cellulosic material, such as wood pulp or wood pulpbased or paper-based or cardboard-based material.

title: USED CAPSULE RECEPTACLE FOR BEVERAGE MACHINES
abstract: A machine (1) configured for preparing a beverage from an ingredient contained in a capsule (100) has: a passage (2) for evacuating such ingredient capsule (100) upon preparing a beverage from such capsule (100) in the machine (1); a seat (20) positioned so that the evacuation passage (2) leads into the seat (20), the seat (20) having a bottom end (21); a capsule collector (10) having a bottom (11) and sidewalls (12,12') delimiting a cavity (13) with a cavity entry opening (14), the cavity (13) being configured for storing such used capsules (100); and a spacer (15). The capsule collector (10) has a collection position in which the capsule collector (10) is located in the seat (20) above the seat bottom end (21) for collecting in the storage cavity (13) capsules (100) delivered into the storage cavity (13) via the evacuation passage (2) and the entry opening (14). The spacer (15) has a spacing position in which the spacer (15) is located in the seat (20). The capsule collector (10) and the spacer (15) are removable by a user from the seat (20). The spacer (15) is removable from the seat (20) independently from the capsule collector (10) when the capsule collector (10) is blocked in the seat (20) by one or more capsules (100) protruding above the entry opening (14) of the collector (10), whereby a space (22) in the seat (20) is freed below the collector (10) to lower the collector (10) and the protruding capsule(s) (100) under the evacuation passage (2) so as to allow removal from the seat (20) of the collector (10) after removal of the spacer (15).

title: RELIABLE CAPSULE REMOVAL SYSTEM
abstract: A machine (1) has a capsule extraction module (10,20) for preparing a beverage from an ingredient contained in a capsule (100) by supplying an extraction liquid (e.g. water) into such capsule (100). The extraction module (10,20) has: first and second capsule enclosure parts (10,20) movable relative to each other between a proximate position for enclosing and processing the capsule (100) to prepare a beverage in the module (10,20) and a distant position for inserting the capsule (100) and removing the capsule (100) from the module (10,20); and a capsule removal arrangement (40,50) for assisting removal of such capsule (100) when the first and second parts (10,20) are brought from the proximate to the distant position. At least one of the first and second capsule enclosure parts (10,20) has a corresponding cooperating face (11,21) extending over a corresponding capsule (101). At least one of first and second pushers (40,50) comprises a pusher face (41,51) for pushing the corresponding capsule face (101,102) away from the corresponding cooperating enclosure part face (11,21). The first pusher face (41) and the first cooperating enclosure part face (11) have a surface area ratio of at least 0.1 and/or at most 10; and/or the second pusher face (51) and the second cooperating enclosure part face (21) have a surface area ratio of at least 0.05 and/or at most 0.2.

title: Windkonverter zur Umwandlung von Windenergie in mechanische und/oder elektrische Energie
abstract: Der Windkonverter hat einen Mast, an dem wenigstens ein Flügel vorgesehen und der um eine Achse drehbar ist. Der Flügel ist je nach Windrichtung zwischen zumindest zwei Stellungen quer zum Drehlager hin- und herschwingbar. Der Mast ist zumindest in einem Bereich zwischen dem Drehlager und dem Flügel elastisch biegbar ausgebildet. Der Flügel kann aufgrund einer solchen Ausbildung optimal selbststätig so eingestellt werden, dass die Windenergie gut in die mechanische und/oder elektrische Energie umgewandelt werden kann.

title: WEARABLE COMPUTING DEVICE WITH TEMPERATURE CORRECTION OF SKIN AUTOFLUORESCENCE SIGNAL
abstract: A computing device includes a temperature sensor for generating skin temperature data of a user of the computing device, a skin autofluorescence (SAF) sensor for generating SAF data of the user, and a controller configured to perform a plurality of operations. The plurality of operations includes receiving the skin temperature data and the SAF data over time, determining a correlation between the skin temperature data and the SAF data over time, applying a temperature correction factor to the SAF data to correct the SAF data for skin temperature of the user based on the correlation, determining at least one health parameter of the user using the corrected SAF data, and displaying, via a display of the computing device, the at least one health parameter to the user.

title: EMBEDDED RETINAL IMAGING COMPACT CAMERA MODULE WITH THIRD PARTY APPLICATION DEVELOPMENT API
abstract: [0001]    This invention relates to a compact camera module (CCM) for capturing retinal images, built into or embedded in various electronic devices such as smartphones, tablets, laptops, and wearables. The system is designed to facilitate AI-driven systemic disease detection by providing high-quality retinal images to third-party developers through an API. Alternatively, the system may include a built-in AI disease diagnosis application within the CCM software, eliminating the need for third-party integration. The retinal images can be analyzed by AI to detect early signs of systemic diseases, such as diabetes, hypertension, and cardiovascular conditions, thus making advanced health diagnostics accessible, especially in underdeveloped areas. The system features a dual-purpose objective lens for both optical and illumination paths. It is optimized for integration into portable consumer electronics with space constrains, enabling widespread usage and access to diagnostics.

title: ROLLING BEARING AND RELATIVE METHOD AND INSPECTION SYSTEM
abstract: A rolling bearing (20) for a helicopter (1) is described, comprising a first ring (21) extending around an axis (A) and a second ring (22) extending around the axis (A) and radially external to the first ring (20). The rolling bearing (20) further comprises a plurality of rolling bodies (23, 24) cooperating with said first and second rings (21, 22), so as to roll on respective raceways (25, 26, 27, 28) of said first and second rings (21, 22) and to allow the relative rotation between the first and the second ring (21, 22) around the axis (A); and a cage (29) configured to maintain the rolling bodies (23, 24) angularly distanced from each other around the axis (A). The cage (29) comprises a cavity (30) configured to be selectively engaged by a sensor (50); and facing the first ring (21) and/or the second ring (22).

title: CONVERTIBLE AIRCRAFT CAPABLE OF HOVERING
abstract: [0001]    An aircraft (1, 1', 1") is described with a fuselage (2) extending along a first longitudinal axis (Y) of the aircraft (1, 1', 1"); a pair of half-wings (3, 8) projecting sideways, cantilevered, from the fuselage (2); a pair of first rotors (20a, 20b; 21a, 21b; 22a, 22b) that revolve about a second axis (B, C; D, E; F, G) and can be tilted independently of each other about a third axis (H; L; J); a pair of first motors (30a, 30b; 31a, 31b; 32a, 32b) that can be operated to rotate first rotors (20a, 20b; 21a, 21b; 22a, 22b) independently of each other; the aircraft (1, 1', 1") can be moved between: a first forward flight configuration and a second take-off/landing configuration in which the second axes (B, C; D, E; F, G) are arranged transverse to the first axis (Y); first wing areas (60a, 60b; 61a; 62a, 62b; 70a, 70b; 72a, 72b) operationally connected to respective first rotors (20a, 20b; 21a; 21b; 22a, 22b); the first wing areas (60a, 60b; 61a, 61b; 62a, 62b; 70a, 70b; 72a, 72b) being tiltable with respect to the third axis (H; L; J) as a result of the inclination of the respective first rotors (20a, 20b; 21a; 21b; 22a, 22b) about the third axis (H; L; J) independently of each other.

title: IMAGE FORMING APPARATUS
abstract: [0001]    An image forming apparatus (100) includes a main body (1), a container (2), an outer cover (3) and an inner cover (4) which is supported turnably around a second axis (A2) with respect to the outer cover (3). The inner cover (4) sandwiches the container (2) between the outer cover (3) and an upper part (41) located above the second axis (A2). After the inner cover (4) enters the main body (1), by pressing the inner cover (4) toward an outer side, the upper part (41) of the inner cover (4) is turned around the second axis (A2) to approach the container (2). The inner cover (4) includes an engagement portion (40) in a lower part located below the second axis (A2). In a state where the inner cover (4) is not pressed toward the outer side, the container (2) engages with the engagement portion (40).

title: METHOD FOR DERIVING ADJUSTMENT ANGLE FOR RADAR SENSOR INSTALLED IN VEHICLE
abstract: [0001]    A method for deriving an adjustment angle for a radar sensor installed in a vehicle, includes transmitting radar signals through the radar sensor during the driving of the vehicle; receiving radar signals reflected from a target; generating point cloud data based on the received radar signals; deriving adjustment feature information based on the point cloud data; performing fitting of the adjustment feature information with respect to a cosine graph; deriving an adjustment angle based on the fitted adjustment feature information; and post-processing the point cloud data based on the derived adjustment angle.
assignee: BITSENSING INC [KR]; bitsensing Inc
inventors: LEE HYEON KYU [KR]; JIN HO YOUNG [KR]; LEE, Hyeon Kyu et al.

title: CYBERSECURITY RISK DETECTION FOR A SERVICE
abstract: [0001]    The present disclosure provides an approach of collecting contextual execution data of a service executing in a runtime environment. The contextual execution data indicates a communication between the service and a runtime entity within the runtime environment. The approach determines a cybersecurity risk score of the service based on the contextual execution data and prioritizes the service based on the cybersecurity risk score. In turn, the approach performs a remediation of a cybersecurity threat to the service based on the prioritizing.
assignee: CROWDSTRIKE INC [US]; CrowdStrike Inc.

title: METHODS AND SYSTEMS FOR SCENE FLOW ESTIMATION
abstract: A computer implemented method for scene flow estimation includes: determining a plurality of point detections at a present point of time based on sensor data from a sensor, each of the point detections including a coordinate vector and a point feature vector; sampling a first point feature grid vector for each point detection based on a first feature grid; estimating a previous point detection for each point detection at a previous point of time using a preliminary scene flow; sampling a second point feature grid vector for each previous point detection based on a second feature grid; determining a fused point feature vector for each point detection based on the point feature vector, the first point feature grid vector and the second point feature grid vector; and determining a scene flow for each point detection based on the respective fused point feature vector.

An example device may receive an external data stream from a source external to the surgical system. The device may derive, based at least on the external data stream, decision contextual information. The device may select a surgical option associated with a surgical instrument based on the decision context information. The device may generate a control signal associated with the surgical instrument based on the selected surgical option.

title: CONFLICTING DATA STREAMS IN MULTI-SYSTEM INTERACTION
abstract: [0001]    A surgical system may include a processor configured to make a determination between two seemingly accurate but conflicting data streams. The processor may be further configured to obtain a first data stream and a second data stream associated with a same measurement. The processor may be further configured to determine a first control parameter based at least in part on the first data stream. The processor may be further configured to determine a second control parameter based at least in part on a second data stream. The processor may be further configured to compare the first control parameter and the second parameter. The processor may be further configured to select a data stream between the first data stream and the second data stream based on the comparing. The processor may be further configured to generate a control signal based on the selected data stream.

The first IED (202) may measure a local current and a local voltage (206), transmit a first signal indicative of the local current and voltage measurements to additional IEDs (204) via one or more communication channels, receive one or more additional signals indicative of remote current and voltage measurements (210) from each of the additional IEDs (206), determine a respective asymmetry of each of the communication channels based on the local current and voltage measurements (206) and the remote current and voltage measurements (210), determine a total asymmetry based on the respective asymmetries, compare the total asymmetry to one or more threshold relationships between operating currents and restraining currents, each of the one or more threshold relationships comprising a slope value, and perform a control function based on the comparison.
